4sdus/2laḥshā/lhaX'i/zi//zi/ /ni/hāzla7paramatshom rigasaslobag mo'ibodamigachedadesad/nyerasgrolanasapa'imanāḥtā rig slotparshakā~Xrtsomaparazhib ṭā/zloshārjom/kāṭā/kāswāslob degazhigrangasanyung rigasaskadayig khagagisna///ཿtrīḥswārsha swā//rāḥ /zlo/na99loramatshosngonamirigasadapesakhangadulasayosasposate nibodabyi/rtso/ sgrig khogis rin/na zloshāstuzlog/sgriga~Xg ri/ga//pa'i khang spyokhyabartsom sgrigagazhonapabacasakyilas khurichi rdomi'irtsomasgriga'izhusdusadzolashāl/7stomuradhikārakā misdudhislob/shā:/kā//shāḥ/zlo/rshaswāhā mo'i'aganabazhesamusasu

sngon du zhu ba'i gtam/da lan krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang bis par skrun byas pa'i 〈〈'gyur rtsom dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs 〉zhes bya ba 'di ni phran gyis 'o ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la bya ba'i khom gseng spyad de snga phyir rgya yig nas bsgyur pa'i snyan ngag dag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig ste/ de'i nang gi phal che ba ni deb tu bkod nas pa ra skrun byas pa'am dus deb steng du spel myong ba dang / nyung shas ni gsar du bsgyur nas dus deb tu spel long ma byung ba bcas bsdoms nga/sa ldeb grangs bzhi brgyar zin tsam 'dug dang thog phran nas kyang mkhas pa che ge mo zhig la mgo brjod cig bri bar bskul bsam zhing mi sna'ang phal cher gtan du 'khel zin mod/ de lta na ni mkhas pa de ga'i ngo so la brten nas rang gi dpe cha'i rin thang yar bstod pa'i khrel gzhir mi 'gyur ram snyam nas spobs pa ngang gis zhi bar gyur cing tha na dpe deb par du gdab pa'i dgos pa ci tsam mchi ba dang klog mkhan ci tsam yod pa'i cha la'ang sadeng tshod chen po med pas/ par du gdab bam mi gdab kyi the tshom gcad ma thub par re zhig lus so/ /de'i tshe grogs po 'ga' yis klog mkhan mang yang srid la nyung yang rung / 'on kyang slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi 'dzin grwa'am zhib 'jug slob ma'i rgya bod yig sgyur gyi tshan khag de min rgya bod yig sgyur kyi las la blo kha phyogs pa'i las dang po ba rnams la zhib 'jug sga rin thang dang dpyad bzhi'i zur blta'i rin thang nges par yod pas par du btab na legs zhes yang yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ phran nas kyang bsam blo yang yang 1

btang ba'i mthar/ dpe deb 'di nyid las phran gyis lo bcu phrag 'ga'i yis sgyur lag len dang zhib 'jug gi bshul lam sa 'dra zhig brgyud pa dang /nyams myong dang bslab bya ji tsam yod pa/ yig sgyur dang nang sgos su snyan ngas 'gyur rtsom la khyad chos ci tsam yod pa bcas klog pa po'i lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa dang 'dra bar mngon sum mthong chos su 'gyur sla zhing / de las legs nyes blang dor gyi blo skyed tog tsam 'thob na'ang yig sgyur las don gyi 'phrul 'degs su mi 'gyur grang snyam nas spobs pa cung tsam rgyas te par btab pa'o/ /yig sgyur ni yang bskyar gsar rtsom gyi las ka zhig red ces kun tu grags pa ltar/ yang bskyar gsar rtsom gyi las ka zhig yin phyin/ de la sgyur pa pos ma yig gi brjod don chad lhag nor 'gal gyi skyon dang bral bar ji bzhin du mtshon par byed pa gzhir byas thog tshig sbyor gyi cha nas sgyur byed kyi skad dang yi ge la brten nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rtsom gsar rkyang zhig spel dgos pas/ ma yig gi don la go ba len stangs mi 'dra ba/ sgyur thabs spyad stangs mi 'dra ba/ tshig sbyor spel stangs mi 'dra ba bcas kyi khyad par dang khyad chos cis kyang yod nges la yod rung ba zhig kyang red/ gnad 'gag ni 'gyur ma'i nang gi brjod bya'i don dang phyi'i tshig gi rnam pa gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dres te ma yig gi brjod don ji bzhin mtshon par ma zad/ ma yig gi rtsom gyi khyad chos dang rnam pa ma mtha'ang dod tsam mtshon par byed pa de red la/rtsom rig gi 'gyur dang nang sgos su snyan ngag gi 'gyur la dmigs tshad de 'dra zhig ma bton rang bton red/ phran gyis dang thog rgya'i snyan ngag sgyur ba'i skabs su don sgyur gyi thabs gtso bor spyad de ma yig gi brjod don ma nor 2

bar mtshon pa'i thog tshig sbyor dang rnam pa'i cha nas bod kyi snyan ngag gi khyad chos ldan pa zhig byed dgos par bsams nas rgya'i snyan ngag sho lo ka gcig yin kyang bod kyi snyan ngag sga nyams 'don pa'i ched du tshig rkang drug gam brgyad du byas nas bsgyur myong / de 'dra byas na sgyur pa po rang nyid kyi tshig mi nyung ba zhis ngang ngam shugs kyis tsheg bar du bsdebs te ma yig sga tshig gi rnam pa ye nas zhig pa ma zad don gyi cha nas kyang bsres lhad kyi skyon zhugs pa bshol thabs med pa zhig tu gyur/ de nas bod du 'gyur zin pa'i gna' rabs rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa slob dpon dbyug pa can gyi 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉dang bod kyi snyan 'grel grags can dag la zhib 'jug tog tsam byas pa na/ me long ma'i nang du gsungs pa'i 8 lho shar thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan mi ni mthar gtugs na snyan ngag rtsom stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis yin cing / rtsom stangs de gnyis bod yig gi lam nas ji bzhin du mtshon par byas pa ni bod kyi lo tsā bas ma yig gi brjod don dang rjod byed kyi tshig gi khyad chos chu dang 'o ma bzhin gzhi gcig tu legs par bsdebs pa'i dper mtshon zhig tu gyur yod pa dang / bod rang la'ang de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rtsom stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis su gyes pa gzhi nas shes byung / de nas rgya'i snyan ngag la bltas pa na/de la thog mar sgra'i drag zhan dang dbyangs nges pa'i sho lo ka gcig gam yang na du mas rdzogs par byed pa'i snyan ngag rtsom lugs shig dang / dang thog rol dbyangs la 'bru btab cing phyis su rim gyis gtan 'jags su gyur pa'i tshig rkang ring thung mi 'dra ba bsdebs pa'i rtsom lugs shig ste snyan tshig de nas rjes su byung ba'i tshig rkang ring thung dang tshig phreng mang nyung gang la'ang rang dbang thob pa'i rtsom lugs te rang mos snyan ngag ces gsum du phye ba de dag 3

mtha' gcig tu bod kyi snyan ngag rtsom lugs ltar tsheg bar do mnyam pa'i snyan ngag tu bsgyur tshe rgya'i snyan ngag bi khyad chos nyams shing zhig par 'gyur bar nges na/ de ni 'gyur legs sam 'gyur nyes yin pa da dung brtag dgos pa'i gnas su 'dug dbyin ji'i snyan ngag pa chen po hra hri pis yas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag tshig rkang bcu bzhi ma de phyis kyi mi rnams kyis khong bi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom lugs shig tu brtsis te gdeng 'jog byed bzhin yod pa dang /bod kyi snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring lags kyis khong sgas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag tshig rkang bdun ma can (de ni thog mar sho lo ka gcig bar du tshig rkang gcig tha mar tshig rkang gnyis kyis don rdzogs pa can )de khong rang nyid kyis gsar du gtod pa'i snyan ngag rtsom lugs shig tu brtsis pa lags na/bod du 'gyur tshe'ang rtsom rkang bcu bzhi'am tshig rkang bdun can du byas na ma gtogs/ de'i khyad chos dang yon tan ye nas zhig 'gro bas gzab dgos par 'dod/ de 'dra'i lag len dang zhib 'jus gi bya rim tog tsam brgyud rjes/ rang nyid la ma yig gi nang don ji bzhin du mtshon par byas pa'i thog tshig gi rnam pa'am khyad chos la'ang do snang byas te/ rnam pa'i cha nas kyang klog pa pos ma yig gi rtsom gyi khyad chos shes thub pa zhig byed rgyu ni gnad kyi don por 'dzin dgos par snyam pa'i blo skyed cig thob byung / de'i phyir phran gyis phyis su bsgyur ba'i snyan ngag la phyi'i tshig gi rnam pa la'ang do snang byas shing rtsol ba byas pa'i shul rjes de klog pa po tshos rig pas zin thub nges red/phran gyi bsam tshul du/ yig sgyur ni ches sla zhing ches dka' ba'i rig gnas las ka zhig red/ ches sla ba yin zer don ni/ rig gnas mi 'dra ba gnyis tog tsam shes tshe khyod kyis yig sgyur gyi las ka phran tsam byed nus pa 4

red/ ches dka' mo red zer don ni/ yig sgyur byed tshe sgyur pa po la shes bya rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dka' gnad la 'phrad nges red la / dka' gnad de das dgrol dgos na thog mar khyod la ris gnas gang dang gang la'ang thos pa tog tsam yod dgos pa dang / thos pa'i stobs de la brten nas dka' gnad de dag 'grol byed kyi thabs dang nus pa'ang yod dgos pas las sla mo zhig ga la yin te ma yin no/ /des na da lta nga tsho la dgos pa ni skad cha'i go brda 'phrod pa tsam ma yin par khyod kyi 'gyur rtsom de bod kyi rig gnas phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur dgos pa de lags na/ da lan par du bskrun pa'i 'gyur rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 'dis 'gan de 'dra zhig theg gang la nus te mi nus kyang / bod kyi klog pa po tsho'i dpyad gzhi tsam du 'gyur na'ang dge ba'i tshogs su bsngos te kun gyi spyan lam du bstar bar mi khrel bar zhu zhes lo tsā ba'i ming tsam 'dzin pa sangs rgyas nas spyi lo 2007zla 6tshes 5la bris te phul/

dkar chagayi dam tshe ring 899lo/1nga yis nyi zla'i 'od kyi 'byung gnas 'tshol zhing snyeg (1)sbyi lja/ /ra rgurdo tt+waṃ dzobyangs rta/ (7)tsho6chi/ci lo:mi blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas gyi nar ma 'dug ldang zhig ces/ 'jig rten shing rta kun gyi mar gyur ma pham g.yu mtshos 'di skad gsungs/ (14)ma lnga chosamarsā76༅lko tshotsho/1712422232rta mgrin mgon po/ 〉zlomachoblupyid kyi smon 'dun/ (23)ndhu spro'i mdun du/ (26)rnyi/ 'irjosam/ mi rjes/ rta'i mig rjes/ (28)rab ༵༵ pye zlodrozlo//chi/khu/ khaṭwā~X ༵ ༵nga / (31)༵༵gatsho ༵ bstod glu/ (34)bskal bzang rdo rje/ cha tsho rke

rma chen gangs ri'i mtshan snyan/ (37)spre 314bza /sde/skye 12 rha gug pa'i 'brong rwa/ (41)dzorikhri nyaspro'oṣpe.a le /dzo )khu ri tshogs sam yang na nga rang nyid la phul ba'i bstod tshig (46)yā/1 tshozloskrur7khri mtsho.a:ltokhrid nas phul ba'i bstod tshig (58)khrang ༵/kā sbra snronā rje'i gru gzings/ (60)hru'u sgrong / charsālto~Xhā/ spyang la phul ba/ (82)hre kong krung / lkolko ༵ shāl dran pa'i skyo gdung / (85)lis pe/gyirnye lu'u hran ri bo'i rbab chur gzigs pa/ (87)stso1yongakhrismu lha'ispyang rnyingags mtshan mo'i dran gdung / (87)chang /dren pa/ (88)tu'u tt+waṃ/dhishā 2

ḍho ljo sdong la slebs pa'i mngag gzhug (90)sdushārnyi smon 'dun/ (92)meng dhe sdin/ rtsa/mi 8kṇi/ḍi ma'i zhogs pa/ (93)su'u hri/ 77 hru'e ti'o ki thi'u/ (94)/sna zloshā / (96)lis sbyispri tram̐/ sgo/ spro zhoyeX can me/ (98)lis snye /༷rto ṭha:dri gā rin/ (99)rlong tha'o hra/ (100)tsho /yi/lu'u yug /67pu'u son tsi/ dpyid mgo'i me tog la bsngags pa/ (101)tsha'o tt+waṃ/zoms shārnyi ༵ bdun ma'i snyan tshig (102)3

ri thang gser bye'u 'khor/ (103)zhin ddhi rnyi / rjozloṣṭhasdu/rlukrin tsi/ (104)wang rshasdo/dīsna / /sdugā /na tsi/ (106)pe cu'u dbyi/ ngo〉〉7dbyi cang nan/ (108)/271 pi wang 'gros/ (109)ming ddhirdo snag ma chastegatsa shā nan/ (116)ku'u ༵༵ rten/ 775rsātrī ༷/cha snyan tshig (117)ming merdo zhig ma chazloXhāng seng / (121)ming med zhig /rsā4shumatsha nges med snyan tshig (125)lko 2 stutho4

gsar brje'i sngon byon pa dang gsar brje'i sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i snyan tshig (127)pho tshi rsālko04lo7 //tsho/67/mtsho sngon la dga' ba'i glu dbyangs/ (293)tsho/thi rsā stu oṃ 7sdig 1rdiX mdo gsar ma/ (314)byerte rnosurngo mdo/ (351)(rwa rdzo〉〉

yi dam tshe ring /rjong yis nyi zla'i 'od kyi 'byung gnas 'tshol zhing snyegagacigakye kye grogs po khyod kyis zla ba'i bsil zer phreng ba dus rtag tu//yal med yid 'ong nyams 'gyur 'bum gyis kun yid myos pa e shes lags//ltar snang ma yin rgyu mtshan yang dag nga la gsong bor brjod par zhu//kye kye grogs po nyin mo'i byed po'i tsha zer stong gis 'khyags grang gi/rgol ba mthar byed mthu stobs rab rdzogs gzi dpal nyams pa med de ci//ngas ni de yi bden don mthar thug zhib tu yang yang rtog cing 'tshol//gnyis/na tshod shin tu phra mo'i skabs su gdong la nu zho'i rtsis sbags pa'i//phran chung nga yis a ma'i phang du mgo bo dgyes te zla ba la//khyod kyi skyed yum su dang gang zhig mig las dngul mdog 'od dkar gyi//'dzum zer phreng ba mngon par spro 'di ci zhes dris kyang lan mi ldon//de tshe byams brtse'i gter gyur ma yis skya rengs bsu ba'i glu dbyangs shig/gyer las de ni de yi a ma'i snying gi sgron me nyid du mthong //1

de phyir de ni skyes ma nyid nas mnal du yur ba'i go skabs dben//gdong la rdul dang snabs kyis gang zhing gom pa'i 'degs 'jog slob pa'i dus//nga yis a ma'i pus mor bsnyes te nyi ma khyod ni ci yin dang //gser gyi 'od zer phung bor grub pa ci zhes dris kyang lan mi ldon//de tshe mtshungs med drin ldan ma yis nga la thog ma'i zhabs 'dzugs kyi//glu zhig gyer las de ni de yi a ma'i re ba'i gshog 'dab zung //yin phyir de ni mi yi yul du drod khol skyel ba'i rta ljang bcibs//gsum/mdang dgong khri shog rgyal mo'i mtha' ru zla ba'i rjes su bsnyegs pa lasalhade ni chu gter lan brgyar bsrubs las dngul dkar mdangs su bkra bar go//de phyir de ni sprin dang na bun stug pos g.yogs shing dkris na yang //gtsang zhing dkar ba'i kun gsal 'od snang nam yang mi nyams rtag pa dang //bar med 'jo ba'i dbyar gsum char bas yang yang bran zhing gsher na yang //rul cing myags pa'i dri bsung ngan pa ldang ba'i dus shig yod re skan//zhogs par nyi zla ri bo'i rtse ru 'greng nas nyi gzhon bsu ba'i tshe/khyagaser gyi zegs ma spro dang 'dra ba'i nyi ma'i 'od kyi dra ba ni//sa yi snying pos bzhu sbyang gnang ba'i drin la brten pa gzhi nas shes//de phyir mtshan mo'i smag rum tshal du rgyu yang mun pa'i dri ma gos//gangs dang 'khyags pas rab tu bsdams pa'i dgun gsum grang ngar brgal byas nas//2

mi yi 'jig rten 'jig rten mi la dpyid kyi drod khol sbyin par rtsom//bzhi/srod kyi mdzes sdug mtshams sprin dbus su nga yis kha dog lnga ldan gyi//dra rgya btab tshe yar 'brog g.yu mtshos nga la 'od kyi rgyu spun bsgrigs/khutamatsho yi gnyer ma dal bur g.yo zhing dkar gsal zla ba mkha' la lham//kye ma snyigs bral chab kyi dwangs gtsang gting mtha' mi mngon rgya mtsho'i 'jings/gnyis skyes rgyal po'i dri med khyad chos 'od kyi mtshar sdug yon tan te//srog gi 'dus byas de dang de yis yid kyi mun pa'i dpung tshogs dang //mi gtsang dri ma ma lus gzhil bar mdzod ces snying nas gsol ba 'debs//nyi gzhon gsar ba'i 'od kyi dbus la nga yis 'ja' tshon zhags pa zhig/btab pas gangs dkar ti se lhun pos 'od kyi rtogs pa slar yang bskyed/khyapadma'i gnyen gcig shar ri'i rtser 'phaṭa nor 'dzin dga' ba'i dpal la rol/kye ma zhing sa'i snum gshin yon tan dbyig 'dzin khong gi tsha drod dang //srid pa'i mig gi 'dzum zer dang ni snang ba'i 'od kyi mdzes sdug ste//rang byung khams kyi lhun grub yon tan de yis dpyid kyi dpal yon dang // ston gyi 'bras bu phun tshogs skrun pa'i thabs lam mchog cig ston par mdzod//lnga/de nas nga yis bag yod srab kyis phyir phyogs rnam shes rta rgod de//g.yung ba'i gnas la rab tu bkol cing stobs shugs yod dgu rtsal bton nas//rang don kho na don du gnyer ba'i bdag 'dzin mun pa stug po dang //3

byams dang snying rje'i tsha drod btang ba'i 'khyags grang ma lus slog byed kyi//rno zhing dbal ba'i nyi zla'i thong gshol zung gcig dmigs kyis bzo bar 'dod//de phyir nga ni mtshan mo la 'ang tshe 'di'i spro skyid 'tshol zhing rgyug/nyi gzhon gsar ba'i 'od dang 'grosas nas slar yang 'tsho ba'i snying po rtog/de nas nga yis rgo cha'i brtson 'grus brtson 'grus go cha legs bgos te//ma zin shor ba'i dus kyi rta po'i rjes su bsnyegs shing chod par byed//ji srid sems shugs yod tshad de srid ma lus yongs su rtsal sprugs nas//dbyar gsum tsha ba'i gdung ba dang ni dgun gsum 'khyags pas gzir ba dag/ming gi lhag mar gtong bar byed pa'i glog zhags dmar po slas par 'dod//de phyir nub kha'i nyi zer zigs ma cha shas tsam yang bsags byas te//zhigs pa'i zhim mngar zil ba'i thibs pa ji dang ji snyed snyol bar byed//drugargyu skar lam dang rgya mtsho'i gos can mi g.yo rab tu brtan pa dang //rta ljang can dang bsil zer byed po rgyad pa'i go skabs ye nas dben//kye kye srog gi 'dus byas khyod kyis nga la bslab ston mdzad pa'i mthus//nga yis lag zung ring du brkyangs nas sngo ljang dpyid kyi dpal yon dang //ston gyi phun tshogs 'bras bu dang ni mi yi mnyes gshin ngang tshul dang //dri med lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i thugs rgyud yongs su sdud par byed//de ring nga yis 'phar lding mnyam pa'i khyod kyi rgyu rtsa reg pa na// dgyes dgur rol ba'i chu mtsho chen por mdog legs rba rlabs g.yo dang 'dra//4

'jig rten mig dang bde 'byung gtsug rgyan rgud pa'i gro skabs bral ba dang //gser ldan ma dang lha yi rdzing ring rnam par mi g.yo rab tu brtan//ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan de yi mtshungs med mthu stobs kyis//nga yi dri med yid kyi ngos la stod kyi skor gsum mnyes gshin dang //bar gyi ru bzhi'i mdzes sdug dang ni smad kyi sgang drug sngo ljang mdog/me long ngos la gcig tu bsdus bzhin ma lus snying la nyar bar byed//de ring nga yis khyod kyi rngul chu'i dri bzang sna bas mnam nyid du//nor 'dzin gzhi la bsung zhim 'thul ba'i 'dab brgya'i char ba babs dang mtshungs//bdun/da lta nyid nas nga yis snang ba'i yon tan dran pa'i lam du 'jug/tshe dang srog gi 'dus byas dang ni zla ba'i dri med bsil zer te//snying gi khong na g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i dngos po de dag chu gter gyi//thigs pa zags sam yang na gangs ri bzhus pa'i chab rgyun yin nam ci//nga ni da gdod bla med sgron bskal mchog la slebs pa'i skal ba ldan/khyam bcos lhun grub yon tan dang ni nyin byed 'od kyi gzi dpal te//srog gi dbang po'i yul du gyur pa'i dngos po de dang de dag ni//rang byung khams kyi rtog pas bzos pa'i rang gi gzugs byad mngon pa'am//'gro ba'i snying nas slar yang sos pa'i rig pa'i 'char sgo yin nam ci//e ma dngul dkar zla ba'i 'od snang ji 'dra mdzes shing sdug pa ang /e ma gser mdos nyi ma'i tsha zer ji ltar dro zhing 'jam pa ang //

mchan 'grel/༷yi dam tshe ring ( 1933 2005) mtsho sngon zhing chen dam ra gtsang sa cha'i mi yin/ 1949lo'i zla 11pa nas bya bar zhugs/ 1952lo nas bzung rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi mgo tshugs/ snga phyir dmangs khyod glu gzhas 'tshol sdud dang / zhabs bro/glu tshig zlos gar sogs gsar rtsom byas myong / phyis su ched gnyer rtsom pa po'i phyag las gnyer zhing / krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi tshogs mi dang / krung go'i bod kyi rtsom rig tshogs pa'i kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes myong / khong ni rgya yig bi lam nas bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang bod kyi rig gnas la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i bstod glu 'bul mkhan snyan ngag pa grags can zhig go/ /6takhri shog rgyal mo zhes pa mtsho sngon po'i ming ngo / /0nyi zla ri bo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon po'i shar gzhogs gung ho rdzong dang stong skor rdzong gi sa ma tshams na yod pa'i ri bo zhig gi ming / thang rgyal rabs skabs rgya bza' kong jo bod la phebs pa'i tshe ri bo 'di brgyud nas bzhud skad/④yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes pa ni bod ljongs sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs kyi mtsho zhig gi ming / rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma 678yod skad/dugangs ti se zhes pa ni bod ljongs mnga' ris khul spu hreng rdzong khongs na yod/yongs grags su gangs rin po che zhes gsol/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs rig byed smra ba dang /g.yung drung bon/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa tshang mas so so'i gnas mchog tu brtsi bas ming grags shin tu che/dusgron bskal ces pa ni sgron me'i bskal pa ste/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon dus kyi bskal pa'i ming ngo //6

tshe srog dar rgyad kyi dbyangs rta/—rig gnas ngang tshul skor gyi bsam gzhigagayu 'drug nam mkhar lding yang / spar rjo sa la mi lhang /—bod kyi gtam dpe/nor 'dzin gzhi la 'od snang bzhad cing nyi zer bdud rtsi zegs pa 'di//gangs dang smug pas bsnyal las grub pa'i ri klung gis ni sngo bsangs mar/mtshams sprin mdangs ldan dar rgyad ri mo bsam bzhin brkos pa yin nam ci//yang na gdags srib snol mar bsdebs pa'i nam mkhas nor 'dzin bu mo la//mtshungs med bdud rtsi'i phun tshogs ro brgya bsam bzhin chad med 'grem nam ci//'di rnams tshe srog 'byung gnas yin phyir rtag tu gso skyong byas gyur na//dka' sdug de yis tshe la bsnan pa'i zungs bcud la ni skyes ldan gyi//rtogs pa rgyas sam ma rgyas dbye ba khyod kyis rnam par brtags sam ci//gal te 'di rnams tshe srog 'byung gnas yin phyir gces skyong byas gyur na//dungs sems de yis mdzes sdug yul la sbyin pa'i dri med lhag bsam der//dkar ser dmar sngo'i kha dog tshogs kyis bsnyegs min sdom tshig bzhag gam ci//ga nas brtag cing legs par dpyad kyang de rang nyid do gzigs shig dang //sprin phung gis ni sa gzhi'i smug pa'i gdams ngag zab don rtogs pa'i tshe/7

bar snang khams nas ngo mtshar nyams brgya nyin byed dbang pos rab bres pa'i//dkyil 'khor bla bre'i tshad dang mthun pa'i rol rtsed ci dang ci yang 'gyed//nyon dang ngang 'jam char thibs kyis ni sprin rlangs re smon nyer bskul pas//rang gis sa la 'bebs pa'i smra brjod gtam phreng tshogs ni bus pa yis//chu gter chen po blo 'gugs byed pa'i lad zlo'i ngag dang mthun par bsdebs//de nas bzung ste zhogs pa'i smug pa dkag par gyur tshe rgya mtsho yis//dpal 'bar sgron pas sa dang bar snang gzhi nas phan tshun brda 'phrod cing //rlung dang sa rdul khrod du rgyu spun bsnol ba'i kher sdug nyer bkug pas//slar yang 'tsho ba'i phang du log ste gzhan gyi gces skyong rol bar byas//de nas bzung ste srod kyi mtshams sprin mkhregs rdor 'gyur tshe gangs ri yis//rgya mtsho gsal ba'i sgron me gsod pas 'khyams por thar ba'i bde thob cing //rgyal khams 'grim pa'i skyo sdug zas kyis sgrogs pa'i gcong nad yongs su dwangs//sgyu ma'i rmi lam lta bu'i bden rdzun phye zhing dran shes skyed par byas//de nas shi gson 'thab pa'i 'gran rtsod yang yang rtsom par byas pa ni//mgo yi 'khyags rom krong nger 'greng ba'i dud khyim sgo gtad byas pa'i phyir//de nas mdzes sdug phyi ru phyung ba'i rgyang skyod yang yang byas pa de//rkang ba'i zhabs kyi drod rgyun 'phags de nam mkha'i 'ja' gur phub pa'i phyir//mdang dgong rtsa ba'i se ba re rer gru char thigs pa g.yo bar byas//sa la lhung ba'i char thigs dog pas mtshar sdug dpal gyi ri mo bkra//8

zhogs par dri zhim se 'brus me tog 'dab ma re la dga' ba bskyed//mgo la bkra ba'i mdzes sdug dang la gyis rkang ba drug pa myos par byed//ma nyams spobs pas rab brgyan 'tsho ba'i na chung gzhon nus mtshar sdus bi//lang tsho'i kho lag rdzogs pa'i dpal gyis 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gzi byin ngom//ma/ yal lhun chags mdzes sdus so ra mos rgyad bral 'tsho ba'i rgyud mang sbreng //gzhan dbang min pa'i 'tsho ba'i shed kyis 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'bras bu sbyin//khyod kyis nga la brtse zhags btab pas nga yis khyod kyi lhag phran zhig/btes ste nam mkha'i khyon 'dir kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja' gur phub byed cing //rul myags bral ba'i ri klung nas ni me tog ldem mer bzhad pa'i tshal//gtsang zhing gtsang la mdzes shing mdzes pa nyid cig sa la 'god par byed//nga yi sems kyi dran shes nyid kyis nga la dran shes bsnan pa'i phyir//srid 'di'i ldog med skye 'phel chos la ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi dpal 'bar zhing //tshul mthun bag yod ngang rgyud ring ba'i mdzes sdug mtshams sprin phung bo yis//nam mkha'i bya lam bya lam mkha' 'di sngar las yangs shing che bar bskyed//'gyur med brtse ba'i zhags pas bcings pa'i rdzogs med sems kyi phugs 'dun mchog/yal med ngo mtshar nyams brgya bskrun na bla med g.yur za'i 'bras bu smin//grangs med 'jo sgeg ngang tshul mchog la nyams med spobs pas yongs khengs te//slar yang brtse dung nyid du 'gyur na de ring gdeng thob gom kha bsgyur//9

mdang dgong skyes pa'i sa brtol ljon de nyi gzhon 'dra ba'i dpal bral yang //nyi gzhin gsar ba sngon la bsu ba'i 'dab ma'i gar stabs ngang gis bsgyur//de ring dgung la zug ltar 'greng der hi ma la ya'i gzi byin mchogakhyamed kyang gsar skyes gzhon nu'i spobs pa ma nyams ri bo'i rtse la bsnyegs//de phyir nga yis ngang ngam shugs kyis sa gzhi'i 'phrul gyi mngag gzhug ste//ngo mtshar sprin gyi phung tshogs gzigs tshe de yis kha dog rnam bkra ba'i//yol ba btegs pas char rlung mthun par bsdebs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro zhig/mya ngam thang dang mi med lung stong dag tu bar med sgrog par byed//de phyir nga yis mgrin pa bteg nas dran dang shes pa'i 'bod sgra sgrogs//sngo bsangs khyon na 'khor zhing rgyu ba'i bla med 'od gur zlum po yis//zhim ngad 'thul ba'i du sprin tshogs shig sa la rim gyis 'phos pa'i mthus//gangs dang 'khyags pa'i dbus na 'tsho de mtshungs med skyes stobs dpal yon rgyas//de'i tshe nga yis mgo bo dgye nas bsams shing zhib tu gzhigs pa na//g.yu 'brug nam mkhar lding zhing 'khor yang spar rdo sa la mi lhung zhes//gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe tshad ldan de yi go don gzhi nas rtogs//mgo bo gug cing lag par bsnyes nas mno bsam zhib tu btang ba na//rtsa ba ma lus sa la zug kyang rtse mo gnam la bslangs so zhes//khrag dang mig chus grub pa'i bden don mdud pa grol ba bzhin du gyur//10

e ma rtogs pa de nyid thob pas nga la tshad med dga' bskyed kyang //mtshams sprin dum bu sa las blangs te nyi 'od ka bar 'gel byed cing //'phrul snang rmi lam zung gi 'gul skyod char rlung drag por phrad pa'i tshe//mi 'dod rkyen ngan mgo la ma babs rang srung rten du 'gyur bar sems/e ma bsod nams stobs kyis thob 'dis nga la g.yur za'i 'bras sbyin yang //mtshungs med dpyid kyi gsos bcud mngar rgyun rtog pa'i 'dab mar drangs pa'i mthus//glo bur dud sprin gsar ba 'khrigs tshe rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba bzhin//lus dang sems kyi dri med mnyes gshin 'chel ba'i rten du 'gyur bar bsgoms//dwangs shing bsil ba'i 'bab rgyun phra mo lu gu'i lkog gyur yul du rgyug/a ma'i phang du gnyid ma sangs la thol byung bla rdol smra 'di su//bla rdol sgra yis rmi ltas lam gyi mtshan ma yag po dkrigs sam ci//g.ya' dag mkha' yis than bya glag gi lkog gshom ngan pa 'geb par byas//gdong la 'bag gyon mngon sum yul du ngan skul byed pa'i lha de su//dran dang shes pa sbrid byed dug rlangs bsam bzhin bslangs pa yin nam ci//kye kye mkhas dbang khyod ni rang rlom ches na rigs pa rags par 'gyur//skad cig nyid kyi blo nyes des kyang rang nyid 'phung ba'i gnas su ltung //nga ro gcig gis gnam sa g.yo ba'i ri dwags rgyal po chen po yang //nyam chung ri bong g.yo thabs kyis ni srog dang 'bral bar byas min nam//11

kye kye mkhyen ldan khyod ni blo rig rgod na gzab nan min par 'gyur//grog tshang gcig bis mtsho mo brdol ba'i sngar byung lo rgyus grags min nam//thang dkar rgod kyis gshog yas nam mkha' 'gebs pa'i rlom sems che na yang //nam zhig sdong 'gyel gshog pa gcog pa'i chag sgo yong zhes khyod kyis gsungs//skye rgu'i bdag po khyod kyis gson dang 'doms shes sngar gyi bslab bya de//phyis kyi phan bde'i gzhi ru 'gyur bar the tshom dogs pa ga la srid//nga tshos 'phongs kyi rnga ma'i rus tshigs lhung zhing med par gyur bzhin du//slar yang dud 'gro'i gras su zhugs te ljon rtser 'dzeg cing phyi sug zung //brkyangs nas mngar chang gis bsnyal sil shun 'phrog pa'i dgos pa ga la 'dug/skye rgya'i bdag po khyod kyis gson dang mi la phyis sdug med gyur na//snga sdug cis kyang yod ces 'jig rten gtam dpe kun la grags min nam//tshang ma'i gtam brjod mgrin dbyangs gcig tu 'gyur bzhin sngar 'das ci la dran//mdun gyi gangs dkar rdza chu sngon mo bsam bzhin btsog par bslad pa na//sang bi dri zhim mngar ja dang ni 'o ma snum po ga la yod//kye ho nga yis bsams shing gzhigs na nyi ma'i 'od la g.ya' chags shing //chu klung gis ni me rgyun 'bab pas gang mkho sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyis//nyams dga'i bde thang lam sna gcod dam yang na gang mthong slog byed pa'i//12

'gro tshogs kyis ni re ba zad pa'i 'u thug lam 'phrang slob gam ci//mchanahu ༷ṭwāṃ sdu la ya ni ri bo hi ma la ya ste da lta 'dzam gling thog mtho shos dang ches ring shos kyi ri rgyud cig yin par bshad/

blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas gyi nar ma sdod ldang zhig ces/ /'jig rten shing rta kun gyi mar gyur ma pham g.yu mtshos 'di skad gsungs/(snyan tshig 'di 1986lor lha sar tshogs pa'i bod rig pa'i gros mol tshogs 'du thengs dang por phul ba lags/)kye kye rje btsun gang gi blo sgo rnam 'byed 'phrul lde rnyed dam ci//mdang dgong bgrang yas rgyu skar tshogs rnams phyogs med mkha' la 'dus pa'i tshe/nga yis sra brtan chu lon 'gag sgo cig car phye ba'i gtsang po'i rgyun//drag tu rgyugs pas nor 'dzin g.yo byed 'ur sgra thos de ci zhig lags//kye kye shes ldan gang gi dran shes 'ching ba'i rgya las bkrol lam ci//zhogs pa'i mtshams sprin gsar ba'i mdzes ris sngo bsangs bzhin la bkra ba'i mod//nga yis slar yang gangs dkar stod g.yogs bklubs pa'i sa 'dzin phreng tshogs las//nyi ma'i gzi la skyengs byed 'od snang spro de mthong ba ci zhig lags//14

gal te khyod ni brjed ngas ma khyer dran 'dzin dbang po nyams min na//bcu gnyis bdag pos chu mthongs rtse nas chu sater ma la 'tshams 'dri'i tshig/'bul tshe de yis sangs ri las 'phos thun mtshams sasar ba'i bos gyon zhes//mtshungs med bskal brgyar ma nyams gnas pa'i snyan rtsom ring mos gsungs min nam//gal te khyod ni kun rtog ma nyams brjed ngas dbang du gyur min na//dri med gangs ri rgya mtsho las 'phags sngo bsangs bu mo bsu ba'i tshe//de yi phyag na tsha zer dpag med 'byung ba'i nor bu bteg go zhes//gna' bo'i srid pa chags glu nyid las de ltar gsungs pa thos min nam//lags so dbyig 'dzin gzhi yi ngo mtshar skye stobs dpal yon rab 'bar ba'i//yon tan nyid kyis tsha zer dang ni rlangs pa'i sprin gnyis rab ngal ba'i//rngul chu bar med rtag tu 'bebs pas brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun bzang de//ma nyams 'phel ba'i stobs dang spobs pa ldan par gyur pa bden dpang byas//lags so 'byams klas lha yi rdzing ring khyon gyi ngo mtshar ltad mo las//me dang chu yis rgyun chad med par btsos shing bsnyal las rab byung ba'i//dri med dwangs gtsang sprin gyi rlangs pa gzhi nas g.ya' dag nam mkha' la//rnam par 'phags pa'i dge ba'i mtshan ma mngon sum tshad mas bstan min nam//'on kyang mkha' yi sprin 'od zhun ma sra zhing rengs par ma gyur mod//15

sa yi 'khyabs rom rab dang rim par ma zhu mkhregs par lus 'di ci//nga yis ma shes skyes rabs du mar btang snyoms bzhag pa'i dri ba de//sgro 'dogs gcod par rje btsun khyod la re zhing ltos pa e tshor lags//gya gyur 'bab pa'i gtsang po'i rgyun gyis 'gro ba'i bgrod lam ma bcad par//rgya mtshor skyod pa'i gru gzings lam de yang yang chad 'di ci la thug/nga yis the tshom dra rgya ma chod shes ldan khyod kyis gcam bu'i ngag/ma yin drang ba'i gsung zhig 'byon par re sgug byas pa e rtogs lags//dbang phyogs lhun po'i spo la zhigs pa'i nyi gzhon gsar ba 'phags pa'i dus//me ltar tsha ba'i brtse zhen dbang med thog ma nyid du gangs ri la//gtad pa 'di yang bus pa nu zhor snyogs pa'i dpe bzhin skem pa'i kha//gdangs pa'i dal 'gro ma yi slad du dmigs pa khyod kyis shes min nam//tsha zer brgya bas sa yi rlangs pa mkha' yi sprin du btso ba'i tshe//bcos min sems kyi dung ba chen po thog ma nyid du nyin byed la//nyer sbyin 'di yang mes pos stong nyid sgom pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yis//nyin mtshan med par g.yu 'brug sprin glang sgug pa khyod kyis mkhyen min nam//da lo mtshar sdug rmi lam 'dra ba'i thun mtshams bsar ba snang ba'i dbus//nga ni tung thin mtsho mo'i 'gram du skyod tshe rba rlabs g.yo ba'i rtser/khyami ring 'dab gshog rgyas par 'gyur ba'i khyung chen lta bu'i ngang ba mo//rigasar ba'i khyu tshogs dga' mgur rol pa nga yi mthong ba'i lam du byon//16

mdang dargong dri med me long 'dra ba'i dkar gsal nya gang zla 'od 'os/nga ni 'bri chu'i stod kyi 'gram du yid kyi 'gyu ba spro bas na/khyangam grog mthil gyi dal 'gro'i bzhin la ris su brkos pa/'i gangs seng gis//le dbar stong la nyin gyis gcod pa'i 'phur shes rta mchog sgug pa mthong lpade'i tshe rje btsun khyod kyi lnga rig nyin byed lta bu'i 'du shes mchog/'gyu ba myur ram skyes dngos yod rgyar skye stobs sbyin pa'i nyi zer la//byin gyis brlabs bzhin da ni kha ba ri ba'i 'ja' tshon med 'di ci//nga yi bsam pa'i snang ngor the tshom dri ba mang po'i rtags kyis 'tshang //shes ldan khyod kyi 'khyug rtsal ldan pa'i phyag zung rgya las bkrol lam ci//rgya mtsho gnyis kyi bsam pa klung brgyad g.yo zhing dkrug pa'i nus ldan bzhin/khyad ni kha ba'i ljongs kyi 'dun ma legs pa'i 'khor lo rin po che//bskor bar ma nus gyi nar lus 'di ci zhes nga yis dris pa lags//sngo bsangs bu mo'i lto ba ral dogs rngam chen gangs ri'i rtse mo dang //blta bas mi ngoms tshar du dngar ba'i mu 'brel ri tshom phreng ba yis//chad med rgyugs pa'i gtsang po'i rgyun la chab kyi kha snon mi nus na//shar lhor 'phred du bcad de 'gying ba'i dregs nyams de yis ci zhig bya//rlabs kyi gzigs ma bar med mkha' la 'phyo ba'i 'bab ldan gtsang po dang //snyan pa'i ca co sgra dang sdeb bzhin rjes 'brang chu phran tshogs kyis ni//pha mtha' mi mngon dal 'bab mdzod kyi lto ba 'gengs pa'i chab kyi gsos//dgos 'dod ji bzhin sbyin nus min na khengs pa'i nga ro sgrog 'dis ci//17

kye kye blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas yar la ldang zhig ces//'jig rten shing rta kun gyi mar gyur ma pham gci mtshos 'di skad gsungs/khyamatho ba'i nam mkha' thogs reg bral bas mgo bo bteg la skrag dgos ci//khyod kyi rgyab na rab 'bying ri tshogs rtse mo dgung la zug min nam//las dang skal ba'i mgyogs 'gror bcibs nas dpa' bskyed mdun du mchongs shig ces//gangs ri'i dbang po nyid du gyur pa'i lhun po ti ses 'di skad gsungs/khyamu mtha' yas pa'i gser ldan gzhi ru 'dril bar 'gyur la skrag dgos ci//shar la 'bab pa'i chu klung yod rgu chad med rgyugs pa mthong min nam //kye kye khyod ni sha khrag gdos bcas phung bo nyid du gyur bzhin du//pha rol yul gyi snying nye min pa'i mig bi zur mda' phog tsam gyis//snying zhum bag 'khums dbang du gyur nas ri dang rgya mtsho'i mthar brgal ba'i//'jigs med gom pa'i 'degs 'jog spangs nas bris sku'i brtul zhugs ci la 'dzin//ma dag 'gro ba'i mi gsal shes pa me long rdul bzhin phyis pa dang //lha yi mi gshis sems la nges phyir khyod kyi zol med rang gshis kyis//lhad med gser gyi bden gtam gsungs zhes mnga' ris sa 'dzin rtse mo nas/khyamangon mchongs seng ge 'bum phrag mgrin las 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs ci yang sgrog/18

kye kye khyod ni smra shes don bo sason nyams ldan pa'i khyod yin phyir//yun ring ma yin gnas skabs tsam gyi 'khyags shur smus sprin tog tsam gyis//re zhig dkris la zhed cing yer bas g.yu 'brug 'ja' tshon skyugs pa yi/mgrin pa brnangs te gzhan dbang ma yin rang sgra 'gags pa ga la srid//lam bar 'khyog pa'i sgra gdangs dag bcos dus kyi nor bas rab bskyed pa'i//skyo sdug rab bsangs bla med mchog gyur las skal 'ba' zhig gyur pa des//khyod la dbyar rnga'i sgra ltar che ba'i gsung lan nges par ldon cig ces//mdo smad rgyud nas drag tu 'bab pa'i gtsang po du mas sngar nas sgrogakhyakhyod ni khyod dang skyid sdug sna mang myangs pa'i khyod ni khyod yin phyir//pha rol rgol bas 'phya zhing smod pa'i 'gram chu zegs ma'i thigs pa 'ga'//gtad so med par gang phyogs sa la dbo bas ri rab lhun po'i tshogs//cig car mid pa'i chu yi 'phrul 'khor nyid du 'gyur ba ga la srid//sngar 'das gzi brjid nyams pa slar gso 'byung 'gyur ngo tsha yol ba'i phyir//khyod kyi gsar brdol rang zhen la rgya khrag gis pad ma bsgos pa bzhin//ma 'ongs sang zhogs mun sel rin chen sgron me phyag la thogs shig ces//dbus gtsang khul gyi gangs ri tshogs kyis gzengs su bstad nas gsungs min nam/khunyes nas gyen la bslangs pa'i ri bo yin phyin mgo bo mi sgur ba'i//brtan cing brling ba'i rang gshis yod kyi ltos dang 'gas grum ri rgyud phreng //19

gas shing grum yang rang tshugs ma zhig lhun gyis chags pa'i gzi byin de//gcig las gcig lhag mig gi dpal du mngon sum gyur pa e ma mtshar//kye kye ri rab bzhin du byin chags dpal gyis mdzes gyur rje btsun khyod//khyod kyi sems kyi dbyangs rta de ni 'di ltar blos bslangs 'di ltar sgrog/rab brjid ri bo hi ma la yas mabo bo bteg ste gzigs nga/ na//gcong rong zab cing rlung rlabs che bar zhed pas the tshom dra bar tshud//'on kyang mjug mthar the tshom rgya las bgrol zhing gzeb las rab brgal ba//de ni yang yang dpangs mthor 'gro zhing gyen la 'phags pa'i rtags min nam//sa 'dzin phrag nas drag tu 'bab pa'i phreng ldan yin phyin de nyid la//phyir mi ldog pa phyir mi 'ong ba'i yangs shing dkyil che'i spobs pa ldan//ltos dang chu lon shor ba'i gtsang po chu lon shor yang nyam nga 'am//bag tsha med pa'i blo khog dang ni snying stobs mngon par bstan pa mtshar//rdzing bu'i chu bzhin zhi bar gnas pa'i mtshungs med shes rab ldan pa khyod//khyod kyi blo ngor nyar zhing bsags pa'i snyan 'jebs mnyam sgrog rol dbyangs ni//g.yo zol med cing blo gshogs yangs pa'i bcos min gdod ma'i rang gshis mchog/rdzu yis ma 'gebs lhang nger ston pa'i dgos pa shin tu che bar snyam//rta yi rmig pas me tsha spro ba'i 'bab ldan rgyal mo rngul chu de/khya'aphur bzhin thur la rgyugs tshe mthong lam 'gog pa'i smug sprin gtibs pa dang //gar 'bebs yul la gdeng tshod med pas re zhig som nyir tshud srid mod//20

'on kyang mtha' mjug rtogs pa sad cing gdeng med yid kyi the tshom de//sgro 'dogs chod pas snying stobs rab rgyas ri dang rgya mtsho chen po yis//'jigs med gad rgyangs sgrog 'dra'i dpa' nyams ma bcos lhun gyis grub min nam//kye ma shes ldan khyod ni rig pa'i srol 'byed thon mi sam bho ṭa'i/khyango mtshar 'phrul gyi lde mig yin phyir da dung g.ya' btsa'i skyon ma gos//mdang dgong lha sa'i tshogs 'du'i dbus su blo yi sgo mo rab phye bas//nga yi yid kyi dgyes pa'i rba rlabs kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'phyo bar byas//kye kye rje btsun khyod kyi dran shes po ta la yi dung dkar bzhin//mgrin pa g.yas su 'khyil cing bteg ste snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs sgrog gam ci//da zhogs nyin mo'i dbang phyug gzi yis dgos 'dod sim pa'i dpyid char de//nga yi dga' ba'i mchi ma'i zol gyis 'dzin ma'i gzhi la 'bebs 'dir ltos//mchan 'grel/0tung thing mtsho zhes pa ni rang rgyal hu'u nan zhing chen gyi byang phyogs/ 'bri chu'i lho 'gram du chags pa'i mtsho zhig bi ming ste/ rang rgyal gyi tshwa med mtshe'u chen po gnyis pa yin skad/()'bri chu'i stod ces pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen yul shul khul khongs kyi 'bri chu la zer ste rgya skad du ༅lko /po ces brjod pa de red/burta mchog ces pa ni 'dir yar klung gtsang po la bstan ces rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis gsungs/ rgyu mtshan ni bod kyis yar klung gtsang po la rta mchog kha 'bab ces brjod srol yang yod pas so//0rgya mtsho gnyis zhes pa ni hin rdu rgya mtsho dang zhi bde rgya mtsho gnyis la zer ṭwāṃ 1

dang / klung brgyad ces pa ni seng ge kha 'bab/ glang chen kha 'bab/ rma bya la 'bab/ rta /༷/ dro 'bab/ rgyal mo thul chu/ rdza chu/ 'bri chu/ rma chu bcas la zer zhes rtsom pa pos spyodu bye/ ma pham g.yu mtsho zhes pa ni bod ljongs mnga' ris khul spu hreng rdzong khongs dang gangs rin po che'i nye 'dabs na yod la/ de las chu bo gaṅgā/ sin lhu/ si ta/ pakṣu bcas 'bab par bshad pas kun gyi mar gyur pa'o zer/bshadadu/ sangs ri'i dbang po zhes pa ni ri tshogs kun gyi rgyal po ste gangs ti se yin par dumanga' ris zhes pa ni bod ljongs mnga' ris sa char bstan pa'o//dumado smad ces pa ni gtso cher da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi mtsho sngon po'i lho nub rgyud dang rma chu 'bab yul gyi sa rgyud spyi'i ming ngo //ming ngoX //dbus gtsang zhes pa ni bod ljongs lha sa nas gzhis ka rtse bar gyi sa rgyud spyi'i (rlurgyal mo rngul chu zhes pa ni bod ljongs kyi nag chu dang sog chu 'dres nas grub pa'i ming zhig ste/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong du 'bab pas de skad du brjod do//()thon mi mabhoṭa zhes pa ni spyi lo dus rabs bdun pa'i mi ste bod kyi yi ge srol 'byed mkhan yin no//22

rta mgrin mgon pokhyadapyid kyi smon 'dun/kye ma mes rgyal mdzin ma'i yang rtse kha ba'i mu khyud can gyi ljongs//stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang ni bar gyi dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i sdes//'bod pa'i mes po'i khams kyi lo rgyus phug ring mdzad rjes bla na med//de la dbang med dad pas ston gyi 'bras bu khur gyis dud pa bzhin//gus pa'i 'dud phyag 'tshal zhing sems khong gting ring grog bzhin zab pa la//khyod kyi gzi dpal gsar pa'i dngos po tshags su bsgrigs zhing bshams par byed/dpyid kyi 'jam rlung ldang bas nga yi nyan thos lcug phran skyod byed cing //gsar skyes myug ma 'tshar legs dpal gyis nga la dga' ba tshad med sbyin//dbus kyi lha ldan grong nas phyogs bcu'i yul dang yul gru thams cad la/phrikha dog drug ldan dpyid kyi pho nya rlung ltar lding skor brgyab pa'i mthus//de snga rbad de bcad pa'i nas son snyan pa'i glu gzhas rta mchog dang //bod yig ka mad sum cu'i phreng sogs slar yang skye stobs zhugs pa bzhin//nas kyi sa lu sa brtol ljon ltar skye 'tshar dpal yon cig char 'bar//snyan pa'i gzhas dbyangs gshog pa thogs ltar nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' la chas//bshul lam gsar ba'i ngos la brtson 'grus ma lhod gom kha sgyur bar byed//shog ngos gsar bar deng rabs can gyi tha snyad gsar ba klong du rdol//kye ma bskal ba bzang por 'phrad pa'i dpal dkyil nor 'dzin bu mo khyod//23

dus rabs gsar ba'i rten 'brel ngang bis 'gris cing phywa g.yang mngon par bsus//gangs ris dngul gyi 'od kor dkrig cing mtsho mtshe'u mu tig phreng bas mdzes//khyod kyi mtshungs med brtson 'grus dang ni khyod kyi spobs pa rgyas pa'i tshul//mes po'i ngag dang sangs rgyas zhal las thon pa'i gsungs las lhag par gyur//mi pham chen po'i sgyug rtse las babs ngag gi bdud rtsi'i mchod yon spros/khu)tshangs sras bu mo'i snyan ngag gdams pa'i gsang ba brtol dang yang dag mtshungs//lhag par dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs dbyar gyi rnga gsang bzhin ldir bas/60kha ba ri ba'i khyad chos ldan pa'i gsung rab bye ma'i grangs la 'phya//de nas ri bo ma la ya nas ldang ba'i tsan dan dri bsung dang /khya'aphaṭa yul mthil gyi dreṭa snyams ldan pa'i rma bya'i sgro mdongs mdzes pa dang /khyangag sgros tsam du zad pa'i me tog u dum wa ra'i sgyu 'phrul lam/khyayang na steng bi mchod pa'i lha mos rked skabs phra ba'i yon tan sogs//kun gyi mchod pa'i yul du snyems pa'i gnas ni rim bzhin shor ba las//zhen pa'i rtog pa gcig pur 'cha' ba'i mi la bsnyen pa tsam du lus//yin yang de ring khyod kyi brjid cing brling ba'i dpung 'jug sder bsdur na//de dang de dag bis ni ngom du ri ba ci yang yod min te//lo rgyus ring zhing gsar skyes byung ba'i gangs ljongs 'dzin ma'i gzhi 'di ru//dus tshigs gsar bar khyod kyi dri zhim bsung ngad ldang zhing rigs skyes la//24

rang bi nga ro sgrog cing 'jig rten khyon la khyod kyi 'brug sgra ldir//rang gi kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja' tshon gur khang rang la 'bubs par byed//red de mes po'i khab kyis khyod la 'di skad gdams shing bcol ba dang //kha dog drug ldan dpyid kyi pho nyas khyod la 'di ltar smon 'dun zhus//lha sa dag pa'i zhing khams yin yang gze ma ra maso mang bas dogs//mes po'i dri med zhal lung de ni yang yang gshar sgo ma byed par rigs//bde ba'i thang la skyod pa yin yang snying la gcag par bya'o zhes//'gro lam gsar ba'i sngon skyod pa la don go chung yang zhus pa lags//mchan 'grel/0rta mgrin mgon po ( 1934 1996) kan su'u zhing chen bsang chu rdzong sga mi yin/ 1955lo nas bzung rgya yig sga lam nas snyan ngag rtsom pa'i 'go tshugs shing snyan ngag pa ming grags can zhig tu gyur/ krung go rtsom pa po'i ma thun tshogs kyi khongs mi dang kun su'u zhing chen kun lho rig gnas cu'u yi cu'u krang gi 'gan khur myong /khu'ilha ldan grong zhes pa ni lha sa grong khyer gyi ming zhig(nyemi pham chen po zhes pa ni 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho mchog la bstan pa yin te/ khong ni dus rabs nyi shu ba'i nang gi rnying ma ba'i mkhas pa chen po zhig go//me dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes pa ni rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo ngag ༵༵༵ blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog gis brtsams pa'i snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ba chen mo de'i (nyeri bo ma la ya zhes pa ni gna'i bshad srol la rgya gar lho phyogs kyi ri bo zhig gi ming ste/ de ru shing tsan dan skye bas tsan dan ri bo yang zer skad/du'aphags yul zhes pa ni rgya gar gyi ming ngo //༷u dum wa ra zhes pa ni me tog cig gi ming ste/ ha cang dkon cing 'phral du yal 'gro ba'i dper 'jog pa'i yul du byed do//25

bu mo'i mdun du/khyod ni sgo ltag 'gram 'greng nas//nga la bgres song ma'o rod ces/khyamatha' gcig dmod pa 'di ci zhig/bdag gis nang zwa brgyab nas ni//lkog gi gser gzhong phyir bton te//shugs kyis gcun pa yin nam ci//nga la longs spyod 'dod ham med//'byor ba'i 'khos ka de bas chung //nga yis nam mkha'i rgyu skar zung //brkus nas khyod la mig 'bras sbyin//mtshan mo'i smag gi gru sne zhig/dral nas khyod kyi skra tshogs bsgos//bzhin la dkar mdangs snon pa'i ched//zho gsar ma la slong mo byas//khyod ni sgo ltag 'gram 'greng nas//nga la bgres song /'o rod ces//gzhan zer bzlas pa tsam min par//26

nga yis khyod la nyos pa yi//glo sman gsher khu mngar bo dang //nga yi gdong gi sha rmen la'ang //dmod 'di ci zhig cha ma 'tshal//mchan 'grel/()bgres song ma'o rod ces pa ni hpha rin si'i rtsom mkhan grags can par kra khes brtsams pa'i (le zhu ku'o rod 〉 ces pa'i sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna gtso bo de la bshad pa red/ de'i nang gi bgres song na'o rod ni dang thog tshong pa chung chung zhig yin yang phyis su phyug por gyur/ 'on kyang gces pa lang shor gyi bu mo gnyis kyis bag med longs spyod /sdo pas dbul zhing stong ba'i gnas su gyur cing / mthar kho rang nyid kyang ltogs grir shi

spyang rjes/ mi rjes/ rta'i mig rjes/gcong rong mthil na 'bab pa'i dal 'gro ma//smug pa stug pos mnan pas 'khun sgra 'byin//nga yi rjes su 'greng ba'i rta pho ni//glo bur ma bde sna phu sgra 'tshub cing //mgo bo grog krog rnga rngog rab sprugs te//yob kyis lcags la rdeg pa'i ting sgra yis//'bab ldan ma yi lan la mya ngan byin//bdag gis snying gcugs grogs der phyir mig gis//bltas tshe de ni mthong byar mi 'gyur ci//srab kyi sne gcig lag pas dam bzung yang //cig shos smug pa'i nang du yal bar gyur//res 'gar thag sne g.yo ba'i ngang tshul las//gzhi nas nged gnyis kha bral med pa shes//rta pho slar yang 'greng zhing rngog sprugs pas//bdag blo ma bde phyogs bzhir rig rig tu//mig phur tshugs kyis btsal cing bltas pa na//kye ma kyag kyog lam phran 'di nyid du//'dam gyi lteng ka me long bzhin bkra zhing //28

mi sdug me tog tshar du dngar ba mthong //de'i tshe rta phos tha tshig 'di ltar sgrog/khyod kyis spyang rjes bsnyegs te skyod 'di ci//rang mthong u tshugs stobs kyis dregs pa'i phyir//mdang gi bdag po'i skyel ma khyod kyis bkag/kyi hud 'dag byed dri yis yongs khyab cing //rked 'ching dmar pos dkri la goms min khyod//lam bar kha nas ma ṇi 'don pa bzhin//than thun bzlo ba'i sgra mtshams ma chad kyang //byin nus ma thon ri spyang nyid la thug/gdong yongs spu yis khengs pa'i zhabs 'bring khyod//khams 'di'i skye rgu'i rin thang shar ba dang //'brog pas slar yang rngon mda' 'chang ba dang //rngul gyi thigs par don snying ldan pa'am//dkar gsal zla gzhon smag dang bral ba'i mod//spyang gis mche ba gcigs la skrag dgos med//'dag chal dri yis khengs pa'i mgron po yis//'brog pa'i ru la bde 'jags snon pa las//'jigs dang dngangs pa'i sdug bsngal ga la ster//dpe glegs kyis ni dpyid dpal khug par 'gyur//'gro ba'i mig zung sngar las gsal bar 'gyur//29

sngon byon mkhas pa'i gser zhal mthong bar 'gyur//rgyu mtshan de'i phyir nga yis yang dang yang //sbyang mi rta yi rjes shul 'tshol bar rings/nyag kha brgal bas dkar po'i smug las thar//bsod zad de ni pha gir rked sgying sgas//bkres pa'i glal ba byed bzhin 'gro tshul las//slad mar rngon mda'i kha nas 'bros thar gyi//glags shig 'tshol las thabs gzhan dben pa mthong //

rab rgyas pa sangasakhyam no thang /bod ljongs byang phyogs sngo ljang rtswa thang dbus//khrag ltar dmar ba'i ma no thang zhig mchis/khyade ni mi brtan g.yo ba'i me lce bzhin//rgyang ring sa 'dzin lham mer gsal bar byed//chem chem 'phro ba'i khrag rgyun thigs pa bzhin//zags pas me tog 'dab ma cung zad dmar//de las rang byung khams kyis 'jig rten 'di//khrag dang bcas te thog mar bskyed pa dang //ri dang rgya mtsho sbrel ba'i lte thag gam//ma bu phral ba'i rog ma bcad pa dran//dung dang 'gron bu'i brag dang rba rlabs sam//byu ru'i nags dang rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs las//gyes shing bskal brgyar nying mtshams sbyar bar brten//chu gter klong nas rngam brjid ri bo brnyes//bod ljongs byang gi las thogs rgya rigs dang //31

de ru skyes pa'i bod rigs na gzhon tshos//blta bas mi ngoms lo rgyus bstan bcos la/dga' bzhin mdog legs ma no gzigs mor bshams//lo ngo stong gi mi bzad rmongs pa yis//gzir bas 'tsho byed zungs khrag bskam la nye//bcu phrag gcig la sgyu ma'i rmi lam gyis//bslus pas lus sems sdug cing bsngal byas pas//da phan gcod byed rno dbal gri gug gis//da dung lte thag rbad de gcod ma nus//de phyir 'a cag dge legs nyer 'gugs pa'i//g.yas 'khyil dung bzhin skam mtsho snol ba'i gzhir//'greng nas rlabs dang 'jug ngogs la gyes te//chu gter ma las ri rab bslang bar 'dod//'a cag dmar ba'i mdangs ldan ma no bzhin//yangs pa'i thang la 'jam pa'i gdan bting nas//sbrum ma'i skye g.yog las la brtson pa dang //lo mang thal ba'i lte thag rengs po de//rno dbal gri yis rab bcad mtshungs med kyi//tshe srog bskyed pa'i nyin mo bsu bar 'dod//bod ljongs byang phyogs sngo ljang rtswa thang na//32

dmar lam lam gyi ma no thang zhig mchis//mchan 'grel/durab rgyas pa sangs ( 1935 ) yun nan zhing chen bde chen rdzong bi mi yin/ 1951lor bcings 'grol dmag la zhugs/ 1956lo nas bzung rgya yig lam nas snyan ngag rtsom pa'i 'go tshugs shing skad grags rim gyis che bar gyur/ da lta krung go rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi khongs mi dang / yun nan zhing chen rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa'i 'gan bzhes/②ma no zhes pa ni rdo rin po che'i rigs shig ste/ bod yig tu de la ma na hol rta klad ces bri med/ 'dir brjod bde phyir kha skad kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin no//

dmag rta'i bstod glu/snying 'jags mtsho mo mgul nas phar skyod dus//zla gzhon shar gyi ri bo'i phrag la 'phags//slar yang mtsho 'gram brgyud nas phyir log tshe//gsar tshes zla 'od g.yu yi mtsho mor lhung //dmag mi'i bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i slad//nyin mtshan dbyer med ring du bskyod pa las//khyod nyid bsnal cing 'thengs par gyur pa la//snying la tsher ma zug 'dra'i sdug bsngal bskyed//sems kyis ma bzod byil byil byed bzhin du//bzod gsol zhus kyang ci mi snyam pa ltar//bdag po'i las 'gan dus las mi yol phyir//rgyug pa'i gom kha sgyur mtshams bzhag ma myong //nyin dang mtshan gyi go mtshams mi 'byed par//bdag por dpung gi sdong grogs byed pa'i ched//rang gi shugs dang 'gros kyi rtsal sprugs nas//g.yul gyi me dpung du ma zhi bar brdzis//mtshungs med snyan pa'i grags pa mang thob kyang //34

nga'o snyam pa'i nyams dang che tshis med//gzengs su bstod pa'i gzigs bzos bstod tshig sogs//ma lus bdag por 'bul ba'i rang gshis ldan//nga yis sems nas nongs shing 'gyod pa'i mthus//khyod la rdab gsig nyung tsam gtong bsam yang //dgra yi zon brda 'byor bas do dgong yang //slar yang 'o brgyal mi gtong ka med gyur//gal srid g.yul gyi go skabs 'chor ba na//smra med sdug bsngal chen pos non par 'gyur//le bar nyis brgya phar tshur skyod dgos kyang //mu tig sa la brdabs pa nyid dang mtshungs//rgyang ring lam du mgo bo yar bteg cing //gdeng tshod lhun po bzhin du rab brtan pas//rkang 'og sprin smag 'thibs pa'i mun grog dang //rgyab steng phreng 'brel ri bo'i gzugs ris 'char//dmag rta'i sgal rgyab rngam gnag ri rgyud bzhin//dus bzhir phun tshogs 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur//gangs rlung 'bras gro me tog shing tog sogs//smug sprin gseb kyi gan mdzod nang du gtams//35

grangs med lo zla'i skyid sdug res mos su//khyod kyi rgyab tu nyams su rol bar byed//dgun gyi grang ngar dang ni dbyar dus kyi//tsha ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad skyid du sgom//mtsho yi gru gzings sa steng rlangs 'khor sogs//gang dang gang la smon pa ci la 'chor//ri klung kun tu bar bgegs yod na yang //mig pa'i me tog ras su 'dor ba med//

bskal bzang rdo rjekhyarma chen gangs ri'i mtshan snyan/rma chen gangs ri'i mtshan snyan lasakhri'ispam mtho zhing gzi dpal ldan pa'i sbas don mtshon/de ni bla na mtho ba/ gtsang zhing dag pa/ gzi byin 'bar ba'i dper mtshon yin/shar phyogs kyi gling phran dang nags tshal/nub phyogs kyi khrom sung dang pho brang /snying 'jags kyi lha khang dang mchod khang /mkhas dbang gi brtsams chos dang bstan bcos/dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun dang gtam rgyud/lo brgya stong gi ring la khyod kyi mtshar ba'i gshog 'dab kyis phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi sge'u khung rdeb/lo zla ring mo'i smyu gus khyod kyi skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i grags snyan brjod/rma chen gangs ri'i mtshan snyan/khyod kyi snying rje'i zhags pas ma zin pa'i mtho sgang gi mi zhig yod dam/mi rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i lha sgrung la brten nas khyod kyi rnam thar brjod/shar phyogs kyi gnam mtha' las dngul mdog gi ri phran stong phrag dang /g.yu mdangs ldan pa'i mtsho dang mtshe'u/ kha dog bdun ldan gyi 'ja' gur 37

rim par sa la lhung /khyod ni bskal ba du mar 'di ru gnas bcas / lo rabs mang por 'di la zhe chags/satum drag sazhung drang / brtson 'grus ldan pa'i mi rigs shigakhyod dang lhan du lo rgyus kyi bshul lam ring mo 'grim/rma chen sangs ri'i mtshan snyan nor 'dzin bu mo'i gdong la bzlos/de nas bzung 'dzam gling gi yang rtser nyams med kyi gzi dpal 'bar/rma 'bri'i 'byung gnas 'od snang du mas khyab/'gying stabs bar gyi nyams snang mig sga gsos su smin/khyod kyi mdzes sdug la chags pas/'dab chags sna tshogs khyod kyi drung du bcar/khyod kyi gzi dang/la gyis bkugs pas/kha ba can gyi 'brog pas khyod la bstod glu len/e ma/ sgyu rtsal gyi do ra'i nang na nyams pa med pa'i gnas brtan khyod/e ma/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus na lhang nger gsal ba'i spyan gsum gyi bdag po khyod/rma chen gangs ri/ dga' gus kyi 'dun ma yod tshad 'dus pa'i mtshan snyan/a myes rma chen/ kun gyi rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'jo ba'i mtshan snyan/ngag rgyun dang lha sgrung yod tshad las/yid 'gyur gyi ro mngar ngang gis 'thul/khyod kyi mtha' 'khor ni sku srung gi sbra gur yin/gangs phran sum brgya drug cu'i sgar brang 'di la btab/38

lha srin dregs nga chig stong lnga brgyas bskor/cang shes rta dang g.yab 'byong zhol chen sogs/rlung bi gshog thogs 'phur ba'i shusas 'chang bzhin/gangs sbal gyis ni dbyar dgun rnga gsang 'khrol/dngul dkar mdangs ldan shwa ba yer mo lding /gong mos nyin mtshan dus drug thun brda gtong /ngag rgyun na nyi mas da gzod khyod kyi 'khrungs skar dang mtshan snyan shes zer/dgu tshigs rlabs kyi phreng bas da bzod khyod kyi dga' ba'i 'dun ma shes/skabs rer khyod kyis 'khu ldog byed pa'i tshe/—gangs nyil bu yu ga 'tshub cing / sprin rlung sga mda' mdung dkrigs/skabs rer khyod ni zhi 'jam 'dzum bag ldan//sbrang char zil mas ne'u gsing gzhi la nu zho bsnun/sgyu rtsal pas khyod la dung sems tshad med bcangs nas/khyod kyi 'gyur med brjid nyams ris su phab/khyod kyi chas gos ni dkar cing dri mas dben/khyod kyi snyan dbang la skar ma'i rna long spras/phyag tu spyan ras 'dzum pa'i ral gri 'dzin/rked par smra shes pa'i mda' gzhu 'chang /khyod ni dpa' ngar ldan pa'i srung ma yin/rma stod yul khams khyod kyis skyong bar byed/dgun gyi kha bas khyod kyi sku phung 'khrud/zhogs pa'i mtshams sprin mdangs kyis zhal ras mdzes par brgyan/39

rlung 'tshub ni khyod nyid thang chad pa'i skabs su bslangs pa'i rdul smig yin/khyod kyis mgo bo bteg ste mkha' dbyings snying 'jags yin min rtogaganam rdib sa gas ni khyod nyid mi yul du 'byon pa'i rkang sgra yin/rin chen gter brgyas khyod kyi don lnga snod drug grub/ngo mtshar ba'i gzhi rgyu ni khyod kyi nus tshad kyi gan mdzod yin/mes rgyal gyi mdo dbus mtho sgang la khyod kyi byin rlabs kyis snang srid zil gyis non par gyur/mchan 'grel/dubaskal bzang rdo rje ( 1936 ) mtsho sngon zhing chen khri ka rdzong gi mi yin/1951lor bya bar zhugs/ srid kyi bya ba gnyer bzhin rgya yig gi lam nas snyan ngag mang po brtsams pas ming grags rim gyis 'phel/ snga phyir krung go rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mthun tshogs kyi u yon/ krung go rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi khongs mi/ krung bo grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/()rma chen gangs ri zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen mgo log khul khongs na yod pa'i gangs ri chen po zhig gi ming ste/ ming gzhan rma chen sbom ra yang zer/ bod kyi lha chen bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan zhig yin skad/40

gug pa'i 'brong rwa/'khyil 'khor byed pa'i spom ra'i rtse mo de/gdod ma'i dus nas 'di ltar gyen gug byas/rwa rtsa gser nag gi phub dang mtshungs/rwa rtse rno dbal gyi mdung dang 'dra/gangs ri'i yab kyis gna' rabs kyi phub de bsnams nas/nam mkha'i dbyings su skar ma'i 'phra tshom btab/gangs ri'i yum gyis gdod ma'i mdung ring spras te/g.yu yi rlabs phreng 'phyo ba'i ri klung srung zhing 'tshos/dka' sdug khrod du rnam shes kyis brag ldebs gtor nas 'tshol zhib byas/sngo ljang gi brtse 'dang nang du lhad med kyi rkang rjes thog ma btod/nam mkhas de la tog mthon po'i zhwa mo skyes su gnang /'phags ma'i sngo ljang dkar dmar gyi rdzing bus chu gnyer gyi mdzes ris btab/'khu ldog gi dbang gis de snga'i gsang nor ras su bor/sprin gyis bsgribs pa'i ri lung gi ltag rgyab na 'brong mgo skam po zhig 'dug cing /khyod kyi ched du gyen la gug cing 'khyogaganam sngon po'i ches gna' bo'i dus stong ni rang nyid mdzes byed kyi rgyan du bkod/41

'jig rten gyi dus gsum pa'i nam 'phangs dma' drags song khyade ni 'tshol zhib kyi gangs rgyud ring drags pa'i rkyen gyis so//gzi rngam ldan pa'i 'byong rwa de bar stong 'di ru gug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/sangs rgyas kyi sku ris btab pa'i brag rdos kyang smra bar mi spobs so//bdud 'dre 'dul bar gug med kyi mdung ring de nyid bteg myong ngam/rdzu bag ldan pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis lha yi rdzing bur sku khrus mdzad cing /gna' bo'i phub chen 'di yi 'thab glu gyer ba'i tshul ni/zhi la'i lha sgrung ring mo yis kyang brjod kyis ga la lang phrides ni khu sim por gnam sngon po la dus rabs gcig gi snol skor mdzad/gzhu gug la byol nas sngo ljang sga mtsho rlung 'tshol snyeg dang /'gag sgo brgal nas tshe srog gi dwangs gtsang srung 'dzin byas te/gangs ri'i 'khyags grang dang rtswa ldum skam po'i smre ngag 'khyur mid byas/ri tshogs kyi skal rgyab la 'dzeg nas/dus gsum pa'i phugs re bsdogs shing de rang yo 'khyog med par byas/re thag chad pa'i rjes kyi 'gro lam ni sprin gseb nas phyogs bzhir brkyangs/sdug bsngal myangs rjes kyi dri bsung ni lhun chags shing pha mtha' yas par gyur/rngam sprin ni gug 'khyog gi rwa rtse ded nas yal bar gyur cing /gna' mtsho'i tshwa chu mtha' dag lhag med du btung /gser dang dngul dkar gyi dus rabs dang gyes pa'i tshul ni/42

gzhu zung bis rlan gsher gyi 'ja' tshon sa la 'phangs pa dang 'dra/thang stong du me yi glo snying sbar bar byas/rwa zung g.yo zhing 'khor nas thong gshol du sprul cing /nam mkha'i sa gzhi sngon po ldog rmos byas te/sngo ljang gi 'dun ma legs po'i sa bon btab/gug cing 'khyog pa'i rwa co zung gis/bung ba'i gshog sgro reg cing 'phrad par byas/gug cing 'khyog pa'i phub kyis bdag med kyi rmi lam khugs shing /de nas bzung grog chu phra mos skyo ngag gi glu dbyangs gyer/de rang me mda' phog nas 'gyel don ci yin nam/khrag rgyun sngar nas bzhur tshar cing rlung gis zad/'dzam gling gi dus gsum pas khyod rang rgyan du spras mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/'on kyang gangs ri snga mus bzhin zhu ma nus/de'i mgo skogs ni gson po'i dus las kyang che zhing brling /rwa zung gis khu nu ri bo'i g.yang ṭi'i pho brang brtsigasakhyaskar ma sme bdun gyis 'jig rten gyi le bda' khur cing /gyen la 'khyog cing gug pa'i rwa rtse 'tshol zhing rtogagangs lha'i 'dab ma zum zhing / ri sgang gi dpyid dpal yal bas/sngo ljang gi 'dab ma dang brag rdo las gzhan ci yang lus ma byung /43

de na skar ma thar thor tsam las gser gyi rlabs phreng ngam/mkha' dbyings su ldog rmos byed pa'i srog ldan mtshar bo dag mthong ma byung /de rang 'gyel rjes kyi rwa zung ni/thang stong du 'dam dang bye mas phyed tsam bsnubs/mtsho chur phyed sbangs byas pa'i rlabs phreng sgas/da dung gdod ma'i rtswa 'dab gsum ma bldad bzhin 'dugarwa rtse ni sprin la zug pa'i dga' 'dun yin/gug 'khyog ni rgya mtsho chen po'i 'khon sems yin/gna' rabs gsang ba'i lo rgyus kyi shul rjes bsnyegs pa na/glag khyis rgyun bzhin 'bab pa'i khrag dri mnam shes pa tsam du zad/des khu sim par lhun chags kyi ri tshom lder bzo byas/gna' rabs rī ma'i glang 'dzing ra bar ngu dgod rgyag pa dang lpaglang 'dzing pa'i rnam shes de glang khrag dang mnyam du rgyug tshe/des hi ma la ya'i ri rtser nyi ma'i rdzi bo byed bzhin mchis/de'i lto ba'i rtsid pa ring mo des/dus gsum pa'i smug phyi'i thig gi rtsibs 'phro bkag cing khyardza chu ring mo'i stod rgyud kyi gro snye'i rlabs phreng g.yo la/yar klung gtsang po'i le dbar stong gi sems par drod khol bskyed/de yi tshe srog sgas nga tsho la 'jam mnyen gyi dbyangs 'gros phab/44

'o zos lo ngo re rer bkra shis bde legs kyi smon 'dun bskyil/de tshe gna' rabs zhi la'i lha sgrung ring mo'i nang du ma zhugs kyang /pa pi lun gyi bstan bcos nang du mig 'og gi sa rdul 'thim yang srid do/khyamachan 'grel/()'jig rten gyi dus gsum pa zhes pa ni sa gshis lo rabs nang nas gsar skyes rabs nang gi rabs shig bi ming ste/ de ni lo khri4500yan chad nas khri1600bar gyi dus de la bstan pa yin zer/0yizhi la zhes pa ni ko ri se ste yo rob gling gna' bo'i rgyal khab cig gi ming ngo //dukhu nu ri bo zhes pa ni shin cang / bod ljongs/ ma tsho sngon bcas kyi khongs na yod pa'i ri rgyud chen po zhig gi ming ngo //②'o ma 'i glang 'dzing ra ba zhes pa ni gna'i dbyi ta li rgyal khab kyi grong khyer rī ma zhes 'bod pa de ru glang 'dzing ra ba zhig yod de/ de ru glang rgod po la 'dzing nas gsod pa'i srol gna' nas da lta'i bar du yod do//༷smug phyi'i thig ces pa ni tshan rtsal gyi tha snyad cis ste/ de ni lin 'od dang ying 'od dngos rdzas la 'od 'byin par byed cing / mkha' rlung brtol thub la shel brtol mi sbyadro pa/ nad 'bu gsod pa'i nus pa ldan pa/ mig la gnod pa'i glog sdud rlabs shig la ()pa pis lun zhes pa ni gna'i pa pi lun rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa grong khyer gyi ming ste/ gna'i ya gling sa khul gyi tshong las dang rig gnas ches dar la drag pa'i gna' shul grags can zhig yin skad/ gnas de da lta dbyi rag rgyal khab kyi khongs su yod do//45

a le5kyeri tshogs sam yang na rang nyid la phul ba'i bstod tshigagacigang rang ri bo'i rtse ru bsdad pa na/rgyang ring gi rlung ni tshe srog sga char rgyun las byung ba tshor/sa gzhi ni g.ya' dag pa'i dbyings su khro nyams kyis lding 'khor brgyab/brag ca phyogs bzhir mched/kha nang du 'thul ba'i ze tshwa'i ro ni 'das pa'i dus las byung ba shes/'das pa'i dus nyin ni rngam 'thug pa'i ri bo'i grib gzugs kyi nang nas skyed pa skur cing / yig 'bru 'di dag bris/rmi lam/ gro nas/ tshwa gzhas/ zangs lcags/ da dung dus bzhi'i zam pa dang rlung khrod kyi sdong lo ri rtser bsdad nas/ ngas mgo bo pus mo'i bar du bcugarlung gis bskul pa'i dus kyi char rgyun ni nga yi sgal ba'i/bar du gtams/e ma/ chu klung 'khyom sgra sgrog 'gro lam phyir 'khor brgyab/'on kyang ngas lam 'gro byung dang ma byung gi dbye mtshams gsal bo ma rnyed do//46

gnyis/da lta/ nga rang gcig pus/ri tshogs kyi rba klong gis nga rang khengs par bya'o bsams/nga yi rkang bol te/ba so'i mdangs dang 'dra ba'i rkang bol ni snol zhing 'dzing pa'i sdong rgan gyi rtsad par gyur/bskal ba ya thog nas rtsub cing mnyen pa'i lag pas nga rang ba mdzo gnyis kyi sko bar du bcings pa'i shing gshol zhig tu bzos/sa nang du btsugs pa na gru skya chu nang du btab pa dang 'dra bar/gangs chu'i dwangs bsil rgyun gyis bran pa dang /rtsi gsher 'dus pa'i rtsad pa mang po dang /thong gshol skyor ba'i lag pa ni rgas pa nas gzhon sha chags par gyur pa dang /lo dus kyi 'khyir rgyun la skya ba btab nas nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags pa bcas tshor/'on kyang gshol mgo ni da dung snying 'jags kyi grog rong na lus 'dugagrog rong gi bser bu 'di nas brgyud de/du ba dang kha rog gi lam du 'khyer ba ni/khal ma'i ru bas sug rjes lam la bzhag pa dang /rgyud 'dzin gyi skyes mas rang nyid kyi phugs 'dun nga tsho'i sems su bzhag pa dang mtshungs/47

e ma/ sgra med 'ur med kyi skyes ma khyu zhig gis nga'i mtha' bskor te/mchi mas mig mtha' bran par byas pas/ ngas kho mo tsho'i bzhin ras gsal bo mthong ma nus/kho mo tsho'i bzhin ras ni ma yum grangs med kyi bzhin ras gcig tu bsdus pa nyid de/kho mo tsho'i 'dar ba'i skad sgra dang mdzub mo ni bung ba'i gshog 'dab deb dang 'dra/da dung sngon byon mkhas pa mang pos nga yi mtha' bskor/sa paṇa gyis nga'i skor gyi legs bshad cig brtsamasakhyagling ge sar gyis kho yi mthu stobs ni nga las byung bar 'dod tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos nga la phul ba'i mgur dbyangs bzhengasagyiphug ron khyu zhig gis nga la nyi 'od kyi gser skud 'then/lha mo tshos nga la bstod tshig gi lwa ba bzos/gsum/e ma/ dbyangs rta zhig dbyangs rta zhigargya mtsho'i rba rlabs dgung la 'phyur ba'i dbyangs rta zhigagana' mi'i ngag rgyun na ri bo zhig la lha'i lung bis zin pa'i bras ngos shig yod zer/ ngas rang nyid kyis rgyun 'don byed pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos gnyis khyer nas mjal bar phyin cing /48

de las lhod bas dang blo skyed cig 'thob par 'dod ngag rgyun la byin rlabs thob pa'i mis nam mkha'i dung sgra thos par 'gyur zer/(de ni 'jis rten khyon gyi skad sgra thog ma dang / 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i mtshungs med bdam/sa ngag cis red/〉dmar ba'i khrag ni lo rabs khri stong bar du bzhur nges yin pa thos/gza' gcig gi sngon la/ nga rang 'bar khams kyi rang khyim dukhyadage rgan zhig dang lhan du mi'i rigs dang mi rigs skor bgro gleng byas/mngal sbrum pa'i lcam mo dang lhan du tshe srog dang dga' 'dod skor gleng mol byas/dus da lta rang nyid gcig pur/ char ba sbrum pa'i ri gseb kyi sa srod dang nged gnyis bgro gleng byas/sprin nag thur tu dpyangs/ khu yug dman 'phur byed/sbrul gyis gya ma gyur sbrul gyi bzo lta 'chang ba ni chu rgyug pa dang 'dra/de ni don gsal cing mtha' mi rtogs pa 'i skad brda zhig red//bzhi/mtsho ni sngar bzhin kha rog ger sdod cing /sngar bzhin gsar skye'am rgyad pa'i bsam rgyar 'tshud//yod tshad snying bi dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i mtsho dang mtshe'u nas maso tshugs/ngas ni na chung skabs kyi 'gram pa'i nag btsog bkrus pa tsam yin/dug khab bzhin du ro ze'u nang du zug pa ni sngar bzhin ri dwags kyi sha khu yin/ngas 'tsho skyong byas myong ba'i mdzo g.yag dag sngar bzhin tshwa la dga'/49

de tshos kha rog ger dran pa rab rib dag ldad bzhin 'dugade tsho la skad cha snyan po phyir skyugs pa'i mchu so yal zin/bska zhing lan tshwa'i ro ni brag rdo las zags pa'i ba tshwa dang mtshungs/nor bu gling bi grags pa 'ba' zhig sngar bzhin gzi dpal ldanakhyakhyod kyi stag shar gzhon nu lta bu'i lha pho kye/khyod kyis rmi lam du skyes ma 'khor chog zer/khyod kyis seng ge ring du thal song zer/khyod kyis mtsho chab cis kyang sngo zhing dwangs dgos zer/nga ni mtsho 'gram du sdong phran rnams dang lhan du 'greng /khyod kyis mi'i mig 'bras ni rab rib tu gyur kyang /mtsho ni cis kyang sngo zhing dwangs par rigs zhes smras pa thos/mtshan mo'i smag nang du rbab chu ni ha yang gi sgo glegs shig dang 'dra bar/sra zhing mkhregs la 'jam zhing mnyen/de'i 'od mdangs ni tho rangs gzhan zhig gi 'od mdangs red//lnga/yang na nga ni sngar bzhin kha rog ger sdod//nga ni nga rang yin/nga ni nga rang yang min te/nga'i spun zla/ nga'i dga' grogs yin/50

nga'i bu phrug nga'i nye tshan yod tshad yin/nga ni ri lung nang gi yul mi ste/grong sde der skyes pa'i yul mi dang 'dra ba'i spun zla'i khrod du rkang tshugs pa yin/nga ni nga rang yin pa'i tshe na a phas nga la btags pa'i ming de spyad/nga ni nga rang yin pa'i skabs su ming la a le zhes 'bod/de ni las dbang gis nga la gnang ba'i ming yin//drugang ni sngar bzhin kha rog ger sdod/ljon shing gi grib bsil ni nga rang srung zhing skyob pa'i brtse 'dang yod tshad dang 'dra bar lag zung yangs par rkyong /stag ma'i me tog stag ma'i me togazla lnga ba'i stag ma'i me tog lhug par bzhad song /zla lnga ba'i khu byug gis skad snyan bsgrags byung /de nas mi'i rigs kyi skyo sdug gi gtam rgyud ni brjid chags shing yid du 'ong ba dran/yal zin pa'i dus brda'i nang du yid sems 'gul ba'i ngu mo yod/kye ma/ ltag rgyab kyi chu mig cig sa ngos su brdol/mtshar ro mtshar ro mtshar ro/ngas ri tshogs kyi zur sne zhig la yun ring du bltas/kye ma/ chu mig 'gram gyi me tog da dung /51

g.ya' dag pa'i nam mkha'i 'dab chags kyi skad sgra/changs khyod tsho la rgyab gtod mi nus so//bdun/zla ba nub la nye/ nyi ma dgung la 'phags/nga ni grong sde zhig tu bslebs/rgan po zhig gis nga la mtshan mo'i grib so zhig bstan/ngas mi rnams la ri mgo'i char byol gyi sprin thang chen po bstan/nga sne len byed pa'i bud med kye/ ngas khyod kyi lus steng nas ldang ba'i 'bras brngos ma dang rnyid zin pa'i shing 'bras me tog gi dri zhim mnams byung /yul mi lags/ ngas ched du skyo sdug gi snyan ngag bris pa ga la yin/zla lnga ba'i skam zhing rnyid pa'i me tog las zla bcu bar sgug pa'i 'bras bu bzhad pa min nam/de ni mngar zhing zhim pa'i dri bsung zhig red/dpyid tha'i grong sde'i dri bsung zhig red/gnyen bsdebs pa'i mngal sbrum yod tshad kyi thig le'i dri bsung zhig red/de ni nga rang phyin myong pa'i grong sde grangs med pa de dag nang gi gcig red/ma rmos lo tog dang / ku shu dang / kham sdong gi grong sde zhigachu mig gi nang nas thon pa'i mu tig gi rlan bag dang snying 'jags ldan pa'i grong sde zhigade dag ni nga rang skye sa'i grong sde dang gnyis su med do//52

brgyad/than pa dang 'khyir rlung gis gtses pa'i grong sde zhig tu/nga yi bstod tshig 'di 'dra zhig thos byung /—mtshan mo ni rtse 'dzings pa'i bya spu'i sham lwa zhig dang 'dra/rmi lam dang 'dra/ rmi lam dang 'dra/sham lwa de gyon na kha sang rgyab tu byon pa dang /kha sang gi gtsang zhing das pa'i nags klong rgyab tu gyon pa dang 'dra/kha sang sga rlan bag ldan pa'i 'jam rlung rgyab tu gyon pa dang 'dra/grong sde de ni de'u zegs 'phyo ba'i nang du yod de/'o ma zags tshar ba'i nyal tha'i me tog bi 'dzum bu zhig dang 'dra/nags tshal yongs su brlag zin/ shwa khyu rtsa med du btang tshar/grong sde de ni nga rang skye sa'i grong sde de min 'dugabyin kyang sde zlomangs tsho bro gar la mkhas shing dga' ba ni nga rang skye sa'i grong ༵ 〉nga rdzubye 'dugaglu sgra ni rlung gis gtub cing ral bas sde mgo'i ri dwags kyi rgya bsdams pa'i brda tho dang 'dra/

dgu/nga yi mgo bo/ nga yi brang khogachu shel gyi rdza bum zhig dang dben zhing stong ba'i grog rong zhig dang 'dra/ji 'dra gtsang zhing dag pa la/ bar snang du brag ca'i sgra yis khengs/nga ni btsun pa zhig dang 'dra/gtsug lag khang gi rdo gcal nas babs pa na/rgyab tu lus pa'i bzo bkod ni rdo leb steng du rdo leb mnan nas brtsigs pas/sdug bsngal zhing brtan brling ldan par snang /rlung gis de snga yod myong ba'i skra lo g.yo bar byed pa dang /khrag rgyun ni mthong mi nus pa'i rma kha zhig nas 'dzag par snang /don dam par nga ni brag rdo chen po zhig las babs/don dam par nga ni brag rdo de las logs su dgar dka' bar 'dugari 'dabs su/ skyes bu tshos gser phye 'tshag bzhin 'dugaskyes ma tshos rtsid thag brgyus bzhin 'dugargyang ring gi rgya mtsho'i nang du tshwa khu 'brub/lho phyogs kyi de'u 'bur steng du ja sdong skye/nying 'jags kyis nga rang rum la 'jug par rtsom pa'i bya sgong zhig tu sprul bar byas/54

bcu/snying 'jags/snying 'jags kyis nga yi ngu sgra ni gtsang po zhig yin pa thos/snying 'jags kyis nga yi ngu sgra ni gtsang po gnyis yin pa thos/ngas skyo sdug la glu len pa dang bde skyid la ngus/skabs der rnam shes ni glag bzhin du ri tshogs khrod du lding 'khor rgyag cing /so skye srog chags mang po sgra med tshor med du skyod pa thos/nying 'jags ni brang khog tu zug pa de 'obs rnyi nang sga dug byugs pa'i phur bu dang 'dra/snying 'jags ni rngam 'thug pa'i shing tshil zhig dang 'dra bar/nga'i 'tshum mi 'dod pa'i mig lcibs 'byar bar byas/nga ni gnas 'di ru/slar yang skye ba blangs/ltag rgyab na yod pa ni dben zhing 'jags pa'i kha ba dkar po dang /mdun na yod pa ni gsal zhing 'tsher ba'i mun nag red/kye ma/ gnam sngon pos nga la ches yid du 'ong ba'i skad brda zhig dus nam zhig la sbyin par byed dam/bcu gcigang ni men hran ri bo'i rtse ru 'greng kṣagatsang po thams cad lag pa chen po brkyangs pa dang 'dra/55

sa gshin po dang de'u zegs dag 'gag 'phrang bi kha ru spungs/sna ngos char ba rgyang ring du sim sim 'bab/'on kyang nga ste a pa'i bu ni shi tshar 'duganga'i gdong la lhun chags kyi kher rkyang gi mdog cig gis khengs 'dugachang ni ri tshogs dang rang nyid kyi glu ba zhig yin/nga yi mchu ni mchu mang po zhig dang sbyar myong /ma rtogs pa'i 'ur zing dang dri med kyi bde 'jags dang 'phrad myong /ngas gtam mi smra/ngas ri phug gi chu mig brgyud nas gtam brjod byed/thog ma'i tshig sbyor ni 'khyags klung gi lce rtse'i dwangs bsil gyi thigs pa de yin/nyi 'od/ bya skad/ me tog gi ze'u 'bru/ thig le/ 'o ma/thigs pa de ni dngos po de dag thams cad yin/nga ni rdo ru 'gyur zin/ der brten/ngas glo bur du don gyis stongs pa'i ming tshig yag po de dag yang bskyar 'bod mi srid/ngas rlung gi dpung ba brkyangs nas/lag pa ste thang chad cing dpyang dka' ba'i lag pa de 'phur 'phur byed/mchan 'grel/()a le ( 1959 〉 si khron zhing chen rnga ba khul 'bar khams rdzong gi mi yin/ rgya yig gi lam nas snyan ngag dang sgrung gtam mang po brtsams pas ming grags che/sgrung gtam (sa snying rdul 'jags 〉zhes pa la ma'o tung bya dga' thob/0yis paṇa zhes pa ni sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstan/56

()gling ge sar zhes pa ni bod kyi ngag sgrung ring mo'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo gling ge sar rgyal po la bstan/mtsho'i sdus /ngas dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes pa ni rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya ()'bar khams zhes pa ni si khron zhing chen rnga ba khul khongs kyi sa cha zhig gi ming /()nor bu gling zhes pa ni gzi tsha sde dgu'i lung pa nang bi gnas shig gi ming /cig gi( rdotram̐ na hran ri bo zhes pa ni si khron dang kun su'u sa mtshams na yod pa'i ri rgyud

snying nas phul ba'i bstod tshig—pa gling 'gran rtsal me son sdud mkhan zla ba g.yang 'dzoms la phul bakhyang tshor 'dris shing rgyus mnga' che la snying du sdug pa'i 'bras ldan dus//mtho sgang mtshan mor sbrang char 'jo zhing gangs kyi 'dab ma g.yo ba'i tshe//gnyan chen thang lha'i dbu rtse de ni sngar las gzi byin che bar gyur/phrirmi lam 'phrul gyis phyin pa'i nyin mo dkar gsal drod khol 'dzoms par gyur//nyin byed 'od ni 'dzam bu'i gser dang me son sdud pa'i bu mo yi//thod pa'i mdzes sdug yon tan bzhin du dri bral lhad med rang gshis ngom//kye kye zla ba g.yang 'dzoms khyod kyi mnyes gshin gcen gcung spun zla tshos//khod snyoms zhing du btsas ma rnga zhing 'o ma'i mar gsar len sgang 'dir//khyod kyis nga tsho'i rmi lam 'phrul gyi sngo bsangs stod g.yogs dor byas te//kha ba ri ba'i 'dren byed yul dang dpal dkyil khab kyi dbus 'gyur ram//yang na 'byams klas ya shis ya yi gzigs mo'i lam du byon pa mtshar/khro)'jam po'i rlung gis yang zhing srab pa'i smad gos sham sham g.yo bar byas//gnag snum skra cog gnam lcags btums pa'i mun stug sprin tshogs bsdus pa bzhin//krung go'i me son sdud byed yo chas gor ma'i dbyibs la 'gran pa de//dri med chu shel me long las grub phugs bsam me tog bzhad dang mtshungs//nyi ma'i 'od dang drod khol sdud pa'i gces 'os pha yul nor 'dzin te//nyin byed dbang bor nye zhing nye ba'i gnas 'dir nga yi ma yum tsho'i//58

bu mo dang ni nga yi spun zla'i gcung mo khyod kyis me son gyis//phyag bi ngo mtshar dpal 'bar de nyid gzhi nas zhugs la sgron par byas//me son sdud mkhan khyod kyi phyag bi tsha tsha 'bar ba'i me lce de//tsha zer can las nye bar 'byung yang tsha zer can las gzi dpal 'bar//'jig rten 'di ko'i lta byed zung zhig krung gos rab tu gsal bar byas//me son sdud mkhan bu mo khyod ni 'dzam gling yang rtser 'greng ba na//ri tshom g.yo ba'i sgra yi bang rim lhung lhung shar la 'bab pa yi//chu klung bzhin du rang sgra 'gags med sngar las gsal zhing che ba bzhin//mchan 'grel/༷zla ba g.yang 'dzoms ni bod ljong lha sa'i mi yin/ pe cin du ya gling lus rtsal 'gran tshogs sdud pa'i skabs su 'gran tshogs de'i dpal 'bar gyi me son ni zla ba g.yang 'dzoms kyis bod kyi ri bo grags can gnyan chen thang lha'i 'dabs nas bsdus pa'o//yiganyan chen thang lha zhes pa ni bod kyi ri bo chen po zhig gi ming ste de ni bod ljongs 'dam gzhung rdzong khongs na yod do//dhiya shis ya zhes pa ni ya gling gi ming ste/ dbyin yig ltar na ya gling la ya shis ya zhes 'bod pa'o//59

khrang yo/rjosnying rje'i gru gzings/gcig byams pa dang 'chi ba/de los yin/ dge sdig gi 'gran rtsod khrod du byams pa'i skyed dang sring pa ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/nga ni de 'dra'i bya spyod can gyi dran 'dod yi ge zhig yin/ngas brjed ngas kyi don mi rtogatshor med rengs pa'i ngang tshul de la'ang 'dris ma byung /ngas skabs la lar sna ma'i me tog lta bu'i mdzub gu bsgrengs nas stong ba'i dbyings su se gol gtogs pa na/na zug phog pa ni de'i brag ca red/yin na yang /tshul min pa pham nyes byung ba'i gtam zhig slar yang nyan 'dod pa'i phyir du/ngas da gzod kha byang rnying pa can gyi rol dbyangs shig 60

dkrol 'dod pa yin nam/dge dang sdig pa'i 'gran rtsod khrod du/byams pa'i skyed dang sring pa ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/gnyis/ dran yul gyi mya ngam thang /tsher ma'i gtsug tor bkrol rjes/kho rang mya ngam thang nas byon cing /rang nyid la las skal zhig slar yang thob/thang stong la rgyang lta byas pa na/gnam dpyad so khang dang gangs ltar dkar pa'i ka sdong gi steng na zhi zhing dul ba'i mda' mo zhig 'phred du nyal yod pa mthong yin na yang /nyams pa med pa'i mya ngam thang —nyams pa med pa'i sab sob kyi de'u zhig gi ltag na mdun sug gnam la ker zhing dben 'jags la shar rlung gi rol mo kher dkrol byed pa'i 'phyi ba de kho'i kha sang gi grib gzugs yin nam ci/61

nyams pa med pa'i mtho dbyings kyi bal skud 'og tu rlung 'khyir brtol cing /mda' phog ste rgya mtshor lhung ba'i khrung khrung ngam/tsha smig 'thibs pa'i tsher phung nang nas mgrin pa bsrings te/lag tu rdo chas bzung nas migs pa gshor ba'i sems can de/kho'i kha sang bi grib gzugs yin nam/nyams pa med pa'i mya ngam thang du/mya ngam thang gi nyams pa med pa'i mtshan mor/smag nang du 'phyo 'gul byed pa'i 'khyir skas sun snang gis sdod mi bzod par skar mda' bzhin yal ba'i wa dmar/'jigs pas yer nas gar bros cha med du song ba'i sre mong /'ongs na sgra med song na shul med kyi srin bya/thang nyul gyi zhum rgod/shwa bo/'od sngon po/de dag ni kho'i kha sang sga grib gzigs yin nam/ngas brjed ngas kyi don mi rtogs/ngas mgo bo phyir 'khor te ri 'gag la bltas pa na/nub kha'i nyi 'od kyi nang du mdog lnga'i sgro spus khengs/de ni dpyid kur 'bral mi bzod pa'i me tog gi dur sa dag red/62

gsum/ pha rol/de nas/ khos thos byung /khos thu sgod pa tsho'i smra ba med pa'i pha rol te/ma ṇi 'khor lo zhig byams dang snying rje chen po'i klong du 'khyir 'khor byed pa thos byung /khos gas shing zhig pa'i gzings kyis mjug mtha'i ngu sgra ring mo zhig bsgrags pa thos byung /yod tshad leb phyags byed pa'i rlung 'tshub kyis/rgya mtsho'i klong du sgron stegs bsnubs pa dang /klong 'khor dang ham pa gnyis lkog 'cham byung /pha rol gyi gnyid la ma yur ba'i dge sems de ni kho'i mi che'i phar 'gram nyag cig red/khos de ru dri mas brdzad pa'i gos nag po de phud nas/gzings mgor bzhag ste nyi 'od la bshal 'khrud byed du bcugalus yongs la khrag gis sbags pa'i rma kha de skyes mas g.yab pa'i 'jam rlung la rjen par bstan/lag pa phyir log gis ngo tsha 'gebs par byed pa'i gzhon nu ma des/gyon pa'i nang gi dri zhim khug ma de bkrol nas/kho la lus po srung byed kyi brag spos 'bul bar byed dge dang sdig pa'i 'gran rtsod kyi khrod du/63

byams pa'i skyed dang sring pa ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing /de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/de los yin/rgan po de 'jig rten phyi mar chas par rtsom pa'i tshe/de ltar bu mo dang nye tshan dag gam du bsdus te/sna nyon dang / khyod tsho 'grig po 'cham po gyis/kho ni khyod tsho'i gnyen nye dang spun zla nga'i grogs po dang bu phrug yin mizhes gsungs/bzhi/ lha tshogs/slar skyes kyi 'dzum ris ni/'chi ba las thar rjes kyi dkar gsal zla ba red/ngas 'dzum ris ldan pa'i dkar gsal zla ba delo rabs de'i nang gi rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i 'bangs mi de dag la springs par byed/ming mgo na rus med pa'i ru tsho dang /shi na dur sa med pa'i rigs tshogs de dag la springs par byed do//rta pho bdag 'dzin byed pa'i mi dang /nya dang chu srin la 'dzem pa'i mi/chang dang a rag la dga' ba'i mi/64

me phung bi mtha' bskor nas bro gar 'khrab pa'i mi/rtswa thang gso skyong dang rdzi glu gsar rtsom byed pa'i mi/gtum drag gi gcan gzan 'dul ba'i mi/nyam chung gi 'dab chags gso ba'i mi/du ba la brtag pa mkhas pa'i mi/rang byung khams chen pos gces skyong byed pa'i 'bangs mi rang dbang can/de dang de dag ni nga rang dad cing dga' ba'i yu la dam pa yin/gelha tshogs te/ lha tshogs/lha tshogs ni khyod tsho yin par nges/lnga/ lha tshogs kyi gces ma/'dzum ris de ni/nga'i snang la ma nges pa'i kha btags yin zhing /gnam sa 'brel sbyor gyi sne zur dang /tshe srog gi dpal 'bar ba'i gru'i dar shing la springs pa yin/rnam shes kyi ma ma la springs pa dang /khyod de/rtswa thang gi ma skyes a mar springs pa yin/skabs der/skar ma'i 'od kyi rol dbyangs shigaslar yang stong ba'i dbyings rim nas/65

nga la byis pa'i lus steng nas thon pa lta bu'i nu zho'i dri ngad 'thul/skya rengs kyi me tog gis/nga la dga' ba'i 'dab ma bzhad de/sa snag ṅga gsang ba'i lkugs brda 'grol bar byed/kye ma/ khyod kyis rkang rjen gyi phyi rting yar bteg nas/stegs bu mthon por phyur ba skom bzhin 'dugakhyod kyi phrag pa dang nye ba'i sa na/byis pa'i nang 'jam zhig sgo mdun gyi lcug ma'i rtse ru/dar cha zhig skyod pa nang bzhin/gna' rabs kyi mes po'i zhal lung zhig 'grel bar byedagyang ngor sbyar ba'i lci ba'i leb mo dag ni/khyod kyis lag pas bzos pa'i gzugs mtshon yi ge'i lugs par zhig redakho mos yid 'phrog pa'i mngon brjod re re btogs shing /kha phyir 'khor te khyim la log pa'i khyo bo la sprad nas/thab ku'i 'gram du nyar rtsig byed du bcug /zhungs khyod kyi ldem ldem byed pa'i smin ma ni/snye 'bru rgod pa'i gra ma dang 'dra bar mthong /khyod kyi bzhin mi 'dzum pa'i ngag bsdams ni glog sne 'phrad pa la byung ba'i 'od zlum dang 'dra ba de dran byung )mtshan mo der/ kho nyid ni khyod kyi 'khris su thol gyis bcar/khyod kyi gtsang zhing dag pa'i gzhon sha la gtad nas/66

khyod kyis re snyeg byed pa'i snyol khri la gtad nas/khyod kyi 'gyod sems med pa'i sdug 'bras la gtad nas bsgyur du med pa'i re 'dod dang yang na mya ngan de bcangs nas/kho ni 'chi ba las kyang 'jigs pa med par gyur/kho ni 'jig rten gyi pha rol du bzhud pa dang /khyod de/ lha tshogs kyi gces ma khyod kyi phyogs su bzhud/drug zhal mjal/kho rang gcig pu thang rjen du bsdad/rkang 'gram du skar mda'i hrug lteb steng du da dung gnam me'i tsha ro lus 'dugaltag rgyab tu rang byung khams chen pos zol gyis btod pa'i chu shuramenya phyis dang chu sngo'i rnam shes dganyi phen dus las phyir thon tekhronyenyi 'od 'phrul 'gyur gyi chab la snyeg cing rol bzhin 'dugade na dur sa med/bya glag gi bar snang du/zur mang ba'i rdo rje pha lam gyi 'phro thig cig drubs/de'i tshe na/ khos da gzod khyod nyid gnas ri nas 'byon pa mthong byung /mgyogs 'gro'i mig bzhi lam 'gram du thol gyis bsdad/me tog gi ze'u 'bru lhan cig g.yos te/ khyod la zla lnga ba'i dril bu 'khrol/—mi dgyes sam/ thang stong gi bdag po kye/67
