'on kyang mdun na grong sde yod dam/khos mun nag sga satam rgyud de dag dang / gser rtsis byugs pa'i g.yo khram de dgabyis sgrung de dag gsang 'gebs byed don med/khos khyod la smyos pa lta bu'i skad cig ma de nyid dpyid dus kyi grang ngar te/gdug rtsub kyi shog bu'i zhwa mo/ra bzi ba'i dbyug pa/khrag ldag pa'i byi la dang khyi mo dag yod myong pa bshad nges red/gnam 'og tu byung ma myong ba'i grang ngar mtshar po/byi'us mun nag gi mtshan mor rang lus skung byed kyi sgo glegs shig kyang gnyid las bslangs ma nus/khos khyod la bshad nges red de/ 'od snang slar 'char gyi lcug phran de'i ched du/yong nges pa'i 'dre rlung sgas mjug mthar skad sgrog pa'i bya dang nub yul gyi lug khyu gnyis lhan cig tu btsan khrid byed par 'gyur 'on kyang nar lus byung ba'i gna' bo'i ri bo gnyis kyi bar du dang thog gzhi bdag mchod byed kyi mchod khri zhig red/ston zla'i nyams snang khrod du/ skabs 'gar lha bya'i skad snyan sgrog pa thos/gangs thang du re 'gar shwa skya'i gdan zhu'i shog byang re bzhag 'dugade ni dang thog sa cha yag po zhig red 68

sa srod slebs byung /dben zhing 'jam la zhi zhing dul/thu lhad kyi bu mo'i snag nag gi rgyan 'brum ni skar 'od 'og tubasam gzhigs kyi klong la khugs shing /khengs shes byung /ngas gtong zhing 'bul nges/ngas bsgrub chog ces kho la bshad pa dang 'dra/stod phyogs nas kho la phur tshugs kyis lta ba'i dwangs gsal gyi rlabs gnyer zung las/the tshom gyi gshog 'dab slar deb ma byas so//bdun/ snying rje'i gru gzings/ra ba'i nang gi skya ga ra ba'i phyi yi rma bya/da sa de ga'i glu gzhas/de nas/ kho mos 'dzum zer zhig ston bzhin/me tog gi lam phran nas mel tshe'i khyi pho tshur bkug cing /lcang lo phrag par g.yugs nas/mgron po cha med de la lkog brda 'di ltar bstan/—desan/nga yi sga srab khyod la ster/ 69

ci 'dra red/nga yi rte'u khyod la ster/ci 'dra red/nga yi sbra gur khyod la ster/ci 'dra red/nga yi brag spos khyod la ster/ci 'dra red ji 'dra mdzes pa la srod dus su 'od 'tsher ba'i dngul gyi rna long /mi'i rigs kyi bsam shes kyi ches gna' bo'i 'thob bya/de los yin/ dge sdig gi 'gran rtsod khrod du/byams pa'i skyed dang sring ba ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing /de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/brgyad/ dag zhing /gangs thig mtha' mjug gi dngul sgang ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags pas/dgung sngon po'i dbyings kyi 'od 'tsher ba'i gling phran zhig tu gyur cing /dben 'jags kyi dbang du gyur pa'i gangs gzig ni tsham tshom gyi ngang du lus/'on kyang ri 'dabs su/ sa gzhi ni sngo ljang gi gzhong bar gyur/70

srin 'bu sna tshogs kyis de ru gshog pa rdeb cing /ma dngas sna tshogs ldan pa'i srol rgyun zhig bzo drubs byed bzhin 'duga'abrog pa phyin song / sbra gur skyas spor byas song /shul du lus pa'i thab khung dag thang chad pa'i rtswa thang la bcol/thab khung nas thon pa'i du ba sngon pos da dung skyur mdong nang gi skyur dri dang /ri dwags kyi lpags gdan steng na ldang ba'i lus drod la g.yab mo byed pa 'dra/mi cha med kyis shes mi thub pa'i grog rong zhig tu/'brog pa tshos dbyar brang btab/thu sgod kyi byis pa skra 'khyil dag ni phad byi nang bzhin a ma'i rum nas mgo bo phyir bteg ste/mdun gyi sdeb sgrig byas ma thag pa'i ru sder ce rer lta/ shwa khra zhig thol gyis g.yang la mchongs song /gzugs po ni ldem mnyen can gyi gser long phyed ka zhig dang 'dra/de nas skad cig de nyid du nyi ma'i grib so dang 'grogs nas yal bar gyur/rgyang ring nas rdzi bo zhig bi shu sgra grags byung /lte ba nas thon pa'i sgra dbyangs de yun ring por/rgyang la yal ba'i rta'i mig sgra dang chabs cig rdza ri'i phug tu brgyud cing 'khor/sgang mthon po dang lung pa dog po'i nang gi gnam la dga' ba'i 'bangs mi 'di tshos/thang ring nas 'ongs pa'i mgron po srung 'gebs byas/kho tshos rang rgyud na yod pa'i blo gshog chen po de la brten nas/71

btsan gyis gnya' 'jog byas pa'i dka' sdug dang /dbuṭa dbyung dka' ba'i gzi brjid dang ngo tshar mgo bo gtan nas ma sgur to//kye ma/ sa 'di ni rgyu 'bras kyi sems dang ldan pa'i dag zhing nyid do//dgu/ dag zhing / (tshan pa gnyis pa)'on kyang nyin mo'i ltag rgyab ni/khra lam mer 'char ba'i skar tshom red/dar ma'i rmi lam 'gugs pa'i gzhas dbyangs dgung la 'phags/sha rus kyis nyin mo'i ngal rtsol gyi 'gan yongs su grub pas/skabs der bla na med pa'i bzi gar 'khrab ma song /srubs shing dang mdong mo gnyis las/mtha' mjug gi ba so'i mdzes cha'ang yal bar gyur/chu 'gram nas/sgra med pa'i rib ma mdzo g.yag dgu cu go dgus shin tu mnyam pa'i bar thag bkyed nas/'gros dal mos sngo rog rog gi sa sgang 'phred kyis bcad/rgyang nas bltas na gna' bo'i so rdzong gi bstar phreng zhig nyug pa dang 'dra/thab khung da dung zhi med/me 'od kyis brnyas brkos byas pa'i lus pos ni/rmi lam du rang nyid kyi 'gron bu'i kha thum don med/72

phun sum tshogs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rdzas de dag ni/kho tsho'i 'ching thag med pa 'i bla srog bzhin du rjen par bton cing /mtshan mo'i 'jam reg rol bar byed/ge'atsho ba'i zhen chags ni rtag tu gnas/ rtag tu gnas 'on kyang ljang nag gi nags rdzong du/sgang nas babs pa'i stag mos g.yang gzar la gnas bcas te/kher rkyang gi sdug bsngal ma bzod par/tsher ma'i sba shing nas mchong /'khri skye can gyi sbrang tshogs kyis/stag mo'i rgyab nas tshag tshag gi me stag phyungs shing /de nas yang kho tsho'i 'khri bdag 'tshol zhing snyeg bcu/ chab khrus/kho mo ni gnyen slong la sgug pa'i bag gsar red/mtshan mo der/rgan po de'i 'chi kha'i kha chems dang /dga' ba'i lus 'brel tha ma de'i ched du/kho rang phying ba dmar po'i gdan steng du 'greng /skyes ma zhig gis bdug pa'i bsang phor bteg nas/kho'i rkang 'gram du btud de/73

dag gtsang gi bdug pa la phu yang yang btab/yod tshad la rnam par shes pa med/yod tshad la rnam par shes pa yod/ye shes kyi mig zung gis/zhi 'jam ngang /kho'i nang sems kyi 'gyur ba la brtag cing dpyad/sems kyi dar lce lhab lhub g.yo/sge'u khung gi srubs kha nas/smon lam 'debs pa'i gnam gang sum cu lhag dal bur ldang sgron stegs rgyang la chod par gyur/gdong bsus te thon pa las/khos hi ma la ya nags rdzong du/'od snang bi tshom bu zhig sbar byed kyi drag char mthong /zol 'od kyi nang du mi mngon par skyod pa ni/ma ṇi 'khor lo skor byed kyi rgyun thag khri stong ngo //khos 'di ltar lan btab byung /—6 ngas shes byung /nga yang mos mthun byung ba yin/mi gnyen bsu ba'i pho nyas/kho rang dar gyis brgyan pa'i sga steng du bskyon/lam ring mor mtho sgang 'khyags thang dang /74

rbab chu 'dril ba'i grog rong brgyud/dga' ston gyi me phung ni/nyi shar sngon du kho la ched du sbar byung /rdos brtsigs pa'i sgo 'gram zhig tu kho rang rta las babs shing /kho la ched du bting ba'i lug lpags steng du brtan por 'greng /sra zhing mkhregs pa'i gru gzings de nas/yod tshad la log lta byed pa'i 'khon sems dang /dge legs kyi dam bca' yid la bcangs nas/kho tsham tshom med par sgo srung gi lha'i mche ba las thon pa'ime lce la 'goms nas phyin/de'i rjes su/da gzod tshod med 'thung byed kyi chang phor/lhog lhog 'khol bzhin pa'i chu/lha mdun gyi mchod me dag red/bcu gcig dga' ba'i tshags yiganyams pa med pa'i mya ngam thang du/mya ngam thang gi skya rengs gsal kha ma'i skabs de la/be'u btsa' mi thub pa'i 'bri mo zhiga'akhyags pa'i steng du gcig pur nyal nas 'dug75

lhags pa shur shur ldang /lam 'di nas brgyud pa'i sdom po zhig gis/pha rol na skyabs re'i mig zung bgrad pa dang /sdug bsngal gyi mig chu'i rdog pa zhig mig mthar 'khor ba mthong /kho gcig pus da gzod mig chu'i rdog pa de'i shugs don rtogs song /gedus ran song /skye dgos pa dag cis kyang skye nges red/rgyad dgos pa dag cis kyang rgud par nges/khos tha gu'i mdud pa la bltas nas nyin mor de bklags/de na/ dngul gdub btags pa'i lag zung gis/sen mo mtshan mos brdzus pa'i ldeb ma mthug por bsnun/dam por bslas pa'i skra lo gtsub brdar byas pa las/bags kyis bsags pa'i glog me 'bar/sgron 'od sngon po mi mthong ba'i thang stong du/byis pa zhig skyes byung /'dzum shor ba'i ldom po des/nyin mo de klog bzhin/ nyams pa med pa'i mya ngam thang du lkog nyul byas/bkye ho khyod/ mya ngam thang gi dge bsnyen/ 'dzum shor ba'i sdom pokhyod ni gzhi rgyu du ma'i mched skye rdzas shig yin nakhyakhyod ni gzhi ma'i ril rdul gyi 'dus pa'i phung bo zhig yin nakhyardzas kyi 'pho 'gyur mtha' klas pa'i mun brang mdun du/76

khyod kyis sems khral byed don med la/dga' ba'ang skye don med/khyod ni bskal ba ya thog gi sngon rol sbrum mer las/skyes pa'i srin 'bu zhig yin yang sridapayang na khyod ni gna' bo'i sdings chen gyi nang du zhun mar chags shing /lha'i longs spyod du gyur pa'i 'phyo zhag yin yang srid/khyod nyid dbyang 'gyur byung ba'i tshe sngon mar dpags nasakhyashom lwa chen po'i steng gi rgyun 'dzin gyi dar chings shig bzo drubs byas/khyod kyi skye ba 'di'i rul bar sgug pa'i rus pa des/bye ma'i spang ljongs kyi 'tshar legs pa'i 'om bu dmar po zhig gso thub pa'i re ba bcol/khyod ni thog mtha' med pa'i bgres po zhig ste/ dus dang bar stong bi tshad las 'das par rigs/khyod ni thog mtha' med pa'i na gzhon zhig ste/ rdzogs rgyu med pa'i 'byung 'gyur dbang du bsgyur par rigs/khyod ni che mthong gi rten chen po 'di'i nang bi mang na mi chog panyung na mi rung ba'i sdom spyi zhig go//khyod ni rlung char thog 'brug gi gtan tshigs la mthun pa'i gdam ka zhig red/khyod kyis dus stong 'di nyid du snol sbrel byung tshul tsam slar mtshon byas par sgom pas choga'on kyang khyod ni ma mtha'ang go la 'dis dbang bo bskyed pa'i skye dngos shig 77

red la/lo zlas bsam bzhin du sbrum nas byung ba'i rol gdang zhig red/rgyud dus da dung gsang kha ma brtol ba'i nyes tshogs dang /tshe srog gi bzod shugs kyis zin tho bskrun pa de'i ched du/khyod ni blos gtang bya red la/ dbang chod mkhan yang red/khyod ni dka' thub can red la/ bde mchog gi lha yang red/red ya/ dge sdig sga 'gran rtsod khrod du/byams pa'i skyed dang sring pa ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing /de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/bcu gnyis/ bde ba'i zhing khams/dpyid kyi lang tsho dang /sbrum mngal gyi chas gnyis lhan du smin pa'i tshe/gsar du 'bus pa'i rtsi 'dab kyis dgun 'khyags kyi shun pa srab mo brtol/shin tu gtsigs pa'i brda 'phrin de ni mi'i mgo bo skor ba'i 'chal gtam ga la yin/skye dngos yod rgyar lkog gyur gyi mtshan ma mtha' med pas khyab/sa gzhi ni 'gul skyod la brten nas ri sgang yar bteg78

tshe srog bi 'od kor gyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la mdzes sdug 'gran/ma rdul gyi sdeb sgrig gis phra mthong sga khams chen po'i nang du skar rgyud cig 'grub par byasakhyartswa ljang gis kha dog sga bang rim du ma sa khar btegargang gis rno dbal gyi mda' tshom lus la g.yogs lam chen gyis me tog phreng ba'i star gral la 'khrol 'dzin ster ba'i tshe/rang ming tsam las med pa'i dpung sde zhig grib ma'i nang du sngon skyod byed/dus ran song /phyir sos dgos pa mtha' dag phyir sos pa dang /skye rigs pa mtha' dag skyes zin pa red/'on kyang khos tsher ma'i gtsug tor bkrol cing /mya ngam thang nas byon te/sbra gur re re'i phyogs su phyin/khos gangs ri dang / bsang phor/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs de dgabarjed mi thub/khos rma bya'i sgro mdongs steng gi mig 'bras mang po de brjed mi nus/kho ni mkha' dbyings de la dbang ba dang /kho ni sa gzhi de la gtogs pa red/kho ni de ga'i lag na byang bu med pa'i sku 'khor red/'on kyang ngas ni/79

sna ma'i me tog lta bu'i mdzub mo btsal nas/stong dbyings kyi brag ca slar yang bsgrags te/tshul min pa pham nyes byung ba'i 'phrin bzang thengs shig thos pa dang /de dang de'i tshul mtha' dag brjed mi srid pa red/de red de/ rtag tu/ rtag nas rtag tu/ gebyams pa'i skyed dang sring pa ni/'chi ba'i gdug rtsub las kyang gna' zhed che zhing /de las kyang dpa' ngar brgya 'gyur ldan/mchan 'grel/0khrang yo (sbra 1936 2000) hu'u nan zhing chen gyi mi yin/ 1955lo nas bzung rtsom rig gsar rtsom las la zhugs/ 1955lor mtsho sngon du phebs kyang1957lor ma nyes kha g.yogs thebs nas lo nyi shu lhag gi ring la btson khang du 'tshud/ 1979lor dkar 'don byas rjes slar bya bar zhugs/ khong ni krung go'i snyan ngag las rigs steng na ches phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa yin/60nyi phen dus zhes pa ni sa gshis lo dus 'byed byed sde tshan gyi gna' skyes bskal ba'i dus bzhi ba yin par bshad/dugazhi rgyu zhes pa ni rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i tha snyad cig ste gzhi ma'i rgyur gyur pa'i cha zhig tu go bar bshad/duril rdul zhes pa ni rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i tha snyad cig ste rdzas 'gyur gyi gzhi rgyur 'grub byed kyi sde tshan zhig la rgo/()sbrum mer zhes pa ni sbrum snod la go/rjodabyang 'gyur zhes pa ni rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i tha snyad cig ste dngos po dang 'tsho byed kyi rlung gnyis 'dres 'gyur 'byung ba'i go rim de la go bar bshad/80
pa'i :

gru'u thing khya'agyig shing la phul btang rang khyod la dga' ba yin na/rang lus gzhan la 'khyud pa'i thag 'khril me tog nang bzhin/khyod kyi yal ga'i rtse mor 'dzeg nas mtho rdzu mi byed/nga rang khyod la dga' ba yin na/dga' ba gcig la gtad pa'i co ka nang bzhin/ljon lo'i grib bsil la gdangs gcig pa'i mgrin dbyangs skyar zlos mi byed/brag srubs nas thon pa'i chu mig nang bzhin/rgyun chad med par dwangs shing bsil ba'i bde ba mi sbyin/g.yang gzar gyi brag ri nang bzhin/khyod la mtho ba'i dpang gi snon pa mi byed/ brjid pa'i rngam gyi ram 'degs mi byed/tha na nyi 'od/tha na dpyid char/min/ de tshos da dung mi chogang ni nges par du khyod gam gyi shing nā ga ge sar zhig dang 'dra bar/ljon shing zhig bi gzugs su sprul nas khyod dang mnyam du 'greng bar byed/rtsad pa/ sa 'og nas sgril bar byed/82

lo ma/ sprin rim nas phrad par byed/'jam rlung ldang thengs re rer/nga tshos phan tshun gus 'dud byed/'on kyang mi su yin yang /nga tshos skad cha'i brda mi go/khyod la khyod kyi zangs dang lcags 'dra ba'i gzhung rta dang yal ga yod/yang na gri nang bzhin/ yang na ral gri nang bzhin/yang na mdung nang bzhin/nga la nga yi dmar zhing rgyas pa'i me tog yod/ljid thag ge'i dngan pa nang bzhin/yang na rtul phod kyi dpal 'bar nang bzhin/nga tshos grang ngar/ rlung char/ gnam lcags kyi gnod pa mnyam du 'khur/nga tshos mtshams sprin/ smig rgyu/ 'ja' tshon gyi mdzes sdug mnyam du rol/gtan du so sor gyes pa 'dra yang /nam yang phan tshun bsnyes par byed/de ni da gzod rlabs che ba'i brtse 'dang yin/gtan gyi 'dun pa 'di na 'dugadaga' ba/khyod kyi gzi byin ldan pa'i gzugs po la dga' ba ma zad/khyod kyis mkhregs bzung byed pa'i gnas dang /rkang tshugs pa'i sa gzhi la dga'o/ /83

mcha/hu ༷/zlo thi/ nga (7731952— ) rgya'i deng rabs skyes ma'i snyan ngag pa grags can // ṭwāṃ/gyi/ga shing zhes pa ni tsha khul du skye ba'i ljon shing zhig gi ming ste/ de las 'gyig ces pa'i spyin mang po thon pas de skad du brjod do//

hre kong krung khyapha yul dran pa'i skyo gdung /lo na phra ba'i dus su/pha yul dran pa'i skyo gdung ni sbrag byang chung chung zhig dang 'dra ste/nga tshu rol dang /ma ni pha rol na'o//nar son rjes/pha yul dran pa'i skyo gdung ni gru byang leb mo zhig dang 'dra stekhyang ni tshu rol dang /chung ma pha rol na'o//de'i rjes su/pha yul dran pa'i skyo gdung ni dur phung chung chung zhig dang 'dra ste/nga ni phyi rol dang /a ma nang rol na'o//dus da lta/pha yul dran pa'i skyo gdung ni gting thung ba'i mtsho 'gag cig dang 'dra ste/nga ni tshu rol dang /skam sa chen po ni pha rol na'o//85
sna1928 ) the wan gyi sdod byed kyi spa se'i ming ngo

lis pe lu'u hran ri bo'i rbab chur gzigs pathaspos phor ri rtser nyi 'phros smug zer ldang /khyargyang gzigs rbab chu dar dkar 'phyang bar 'khrul//thur la rgyug cing 'bab pa'i ngang tshul ni//mkha' las dgu tshigs sa la lhung bar dogs//mchan 'grel/zhig godu// lis pe (lho 701 762) thang rgyal rabs kyi snyan ngag pa grags can khu)lu'u hran ri bo zhes pa ni cang zhi zhing chen gyi khongs na yod pa'i ri bo zhig gi ming ste yul ljongs shin tu mdzes pas grags pa che/0spos phor ri rtse zhes pa ni lu'u hran ri bo'i ri rtse zhig gi ming ste dbyibs spos phor dang 'dra bas na de skad du brjod/snying 'jags mtshan mo'i dran gdung /mal khri'i 'gram du zla 'od gsal//sa yi ba mo yin par rtog/mgo bo yar bteg gsal zlar bltas//mar la smad cing pha yul dran//87

chang 'dren pabarma klung ring mo gnam las babs//ldog med rgya mtshor 'bab pa ma mthong ngam//mtho khang me long chen por bltas/phrizhogs skra nag po do nub dung ltar gyur//mi tshe skyid dus dga' ba longs su spyod//gser phor stong ba zla bar ma gtod cig /gnam gyis yon tan bstsal pa spyad sa yod//dngul mang brlags kyang slad mar yong nges yin//g.yag lug bshas te spyod pa skyid du sgom//dgyes skyems gsol tshe phor ba sum brgya zin/khyakhrin spru tsi/ tan cig hrinaslobadrangs pa'i chang / mnyes dag gyis//grogs la gzhas shig btang ba de//khyod kyis rna ba glags te gson//rnga cong zas brgya'i ri ba mi mtho yikhyar bze dwangs pa'i go skabs med par 'dod//sngar gyi 'phags pa thams cad kher rkyang yin//myos byed spyod pa kho nas ming grags 'jog /khrin wang de sngar phing lir dgyes ston bshams/khya88

chang bum gcig la dngul sgor stong bcus brjes/khyabadag pos chang yon nyung song ma smos shig/grogs dang lhan du dgyes rol phyir du nyo//lnga ris rta pho slog pa gong chen sogs/khu)'khor la gtad nas dgyes skyems brje bar byas//lhan du 'dzoms pas bskal brgya'i skyo sdug bsang //mchan 'grel/0)chang 'dren pa zhes pa ni gna'i gzhas dbyangs shig gi ming /②mtho khang me long zhes pa ni mtho zhing brjid pa'i khang chen gyi rtsig ngor bkal ba'i me long la bstan/༷phor ba sum brgya 'dir bshad pa'i sum brgya zhes pa ni shin tu mang po'i don bstan pa tsam mo//6)khrin dru tsi/ tan rig hrin com pa po'i grogs po gnyis kyi ming ngo //0tshig 'di'i nang du bshad pa'i rnga cong zhes pa ni skabs de'i khyim tshang phyug po can gyi khyim du dkrol ba'i rol dbyangs la go/ zas brgya zhes pa ni phun sum tshogs shing rin gong mtho ba'i zas la go//du'adir bshad pa'i khrin wang ni de snga'i rgyal khab gsum skabs kyi tsha'o tsha'o'i bu tsha'o kri zhes pa de'i ming gzhan zhig go/ /thang li zhes pa ni skabs der lo dbyang na yod // pho brang zhig gi ming ste/ tsha'o kris de snga thang li pho brang du dgyes ston bshams pa'i du'adir bshad pa'i stong bcu zhes pa ni skabs de'i dngul sgor gyi grangs tshad ston pa'i ming ste/ chang bum gcig la dngul sgor stong bcu ri bar bshad do//dulnga ris rta pho zhes pa ni spu mdog lnga can gyi rta pho'i don/89

tu'u chu'ukhyahri ho grong la slebs pa'i mngag gzhuganyumatshan mor hri ho grong du brtol//mngag gzhug dpon gyis dmag 'dzin mthong //rgan po gyang las brgal te 'bros//bgres mos sgo glegs phye ste bltas//mngag gzhug dpon gyi tsha 'dri la//bgres mos mgrin pa brnangs skad kyis//bu gsum ye khreng mkhar gyi mtha'/khyabaskor cing rgol ba'i g.yul la zhugs//spun mched zung gcig 'das pa'i brda//shul lus bu yi 'phrin las 'byor//gson pos nyi ma 'khyol thabs dang //gshin po 'das log med pa'i phyir//khyim du tsha bo gcig pu las//skye bo gzhan gyi gzugs kyis stongs//lus la khebs pa'i gos tsam yang //med pas mna' ma 'gro 'ong dka'//gus mo'i lus stobs zhan na yang //dpung la g.yo bskol bya nus pas// 90

ho dbyang dmag skul dang len gyis/po)rjes 'brang g.yul sar da chas zhes//mdun phyag dang bcas zhu skad thos//mtshan ring lab sgra rab chad kyang //ngu ngag bar ma chad par dogs//nam gsal ma ran 'gro chas tshe//rgad po nyid las gyes yul dben//mchana' /zlozlo spru/ 'u (ṣṭha 712 770) thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi snyan ngag pa grags can zhig yin/6)hri ho grong zhes pa ni grong brdal zhig gi ming ste da lta'i ho nan zhing chen hran rdzong khongs na yod par grags/()ye khreng ni mkhar zhig gi ming /6)ho dbyang zhes pa ni ho nan khongs kyi rdzong zhig gi ming /91

dpyid kyi smon 'dunabargyal khab thor kyang ri klung mdzes ljongs sngar bzhin gnas//mkhar nang dpyid kyi rtswa ldum rgyas shing tshang tshing 'khrigs//dus la gzhigs pas me tog gis kyang mchi ma zags/sgo'iso sor 'bral tshe bye'u'i skad kyang gnyom zhing skyo//g.yul gyi dmag 'thab zla ngo gsum la brgyud mar bkye//khyim gyi springs yig gser dngul las kyang dkon par gyur//mgo la reg bzhin skra lo seng zhing thung ngur phyin//gzer khab yang yang btab kyang gzung du mi btub bo/khyamachan 'grel/dusnyan rtsom 'di ni thang phu'u tsung skabs su bris/ skabs der an hri'i zing 'khrug dang 'khel bas/ rgyal srid nyams shing rgyad pa'i snang tshul ji bzhin du bris so//②'di'i dus zhes pa ni an hri zing 'khrug gi skabs der bstan pa'o//dugazer khab ces pa ni gna' dus skye bo'i skra cog bi gseb tu 'debs byed kyi gzer bu ring po de'o//92

men ho ranakhyadapyid ga'i zhigs pa/dpyid kur mnal yur nam gsal rtogs ma gyur//gang sa gang la bye'us skad snyan gyer//mdang dgong rlung dang char ba 'tshub pa las//me tog ci tsam brul ba su yis rtog/mchan 'grel/dumen ho ran (rtsa /67689 740) thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi snyan ngas pa grags can zhig go//

su'u gri hru'e te'o ki thi'umi(me 'brug lo'i zla mchod dus chen dul mtshan gang bor dgyes chang tshim/ par btung zhing / ra bzi'i sgang la shar mar bris te gcung tsi yug la phul/)lanya gang zla ba nam dus yod//chang phor bteg nas gnam la dris//lha yi gzhal yas pho brang du//de ring tshes zhag du yin nam//nga rang rlung rtar bcibs nas snyeg bsams kyang //rin chen rdo las grub pa'i pho brang de//mtho zhing 'khyags pas bzod par mi nus snyam/khyabro gar 'khrab tshe rang gzugs grib mas 'grogs pa tsam//de phyir mi yi yul las lhag pa ga la yod//thog khang dmar po brgyud//ris mdzes sge'ur 'phos//mnal yar gdong la 'phros//zhe 'khon med par rigs na yang //zhal 'bral dus su nya gang 'khel//mi la dga' skyo 'du 'bral dang //94

zla bar smag sasal bri gang ste//skyid sdug res mos 'khor ba chos nyid do//mi yi sku tshe brtan gyur na//sa yis bskal kyang zla 'od mnyam rol bya//mchan 'grel/dusu'u hri ( ( sa 1036 1101) sung rgyal rabs skabs kyi snyan ngag pa grags can zhig ste/ lhag par du rgya'i snyan tshig rtsom par shin tu mkhas pas snyan tshig 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes che bar bshad/0yihru'e te'o ki thi'u zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//༷zla mchod dus chen zhes pa ni rgya'i bshad srol du zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i ma tshan mo ni zla mchod kyi dus chen yin zer skad/②'dir zla ba'i pho brang bstan pa'o//du'adir ni zla ba'i 'od rim bzhin thog khang dmar po dang de nas mdzes ris bkra ba'i sge'u khung / de nas de'i nang gi mnal ma khugs pa'i mi de'i gdong la 'phros pa'i bya rim de bstan pa'o//95

nyan nu'u cobachakhri per sngar 'das rjes su dran panyu'abri chu lhung lhung shar la rgyug/rlabs kyis bye rdo bshal cing ded pa bzhin//sngar 'das dregs ldan dran yul tsam du gyur//sgar rdzong nub kyi 'gram ngogs sume//krig lus khri pe'i g.yul 'thab bkyes par grags/60rdo dang zegs mas bar snang brtol//rba rlabs drag pos chu ngogs brdabs//gzegs ma kha ba'i phung bo 'gril dang mtshungs//ri klung mdzes ris bzhin du bkra//de'i tshe phul byung skye bo brgyud mar byon//gna' bo'i kung cin zhes pa des//zho cho khab kyi 'dun mar bsus0//dpa' mdzangs gzi byin 'bar//sgro g.yab mgo dkris sngon po can//zhal ta gnang ba'i yun tsam la//gtum drag thal ba'i rdul du brlags/khu)gna' bo'i rgyal khams sems kyis 'grims pa na//96

nyams bur langs pa khrel ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur//dbu skra dung ltar gyur la ltos/khya'ajig rten dar rgyad mtshan mo'i rmi lam 'dra//chang phor btegs nas dkar gsal zla bar mchod//mchan 'grel/()nyan nu'u co zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig la zer/ 0yikhri pe zhes pa ni de snga rgyal khab gsum gyi dus su wu'u rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon chen mo krig yus zhes pa des khri pe zhes 'bod pa'i sa char g.yul bshams te tsha'o tsha'o'i dmag dpung pham par brgyab pa'i gtam rgyud la sbyar/()sgar rdzong zhes pa ni gna' dus khri pe g.yul 'gyed skabs su btab pa'i dmag sgar dang btsan rdzong gi shul la bstan/()'dir krig yus kyis khri pe g.yul 'gyed bshams pa'i gnas de la'o//(nyekung cin zhes pa ni krig lus kyi mtshan gzhan zhig go//()zho cho zhes pa ni krig lus kyi chung ma'i ming /()krig lus kyis rgyun du lag la bya sgro'i rlung g.yab cig 'chang bar dga' ba dang /ma gor si skud sngon po'i khebs shig dkris pas na de skad du brjod do/ /'dir bshad pa'i gtum drag ni tsha'o tsho'i dmag dpung la bstan pa yin/du'adir dbu skra dung ltar dkar por gyur pa des skabs der rtsom pa po 'jon thang che la phugs bsam chen po yod bzhin du gong mas brtsi mthong ma byas par mi tshe stong zad du btang ba la blo pham pa'i tshul bstan par bshad do/ /97

lis ching krokhyayus can methachu skyes pad ma zags/ /smyug gdan rim gyis 'khyags/khro)smad sham dal gyis dor/ /gcig pu g.yor grur 'dzeg /sprin par springs pa'i 'phrin yig yod dam ci/ lpakhrung khrung tshogs rnams phyir log cing / /zla 'od nub kyi lding khang 'phos/khyame tog ngang gis brul/ /'bab chu sngar bzhin rgyug /dran sems gcig yin kyang / /skyo gdung gnyis su gyar/ /tshul 'di gzhar yang sel thabs bral/ /smin ma'i mdud pa grol ma thag /sems kyi lcags kyus slar yang bzung / /mchan①/ lis chin kro (cho gi 1084 ha lam 1151) sung rgyal rabs kyi snyan tshig rtsom pa po skyes ma grags can zhig yin/ kho mos snyan tshig la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan par bshad/0yilus can me zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//()tshig 'dis ston dus slebs pa'i don bstan la go//②'dir rtsom pa pos rang nyid kyi khyo ka thag ring du phyin pa la dran pas gdungs te kho'i 'phrin yig 'byor bar re sgug byas pa'i tshul bstan/du'adir khrung khrung phyir log pa dang zla 'od nub kyi lding khang du 'phos pa'i tshul la brten nas ston dus slebs pa shugs kyis bstan/98

lis lus5nyeyus me rinabadapyid me ston zla'i dpal yon ci tsam 'khor//rjes su dran pa'i 'das don ci tsam mchi/khyamadang dgong thog khang shar rlung drag tu ldang //zla 'od 'og tu rgyal khams bltar mi bzod//'brug ris pu shu g.yang ṭi'i rdo stegs sogs//sngar mur gnas kyang bzhin gyi lang tsho 'gyur//khyod la skyo dang sdug bsngal ci tsam mchi//dpyid kyi brug klung shar la rgyug pa bzhin//mchan 'grel/dulis yus (cho 937 978) thang lho ma'i gong ma yin/ rgya'i snyan tshig rtsom pa la shin tu mkhas/ spyi lo 975lor sung gis bsgrubs shing kho rang nyid kyang sung la mgo btags/ snyan tshig 'di ni kho rang gis sngar 'das kyi 'tsho ba rjes su dran te sems shin tu skyo ba'i tshul bris pa yin no/ /khu'ilus me rin zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhigadu'adir rtsom pa pos rang nyid yul gzhan du bzang btson thebs pas lo ci tsam 'khor ba'ang ma shes pa'i tshul bstan/②bzhin gyi lang tsho 'gyur zhes pa ni de snga'i dkar sha dmar mdangs can gyi zhal ras de skyo sdug gis mnar nas skya bor 'gyur zin pa'i don la go//99

lang tha'o photasge'u khung phyi ru char ba shag shag 'bab//dpyid kyi dpal yon nyams shing gud/mtshan gung grang ngar thul bas 'brog thabs bral//gnas skabs bde ba tsam la zhe chags pas//rmi lam nang du gzhan dbang yin pa brjed/phripu shur bsnyes nas rgyang lta ma byed cig/de snga'i mnga' ris mdzes ljongs pha mtha' yas//'bral tshe bla yi mjal dus dka'//dpyid kyi me tog 'bab chus 'khyer te thal//gnam dang sa yi khyad par 'di nyid do//mchan 'grel/()lang tha'o hra zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//②gzhan dbang zhes pa ni rang nyid sung rgyal rabs kyi 'dzin bzung thebs shing bzang btson bya yul du gyur yod pa'i tshul de bstan/100

lu'u yugadupu'u son tsittadapyid mgo'i me tog la bsngags pabarta zam sa tshigs phyi yi zam ro'i 'gram//grogs med kher rkyang khu sim ngang du gnas//srod dus gcig pur skyo bas mnar//char dang rlung gis snon pa byas//dpyid kyi dpal yon 'gran pa'i sems med pas//'dab brgya dgra ru langs pa ci la 'jigs//'dam gyis brdzis shing rdul du btul na yang //lhan skyes dri bsung sngar bzhin ldang bar nges//mchan 'grel/()lu'u yug (1671125 1210) sung rgyal rabs skabs kyi snyan tshig rtsom pa po grags can zhig yin/rku'iphu'u son tsi zhes pa rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhigadu'adi ni rtsom pa pos tshig zin la dpyid mgo'i me tog gi yon tan brjod kyi yod kyang shugs su rang nyid kyi gnas tshul brjod skad/101

tsha'o kri/gom pa bdun ma'i snyan ngagadusran ma'i skyo tsha g.yo ba dang //btsags nas ro khu 'byin par byed//slang zhabs sog ma zhugs la sgron//nang du sran mas smre ngag 'don//rtsa ba gcig las skyes na yang //phan tshun gzhol par brel 'di ci//mchan 'grel/rgyal khab gsum gyi skabs su tsha'o tsha'o'i bu tha chung tsha'o kri (myuṣṭha192 232)zhes pa de rtsom rig gi yon tan shin tu che bas/ gong ma'i srid khrir 'khod zin pa'i bu che ba tsha'o phes phrag dog byas te/ nyin zhig glo bur du nu bo tsha'o kri drung du bos te/ khyod kyis gom pa bdun tsam spo ba'i yun la snyan ngag tshan pa zhig rtsom zhig ma nus na gsad do zer/ tsha'o kris gom pa bdun spo tshun la snyan ngag 'di brtsams nas pha gcig gi bu spun phan tshun la gnod pa gtong bar sems shin tu skyo ba'i tshul bstan pas/ des kyang glo bur du sems rnyed nas gsod ma nus par grags/102

ri thang gser bye'u 'khorabaljon shing mtho na rlung gis 'tshe ba mang khyamatsho mo'i rlabs phreng dgung la 'phyo bar ltos//lag na rno dbal ral gris stongs pas na//grogs po mang du bsgrigs kyang ci la phan//gzeb dra'i nang gi bye'u ma mthong yang khyaskya khra'i rgya la dbang med 'tshud 'di skyo/lpargya rnyis bye'u zin cing thob pas dga'//gzhon nus bye'u mthong bas blo re pham//ral gri phyungs nas rnyi thag gtub byas te//gser bye'u dgung la gtong bar cis mi 'dod//mchanahu ༷sbya sdung/ gser bye'u 'khor zhes pa ni rgya'i pho brang glu gzhas shig bi ming /②lhan ngag 'di ni bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la brten nas bris pa zhig ste/ 'dir rtsom pa po rang nyid ming du grags ches na phrag dog dang gnod pa gtong mkhan mang ba'i don du go bar bshad/du'adir gzeb dra'i nang gi byi'u zhes pa ni dpe yi sgo nas gnod 'tshe thebs pa'i grogs po la bstan/②'dir skya khra zhes pa ni dpe yi sgo nas rang dang grogs po la gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan de dag la bstan no//103

zhin chi byukhyaphob krin tsibabagrogs khrin thong phur skul mar snyan tshig phul ba/(ra bzi'i sgang la sgron 'od mdun du phyir phyungs rno dbal ral grir bltas/)yid ngor dmag sgar ru tshogs dung brdas bskul bar snang //le dbar brgyad brgya'i dmag sgar phyi nang la//sha chen tshil chen sreg pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs/khro)rgyud mang sna tshogs sbreng ba'i brjid chags sgra//mtha' mtshams bar snang kun tu khyab//g.yul 'jug dpung tshogs ngar skyed gzigs mor byon//chibs pa rta rgod 'phur ba bzhin//gzhu mo bdung sgra 'brug ltar ldir//gong ma'i gnam 'og sdud pa'i bsam don sgrub dang lhan//'di phyi'i grags pa ngang gis rgyas bsams kyang //skra 'dab dkar po skyes pa 'di yis phangs//mchan 'grel/duzhin chi cis (ltozlorsā1140 1207) sung lho ma'i skabs kyi snyan tshig pa grags can zhig yin/ na gzhon skabs su cin gyi btsan 'dzul la rgol lan slog pa'i g.yul 'khrug la zhugs myong yang gong ma'i yid ches ma thob pas yon tan ldan yang phyir 104

mngon pa'i skal ba ma thob par grags/kukrophob krin tsi zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//du'adi'i don ni cin gyi btsan 'dzul la rgol lan slog pa'i dmag dpung gi sgar brang ni le dbar brgyad brgya lhag zin pa'i khyon la bkang zhing / dpon dmag re re la bsreg sha'i bya dga' thob pas dmag sgar gyi phyi nang du sreg dris khyab pa'i tshul bstan/du'adir rtsom pa pos rang nyid la rgyal khab skyob pa'i phugs bsam yod kyang gong pa/ /da ches ma thob pas mi tshe stong zad du btang bar blo pham chen po skyes pa'i tshul

wang konakhyapu'u son tsittabagrogs po ho ran kro cang shar phyogs su chas par skyel ma zhus pa/chu ni mdzes ma'i mig ris te//ri bo smin dkyus ring mo bzhin/khyalam mgron gang la chas she na/slobamig gi dpal du gyur pa'i sa la'o/dpyid kyi lha mo par la bskyal ma thag/slar yang grogs por skyel ma zhu dgos byung //gal te 'bri lhor dpyid kyi rjes zin na/khyacis kyang de dang lhan du 'grogs par bya//mchan 'grel/duwang kon (1121048 1127) sung byang ma'i skabs kyi mi zhig yin/sung grin tsung skabs su yig blon gyi 'gan khur myong skad/phunaphu'u son tsi zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//du'adir rtsom pa pos dpyid zla gsum pa'i dus kyi kro cang shar phyogs sa khul ni ri chu shin tu mdzes pa'i dper gzhon nu ma'i mig gi chu ris dang dkyus ring ba'i smin ma bkod de ches shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i tshul bstan/()'dir bshad pa'i lam mgron zhes pa ni rtsom pa pos skyel ma zhu yul grogs po 106
skyi pa'i 'bri lho zhes pa ni 'bri chu'i lho phyopa

pe cu'u dbyi dbyi cang nan9'bri lho yid du 'ong khya mdzes ljongs sngar nas 'dris/ /nyi gzhon 'phags tshe chu skyes 'dab ma dmar lam lam//dpyid kyi gtsang chab dwangs bsil sngo ljang mdangs su bkra//'bri lho rjes su mi dran su zhig mchi//mchan 'grel/dupe cu'u dbyi ( ṣṭha777na 846) thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi dngos yod ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag pa grags can zhig yin/ dma' ba yig blon nas mtho ba blon chen bar gyi 'gan du ma khur myong / phyis dregs ldan la 'gal bas dpon gnas btang ste dben pa'i gnas brtan lta bu'i 'tsho ba skyed cing snyan tshig mang po brtsams yod skad/6yidabyi cang nan zhes pa rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//la bstaX/'bri lho zhes pa ni 'bri chu'i lho phyogs te gtso cher hang krig dang su'u krig sa khul 108

pi wang 'grosajiyon ho lo bcu bar kyang ni snga ma'i dpon gnas las phab ste ci'u cang cun gyi si mar brdzangs phyi lo'i ston khar/ phun phu gtsang po'i ngogs su mgron por skyel ma zhu ba'i tshe/ mtshan mor gru gzings nang na pi wang steng mkhan zhig yod pa thos/ skad gdangs la brtags na rgyal sa khrang an gyi glu ma zhig yin tekhukhyi dmu dang tsha'o gnyis la brten nas pi wang sbyangs myong khu'i na tshod smin zhing bzhin mdangs nyams pas/ mthar tshong pa zhig gi chung ma mi byed ka med byung skad/ pha rol la chang drangs te rol dbyangs 'ga' dkrol bar zhus pa bzhin dkrol/ de nas sems shin tu skyo ba'i tshul gyis gzhon dus kyi bde skyid/ da lta phyogs bzhir 'khyams nas nyam thag tu gyur tshul sogs lhug par brjod pa na/ rang nyid dpon gnas las phab nas lo gnyis phyin kyang blo bde bag phebs ngang nyin 'da' ba la/ kho mo'i gtam thos rjes rang nyid kyang gzhan gyis smad pa'i gnas su lhung 'dug pa gzhi nas rtogs/ glu rta ring mo yin pas phran gyis kyang glu tshig 'di 'dra zhig bris nas phul cing / bsdoms pas yig 'bru drug brgya bcu drug yod cing / ming la pi wang 'gros zhes brjod do//zhun dbyang gtsang 'gram do nub mgron po skyel/khyashing lo me tog bser bu rlung gis skyod//gzhis mgron chibs bshol lhan du gru nang bzhugs//gyes chang gsol kyang rol mo'i ram 'degs dben//'bral mi bzod pa'i skyo sdug bsang bar dka'//skyo bzhin 'bral tshe zla ba chu yis brdzis//glo bur gtsang 'gram pi wang sgra thos pas//109

gzhi byes gnyi ka rang dbang med par lus/khyarol dbyangs 'gros bzhin sbreng mkhan 'tshol ba na//'khrol mtshams chad cing gtam lan slog ma gyur//glu gzings nye bcar dngos mjal zhus pa dang //chang bsnan sgron bteg gsol ston slar yang bshams//nan skul bzlog par ma nus phyir bud cing //pi wang bteg nas gdong phyed 'gebs par byas//rgyud gzer bskor cing mtheb sdeb nyis sum gyis/khyadabyangs rta ma 'grub sngon du bzhin nyams phyung //sgra gdangs nyams dmas sngar 'das rjes su dran//tshe 'di'i 'dun ma don gyis stongs par phangs//smin ma bsdus shing bags kyis 'khrol ba las//sems kyi gsang gtam ma lus brjod dang mtshungs//yang deb dal 'phur gnon 'dred bskyar 'thog gis/khyasnga mar (nyi hrang 〉phyi mar (drug 'gyur 〉sbreng /khyargyud chen rdar dir drag char 'bebs pa bzhin/yirgyud chung sar sir lkog shob smra ba 'dra/khyardar rdir sar sir snol mar sbreng ba yis/g.yang ṭi'i gzhong bar mu tig lhung ba bzhin//res 'gar bye'u'i skad ltar gnyom zhing 'jibs//res 'gar chu phran gor mos bkag dang mtshungs/khukhyardza chu grang 'khyags rgyud mangs 'gags par snang //110

'gags shing chad pas sgra dbyangs re zhig 'jags//skyo 'bral sdug bsngal zhe 'khon snying nas skye//de'i tshe sgra med sgra ldan nyid las lhag/dngul bum hob brdol gzegs ma phyogs bzhir 'thor/phridamag rta 'dur zhing ru mtshon bkyes pa 'dra//rol dbyangs rdzogs shing dkrol mtshams cam gyis bzhag/rgyud bzhi mnyam ldir gos chen gshags pa 'dra//gru gzings shar lho khu sim nying nger 'jags//gtsang ngos dkar gsal ston zla 'ba' zhig mthong //the tshom ngang du mtheb bu phyir la bsdus/spragyon chas 'then tsam bzhin mdangs gzab nan gyur//nga rang ma gzhir rgyal sa'i bu mo ste//khyim ni rta babs bang so'i 'dabs na mchi/khrokhyabacu gsum tshe na rgyud mangs sbyangs nas shes//gzhas bro khang gi dang po'i sde ru gtogs/rdzirol dbyangs gcig gis mkhas dbang dregs pa snyil/khrokhyamadzes spras thengs rer cig nyang 'khu ldog slong /khri〉rigs ldan gzhon nus mgo ras brtsad nas sbyin/khukhyagazhas dbyangs gcig la dar gos grangs med 'thob//dngul gyi sgra 'dzar phar tshur rdeg nas bcagakhyasmad sham dmar po chang gis sbags pa mang //rtsed 'jo'i ngang du lo nas lo phyin cing //111

dpyid rlung ston zla'i dpal yon stong zad btang //gcung po dmag la phyin cing sru mo 'das//lo zla mang 'das bzhin gyi rang mdangs nyams//sgo kha rim 'jags 'grul rta 'khor ba dkon/khu〉na tshod yol bas tshong ba'i chung mar phab//tshong pas khe gnyer 'du 'bral ci mi snyam//nye sngon hphu long yul du ja nyor phyin/khya'agro 'ong gtsang 'gram gru gzings stong ba srung //zla bas gru mtha' bskor cing grang ngar ldang //nam gung gzhon dus rmi lam rmis pa na//ngus pa'i mchi mas gdong gi tshos kyang zags//rgyud mangs sgra snyan thos pas dngan pa 'chor//slar yang skyid sdug brjod pas de bas skyo//gnyi ka sa mthar 'khyams pa'i ldom po ste/khu1mthong ba tsam gyis ring 'dris grogs dang mtshungs//nga ni na ning rgyal sar kha bral nas//'di ru sgyugs shing nad kyi mal khrir lhung //zhin dbyang sa gol rol mo gzhar yang dben//rgyud dang smyug ma'i rol dbyangs thos par dkon/uphin cang ngogs su gnas bcas brlan gsher che//smyug ma'i 'dam rtswa khang pa'i mtha' ru bskor//dgung zhogs thos pa'i sgra ni khu byug dang //112

dred mo'i smre ngag nyid las gzhan ci 'tshal//dpyid kyi me tog ston zla'i mtshan mo mdzes//nam zhar gcig pus bdud rtsi bzhes pa nyid//ri gzhas dang ni gling bu'i sgra med pa'i//tsag tsig sgra yis rna bar gzan la ltos//de ring khyod kyi pi wang sgra thos pas//lha yi rol mo dang mtshungs rna yang bsang /ma bzhud slar yang rol mo zhig khrol dang //khyod la (pi wang 'gros 〉 kyi tshig 'bru rtsom//gtam dag thos rjes yud tsam had cing 'greng //slar yang tsog ste rgyud dag grim par byed//skyo nar dbyangs ni snga ma'i tshul las ldog/tshogs mang nyan bzhin gdong la mchi mas bran//skyo sdug mchi ma mang du dku de su//cang krig si ma gyon pa sngon po can/khunyemachan 'grel/༷pi wang 'gros zhes pa ni rgya'i skad du thas pa zhin zer te gna'i gzhas dbyangs shig gi ming ngo //0yiyon ho zhes pa ni thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma zhon tsung gi lo rtags ming ste/ spyi lo 806nas 821bar du bstan to//()ci'u cang zhes pa ni sos rgyal rabs skabs kyi sa cha zhig gi ming ste/ da lta'i cang zhi'i ci'u cang zhes pa dang thang rgyal rabs skabs su zhon dbyang ngam cang krig zer skad/113

si ma zhes pa ni dpon gnas phal ba zhig gi ming ngo //()rgyal sa khrang an zhes pa ni thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi rgyal sa ste/ da lta'i hran zhi'i zhi an grong khyer la bstan pa'o//()dmu dang tsha'o zhes pa thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi pi wang 'khrol mkhan mkhas chen gnyis kyi ming ngo //()zhun dbyang zhes pa ni skabs de'i ci'u cang sa khul gyi ming gzhan zhig go//()gzhi byes gnyi ka zhes pa ni skyel ma zhu mkhan rtsom pa po rang nyid dang mgon po gnyi kur bstan pa'o//()rgyud gzer zhes pa ni pi wang gi rgyud gdags bya'i gzer bu la go dgos pa dang /mtheb ni pi wang 'khrol byed kyi mtheb bu la go dgos/du 'dir bshad pa'i deb ni mtheb bus deb ste sbreng ba'i don dang /tsa 'phur ni mtheb bus mnyed 'phur byed pa ltar steng ba'i tshul dang / 6 'dred ni rgyud steng nas 'dred pa nang bzhin mnan nas 'drud pa'i don dang / 6 'thog ni rgyud skud la sen mos 'thog pa ltar sbreng ba'i don no//(yinyi hrang zhes pa ni gna'i gzhas dbyangs shig gi ming / 6drug 'gyur zhes pa de yang dbyangs su grub pa'i gzhas sheg gi ming ngo /()rgyud chen zhes pa ni pi wang steng gi rgyud sbom po can la bstan pa'o//(yirgyud chung zhes pa ni pi wang steng gi rgyud phra mo can la bstan pa'o//(na'adir chu phran gor mos bkag dang mtshungs zhes pa ni shar shar rgyug pa'i chu phran glo bur du rdo gor mos bkag pa nang bzhin rol dbyangs re zhig 'jags pa'i don no//(nyatshig 'di'i don ni dngul bum nas chu glo bur du brdol te gzegs ma phyogs bzhir 'thor ba nang bzhin rol dbyangs kyi sgra 'jags pa nas glo bur du drag myur gyis theng ste sgra drag tu ldir ba'i don no//humatheb bu zhes pa ni pi wang sbreng byed kyi mtheb bu leb mo de'i ming ngo //(rlurta babs bang so zhes pa ni ngag rgyun ltar na han rgyal rabs kyi mkhas pa chen po tun krung hru'u yi bang so yod sa'i sa cha'i ming ste/ khong gi rjes 'brang pa dag sa de nas 114

brgyud dus chibs bshol gus 'dud byed pas na rta babs zhes grags skad/ bang so de zhi an grong khyer gyi shar lho'i phyogs na yod do//phyagazhas bro khang zhes pa ni thang rgyal rabs su gong ma'i pho brang nang du btsugs pa'i gzhas ma dang gar ma dag gis slob sbyong byed sa'i gnas la go dgos/(spre'adir bshad pa'i mkhas dbang ni rol dbyangs 'khrol mkhas pa'i mi grags can la bstan pa'o//(mitshig nyang zhes pa ni skabs de ga'i rol dbyangs dkrol mkhas ma yi ming ngo /〈rlurigs ldan gzhon nu zhes pa ni rus mtho zhing khyim tshang phyug po can gyi bu phrug dag la bstan pa'o//kyitshig 'di'i don ni bu mo de gzhon dus su rigs ldan gzhon nu dag dang rtsed 'jo rol ba'i tshe mgo bo g.yo ba las skra 'dzar phan tshun rdeg nas bcag pa'i don/yitshig 'di'i don ni bu mos lang tsho nyams pa'i dbang gis sngon chad nang bzhin drung du 'khor ba'i mi shin tu nyung ba'i don no//yirlu long zhes pa ni da lta'i cang zhi'i wu leng zhes 'bod pa'i sa cha zhig gi ming ngo //pa'o//yi'adir gnyi ka zhes pa ni pi wang byung mkhas bu mo dang rtsom/ pa po gnyis ka bstan yirgyud dang smyug ma zhes pa ni rgyud mangs dang sgyug ma'i rol char bstan pa'o//〈yi'adir gyon pa sngon po can zhes pa ni si ma zhes 'bod pa'i dpon gnas de rigs kyis gyon pa'i lwa ba de sngon po yin pas de skad du brjod do//115

dbyi cang nanalngaming med zhig gis brtsams/nga la ma 'khyud ciga'akhyud pa'i sems mi drang /nga ni chu 'gram lcang sdong bzhin/'di yis bcag cing de yis 'khyud/zhe 'dang skar cha tsamalham na 'grel/rjodabyi cang nan zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig gi ming zhig go//0snyan tshig 'di'i nang don ltar na lus sems gnyis gar mnar gcod thebs pa'i smad 'tshong ma zhig gi gtam du nges te/ kho mos rang nyid ni chu 'gram gyi lcang sdong zhig la dpe drangs nas mi rnams kyi brnyas bcos bya yul du gyur tshul bstan pa'o//116

ku'o ma'o chanakhyamu lan snyan tshigatsi tsi slar yang tsi tsi zhes/phrimu lan khyim du 'khel 'thag byed//bu mo'i dngan pa 'chor sgra las//thags khri'i 'khor sgra thos ma gyur//bu mo khyod kyis ci zhig bsam//bu mo khyod kyis ci zhig dran//nga yis ci yang ma bsam la//nga yis gang yang mi dran gyi//mdang dgong dmag tho mthong ba lasakhyagong mas dmag mi sdud pa shes//dmag tho bam po bcu gnyis tsam//re rer pha yi mtshan yig bkod//pha la bu pho che ba med//gus mor ming po'i spun zla dben//khrom nas nyer spyad nyo sgrub kyis//pha yi tshab tu dmag la chas//shar gyi khrom nas rta mchog dang //117

nub kyi khrom nas sga stan zung //lho yi khrom nas srab mda' dang //byang gi khrom nas lcag ring nyos//zhogs par khyim dang kha bral nas//do nub rma klung 'gram du bcar//rma chu 'bab pa'i sgra tsam las//pha ma'i 'bod sgra thos ma gyur//zhogs par de las sgar bteg ste//do nub ri nag sgang du brtol/khyayan hran hu'u rta'i mig sgra las/khyapha ma'i 'bod sgra thos ma gyur//le dbar khri yi g.yul 'thab la//ri 'phrang 'phur ba bzhin du brgal//byang rlung thun pa'i sgra tsam mched//bsil zer 'od kyis go khyab gsal//ru 'dren brgya phrag g.yul ngor bkrongs//dpa' rtul lo bcu 'khor nas log/phyir 'byor gnam gyi sras por mjalakhyagong ma gser gyi khrir bzhugs nas//bya dga' rim pa bcu gnyis bstsal//gzigs bzos dngos rigs brgya las lhag/118

gzhan yang dgos 'dod ci zhig mchi//hrang hru'u blon chen ngar mi dgos/khyamagyogs 'gros cang shes la bcibs nas//pha yul nyid du gtang bar mdzod//pha mas bu mo'i gtam thos pas//phan tshun skyor bzhin sgo phyir bud//gcen mos nu mo bsu grabs la//me long mdun du mchor sgeg byed//ming pos a ce bsu ba'i ched//gri gug brdar nas phag lug gsod//nga yi gzhogs khang shar ma'i nang //nub kyi mal khri steng du bsdad//dmag gi chas gos rab dor nas//snga ma'i gyon chas rnying pa spras//sge'u khung 'gram du skra lo shad//me long mdun du me tog sbyar//sgo phyir thon pas bcu sde'i grogs/khyaso so ha las ce rer lta//lo ngo bcu gnyis 'grogs na yang //bu mo yin pa ye ma shes//yos phos sug bzhi rdeb par byed//yos mos mig zung rub kyis lta/khya119

de min lhan du bgrod pa'i tshe//pho mo'i dbye ba 'byed mi nus//mchan 'grel/dusnyan tshig 'di ni sung rgyal rabs kyi ku'o ma'o chan (775rsā)zhes pa'i mi zhig gis bsgrigs/ de sngar 〈〈rol mo'i pho brang gi snyan tshig phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉kyi bam po nyer lnga ba'i nang du bsdus skad/0yitsi tsi zhes pa thags khri 'khor ba'i sgra yi ming /rjodamag tho de gong mas btang ba'i dmag skul gyi brda tho la go/yang zeX ṭwāṃ //ga sgang de ni gna' dus nang sog gi ri bo zhig gi ming ste/ stag gsod sgang ()yan hran zhes pa ni phyi sog gi ri bo zhig gi ming / hu'u zhes pa gna' dus rgya mi rigs kyis nub byang phyogs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs spyi la 'bod pa'i ming zhig()gnam gyi sras po zhes pa gong ma'i ming gzhan zhig()hrang hru'u zhes pa gna' dus kyi blon gyi go gnas zhig gi ming /de skad( sdo/ba/cu sde zhes pa gna' dus dmag mi bcu re la sde gcig gi grangs bcad pas na dubashad srol la yos bu'i pho mo'i shan 'byed tshe yos bu'i rna nas bzung ste mar dpyangs na/ pho yin tshe sug bzhi deb par byed pa dang / mo yin tshe mig gnyis rub tsam byas nas lta ba'o//120

ma'o hreng seng shiming med zhig gis brtsams/nyi ma lho shar phyogs nas 'phags//khyim bdag chin gyi thog khang mdzes/khyachin la gzhung bzang bu mo ste//ming la lo rlu zhes par brjod//bu mo dar srin gso la mkhas//mkhar lhor lo ma btu bar phyin//si skud sngon pos gzeb bu btags//lhag mas gzeb kyi long bu byas//skra 'dzer yon por btab nas ni//rin chen gsal zla'i rna long spras/khyastod la smug po'i thig le can//smad la kham ser sham thabs gyon//lam pas mdzes ma mthong ba na//khres po sar bzhag sma ra byil//gzhon nus mdzes ma mthong ba na//zhwa mo phud nas skra cog 'ching //rmon pas thong gshol btsugs te lus//so nam yur ma rgyag mtshams bzhag/121

lam 'grul phan tshun 'phya bzhin du//krong nger mdzes ma'i dpal la blta//lho nas phebs pa'i rdzong dpon gyis/khyamathong nas 'gyogs 'khor skyod mtshams bzhag/'phral du sku 'khor phar btang nas//su yi bu mo yin zhes dris//nga ni chin gyi bu mo ste//ming la lo rlu zhes par 'bod//lang tsho'i dgung grangs ci tsam zin//bcu drug me tog bzhad pa tsam//dpon dang lhan du 'deng ngam zhes//slar yang bu mor 'di ltar dris//bu mos gus 'dud nyams dang bcas//phar la dris lan 'di ltar btab//sku khyod ji 'dra dgod bro ang //khyed la khab 'dzin bdag mo yod//nga la mnyes gshin khyo ka yod//nga yi khyo bor shar phyogs kyi//rta dmag lnga brgya'i zhabs 'bring mchis//de yi nang nas rta dkar mchog/rta nag rjes su 'brang ba nyid//122

rnga mar si skud sngon pos bslas//rta mgo gser gyis brgyan par byas//rked la ral gri 'khor can btags//rin thang gser sung khri las lhag/bco lnga'i tshe na dpon chung dang //nyi shur pho brang ta spru thob/khyasum cur sku srung dmag dpon dang //bzhi bcur mkhar rdzong bdag gir byed//bzhin ras dkar zhing kho lag rdzogs//sma ra za zi na tshod smin//'gro tshe seng ge 'gying stabs bzhin//dpon po'i 'gros nyams rnam par ston//'du tshogs khrom pa'i dbus su ni//kun las khyad du 'phags par brjod//mchan 'grel/dumad hrang seng zhes pa ni rgya'i gna' rabs kyi pho brang glu gzhas shig gi ming ste/glu gzhas kyi ming gi khyad par ltar dbyangs rta dang / glu tshig mi 'dra ba re gtan 'khel byas yod pa zhig yin skad/ snyan tshig 'di'i nang du rdzong dpon zhig gis dar shing gi lo ma 'thu ba'i bu mo zhig la yid shor ste bdag gir 'dzin 'dod pa la bu mos rang gi blo gros la brten nas pha rol gyi 'dod ham la mtshang 'byin dang rang nyid kyi lus po bdag srung byas tshul bstan to//②min zhes pa ni bu mo'i rigs rus kyi ming la chin zhes brjod par bshad do//dugasal zla'i rna long zhes pa ni rgyu rin po che las byas shing dbyibs nya gang ba'i zla 123

ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba'i rna long la bstan/④rdzong dpon zhes pa ni 'dir rgya'i skad du the hrig ces pa de la go dgos/()ta spru zhes pa ni gna' rabs kyi dpon gnas shig gi ming ste srid blon tha ma'i gras la bshad pa'ang yod skad/

nges med snyan tshigaman ju rgyal rabs skabs kyi che ge mos brtsams/dong tse mang na dga' ba'i nges pa med//nor ni sems ngal rgyu dang bdud kyi grogs//dngul khug stongs pa ngo tsha'i gnas ma yin//gang gā'i bye mas phyug pa sangs rgyas yin//sngo ljang dpyid dpal yin pa'i nges pa med//sdong skam gcer bur mngon kyang snying bo mtshon//de ring btang snyoms sgom pa'i thabs zin pas//mdun gyi bdud mo mdzes mar 'gyur ba mthong //grags pa thob kyang go gnas 'phar nges med//'dam skyes rtswa phran chung yang skye stobs 'bar//ri mgo'i rtswa ljang bskams kyang sos par 'gyur//mi yi yul 'dir skyid sdug res mos 'khor//dar la drag pa rtag pa'i nges pa med//bza' btung ngan ngon skyid pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur//drang srong la ni tshe thub man ngag thob//snod bcud mthun sdeb byed mkhas grub pa yin//125
bas phebs gyur na lha yin nges pa med//rnal 'byor nyid ni sgom las byung ba yin//nyi zer tsha zhing 'khris kyi rdzing bu bsil//chu skyes pad ma mtshar zhing snying du sdug/
na byon ngas dpa'a'adra bsdo

gung khran ring lugs ni 'gog thabs med pa zhig yin/me stag phra mos spang ljongs bsreg par 'gyur/sngon gshegs dpa' bo rnams rtag tu mi nyams par shog/ma'o rtse tung /'thab grogs dgyes zhal gtan du gyes na yang //tshe gang mdzad rjes ma nyams gzi dpal 'bar//snyan tshig bklags pas gzugs zhal dngos mjal bzhin//snying stobs dgu 'gyur slar yang skyes thob 'dra//1953lo'i zla 3par tung bra wus gus pas phul/lag pas mi yul gsar ba bskrun nus su//lha dang sangs rgyas ma yin 'phags pa'ang min//lnga bzhi'i tshun gyi lo rgyus gsar ba nyid//gzi dpal rab 'bar snyan tshig 'di las rtogs//lin po chus kyis 1959lo'i bla 4tshes 18nyin phul/khrag gi snyan rtsom khrag gis bris par 'khums//tang mi'i gshis rgyud bskal brgyar bsngag bya'i gnas//mtshal rdog phye mar btul kyang gshis mi 'gyur//btso sbyangs byas kyin rno lcags lhad med ngom//g.yu 'brug 'thab pas ljongs 'di mtshal khar bsgyur//bya pho grag nyid mtshan smag sangs par gyur//129

sha khrag dor nas skar lnga'i rgyal kha thob//gang sar dar dmar mthon por bsgrengs pas khyab//ko mo du'o yis 1959lo'i zla 3tshes 2la phul/ngag tshig lo rgyus gsal ba'i rgyan du lham//gshis rgyud bzang po gnam gyis sa khebs ltar//lag rjes ngo mtshar nyi zla gsal ba bzhin//spyod bzang 'gro kun mig ltos nyid du mthong //wu'u yus krang gis 1961lo'i zla 6tshes 11nyin phul/yig 'bru re re khrag gis sbags nas bris pa bzhin//tshig phreng so sor phul byung snyan ngag rgyan gyis mdzes//g.yu 'brug sngon mo gnam la 'khyug bzhin ngo mtshar ldan//dbyar rnga'i sgra chen dgung la ldir bzhin kun la khyab//glu gcig blangs pas shar rgyug chu bo gyen la ldog/yang zhig blangs pas ri rab phreng ba zhig cing 'gas//gsum dang bzhi bas shar rir gser mdog nyin byed 'phags//gdon 'dre'i ma rung rlung nag 'tshub ma zhi bar gyur//sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i gsang mtho'i glu sgra ma nyams shing //dmangs kyi sems la rtag tu gson por gnas par 'gyur//zhe skyu'e rtses1961lo'i zla 6tshes 12nyin la phul//30

li ta kra'okhrokyesnyan tshig tshan pa gcig(shing yos lo'i lo mjug tu hong pinatsho) nas hpha ran si'i mtsho grur bsdud nas khrun hreng rjodu skyod skabs zhi bde rgya mtsho'i steng du brtsams pa/)zab yangs chu bo shar la rgyug/'grul mkhan sems kyi dngan pa 'chor/zing chas gzir ba'i lha gling 'di//bde ba'i gnas la ci ltar 'god//nor 'dzin khyon 'dir mun pas bstibs//ngan rengs gcig gis rgyal srid bzung /khyakha dog sna lngas brgyan pa'i dar/khrokyede ring gzi mdangs shor la ltos//jag rkun 'dul dus 'phyis drags pas/khunyed lta nyid du 'jug par ran//yun nan 'os langs sgra chen ldir/khu)log spyod rnga sgras ho pe 'khyom/khro)yul mthar snying gcugs grogs por 'phrad//sems gtam brjod pa'i skal ba ldan//mtshan gung cang hu'u yul nas chas/khro)gsal zla mun pa'i grogs dang sdeb//131

mkha' lding lho phyogs rgya mtshor snyeg/spobs pa'i 'dab gshog rkyong bar rangs/gshog deb gcig gis dgung la rtsen//mkha' lam ring la skrag dgos ci//na tshod gzhon pa'i dus sgang 'dir//rgyal khab skyob par brtson pa gces//pho rab rang rtsal ngom pa la//dus dang skal ba ma nor gal//mchan 'grel/① le ta kra'o (rsāshā //1889 1927) ho pe zhing chen 'o/ zin gyi mi yin/ krung go gung khran tang gsar gtod byed mkhan dang / rig gnas gsar ba'i las 'gul dang rgyu lnga bzhi mirgyal gces las 'gul gyi sgrig 'dzugs mkhan dang mgo khrid pa gtso gras yin/ krung gor snga dus su mar khe si ring lugs dril bsgrags byas pa'i lag rjes che/ 1922lor krung go gung khran tang gi skabs gnyis pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen steng krung dbyang u yon du bdams shing / krung gung byang phyogs khul u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan bzhes te byang phyogs kyi bzo ba'i las 'gul dang gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod la mgo 'dren byas/ 1927lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes drug nyin dgra'i 'dzin bzung thebs/ btson khang gi nang du/ khong gis thog mtha' bar gsum du blo brtan 'gyur med kyis gung khran ring lugs 'thab mo ba'i dpa' bo'i spobs pa mngon par bstan/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin pe cin du bkrongs/②nyeng min zhes pa de ni ri pin rgyal khab kyi grong khyer zhig gi ming /༷khrun hreng zhes pa de ni ljar pan rgyal khab kyi grong khyer zhig gi ming /tshungan rengs zhes pa de ni skabs de ga'i rgyal srid g.yo 'phrog byed mkhan yon hri kha'e la bstan/132

༷kha dog sna lnga'i dar zhes pa de ni lcags phag lo'i gsar brje'i rjes su krung hwa ming go zhes pa'i rgyal khab btsugs pa la de'i rgyal dar ni dkar ser dmar sngo nag bcas kha dog lnga yis grub pas na de skad brjod pa yin/dungag rkun zhes pa de yang yon hri kha'e la bstan/①yun nan 'os langs zhes pa de ni dmag dpon tsha'i yod kyis yun nan zhing chen du yon hri kha'e 'dul ba'i 'os langs byas pa la bstan/༷log spyod rnga sgra zhes pa de ni yon hri kha'e yis tsha'i yod kyi 'os langs dmag la drag gnon byed pa'i dmag dpung btang ba la bstan/ducang hu'u zhes pa de ni ljar pan rgyal khab kyi grong khyer zhig gi ming /

ba'o can yus/rjosnyan tshig tshan pa gcibata)nga ni rno dbal ral gri yin/ /nga ni tsha tsha'i me stag yin//gson dus nam mkha'i glog zhags bzhin du 'od rnon rab tu spro bar 'dod//shi tshe dkar gsal skar mda' bzhin du skad cig nyid la 'da' bar sems//mchan 'grel/dhika'o cun lus ( 0lha1896zhe 1925) hran zhi zhing chen cing le rdzong gi mi yin/ 1921lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ phyi lo'i zla dang por krung go gung khran tang gi tshab byas nas mo si khor bsdus pa'i ya gling shar rgyud rgyal khab so so'i gung khran tang dang mi rigs gsar brje'i tshogs pa'i 'thus mi tshogs chen la zhugs/ phyir log rjes blo mthun li ta kra'o dang mnyam du rgo gung mnyam 'brel gyi don du 'bad brtson byas shing / tang gi sgrig 'dzugs dang dril bsgrags bya bar hur brtson byas/ 1925lo'i zla gsum par pe cin du gshegs/②'di ni rtsom pa pos de snga rang nyid kyi gsar brje'i spobs pa bskyed pa'i gsal 'debs su brtsams pa yin skad/134

then po dbyang khyang yis/nga yis drag tu 'tsher ba'i me 'od spros te//mi yu la 'di yi rdzun dang g.yo 'phrul gzhom par 'dod//nga yis rno ngar ldan pa'i gri gug brdungs nas//mi dang mi yi bar gyi skyi pags gshag par 'dod//mchan 'grel/༷then po dbyang (cha'i 71904 1927) hu'u nan zhing chen chin li'u dbyang gi mi yin/ 1922lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang ngo 'i skabs su/ hu'u nan zhing chen gung gzhon tshogs pa'i dril bsgrags pu'u krang / hru'u ci bcas kyi 'gan khur/ hu'u nan na gzhon las 'gul gyi mgo 'dren gtso gas yin/ 1927lo'i zla lnga tshes nyer gcig gi dus 'gyur byung skabs 'dzin bzung thebs/ de lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin khrang hra'i me 'khor sa tshigs su go min tang log spyod pas bkrongs/ 135

dbyang khra'okhyarang srog gtong kha'i tshigaldoljongs 'dir kha ba bu lug dang bsdebs sems kyi skyo ngal bsang dus med//gsar brje byed la mgul rtse'i mgo bo gcad par 'jigs pa spu tsam med//tsi zhus snying stobs ma nyams 'phel ltar snying rus spobs pa bskyed pas na//khru'u wang rgyal por 'khon lan slog pa'i skal ba ldan par som nyis dben/khyamachan 'grel/①dbyang khra'o (6719044 1927) cang zhi zhing chen te an gyi mi yin/1923lor nan cin gyi lho shar slob grwa chen mo'i zur gtogs slob 'bring 'grim skabs gung khran ring lugs na gzhon tshogs par zhugs/ 1925lor pe cin slob grwa chen mor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1926lor tang gi bkas mngags ltar cang zhir log nas krung gung cang zhi zhing u'i u yon dang / phyis su te an rdzong gi hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/1927lo'i zla bzhi bar cang ce hri gsar brjer blo log rjes/ khong snga phyir nan khrang dang wu'u khrang / ho nan sa khul bcas la phebs nas gsar brje'i bya ba bsgrubs/ lo de'i zla bcu bar tang gis khong slar yang cang zhi la mngags kyang stabs ma legs par ci'u cang sa khul du myul ma'i lag tu tshud/ 1927lo'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin nan khrang du bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos rang srog gtong khar skad gsang mthon pos gyer 'don byas pa yin skad/༷khrun cig skabs su/ lu'u tsi zhus zhes pa'i mi de'i pha dang gcen po nyes pa med bzhin du khru'u rgyal khab kyi rgyal po yin wang gis bsad/ de nas wu'u tsi zhus ni lo'u rgyal 136

khab la bros te mi ring bar rgyal po'i blon por gyur rjes/ dmag drangs nas khru'u rgyal khab cham la phab/ skabs der khru'u phin wang 'das nas lo shas thal yang bam ro dur nas bton te lcag gis brabs nas 'khon lan slog pa'i gtam rgyud yod skad/ tshig 'di gnyis kyi don ni/ gsar brje la gnas skabs kyi pham nyes byung yang dpa' bo'i khrag ni don med du bzhur mi srid de/ nam zhig gsar brje la rgyal la 'thob nas dgra bor 'khon lan slog nges yin par bstan/

kro'u wun yung /rjogashegs kha'i tshibatakromago bo bcad kyang chog yan lag bcag kyang rung //gsar brje'i snying stobs nyams pa'i dpe mi srid//dam pa'i mgo bo tang gi ched du 'bul//dpa' bo'i gzugs phung mi dmangs don la mchod//mchan 'grel/༷kro'u wun yung (74rsā1905 1928) 1927lo'i zla bcu gnyis par kong krig 'os langs skabs/ kong krig su'u we ed ngal rtsol u yon dang dmar srung ru khag gi bkod 'doms pa'i 'gan khur/ 'os langs pham rjes/ khong dang lcam khrin the cun gnyi ka 'dzin bzung thebs/ btson khang du khong tshos dgra bo'i 'dri gcod la brgal lan slog ste dgra bo ci bya gtol med du gyur/ gshegs khar lam bar du gsar brje'i kha g.yang sgrog cing 〈〈rgyal spyi'i glu dbyangs 〉〉spon bzhin phyin pas mang tshogs la mchi ma 'chor bar byas skad/red/ ⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po gshegs khar btson khang gi rtsig ngor bris pa zhig 138

sngo'e kha'e kyā/ rjosnyan ngag tshig rkang gnyis/krang cang sgo kha'i khrag 'khon snying la bcags/kho'iphyi mar stag ma'i me tog bzhin dmar shog/mchan 'grel/duzo'i kha'e kyā (/)khrimatsho 1899 1927) cang zhi zhing chen lung hpheng gi mi yin/ snyan ngag dang bris la mkhas/ zhing pa dbul bo zhig gi khyim du skyes shing chung dus rkang par skyon shor bas 'theng skad/ gsar brje chen po'i sngon la gung khran tang du zhugs shing yung hpheng rdzong gi sngon gshegs dpa' bo grags can sung ta zhun sogs dang mnyam du yung hpheng rdzong du gung khran tang tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 1927lor gsar brje chen po pham rjes 'dzin bzung thebs/ gshegs khar dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi khyad chos ngo mtshar bar bstan skad/khu'ikrang cang zhes pa ni sa cha zhig gi ming ngo //139

yo'u dbyang me hreng khyapir kha sbyong ba'i snyan tshig②krung gor ma rung mun pas khyab//'o dod sgra yis rna ba gzan//zhi bde gsha' ma 'thob pa'i phyir//gri kha'i 'dre pho byed par rangs//mchan 'grel/ཿo'u dbyang me hreng (a/ba cho1895 1928) hu'u nan zhing chen khrang hra'i mi yin/ 1926lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir hu'u nan zhing chen rgyal yongs bzo tshogs kyi drung yig chen mo dang / krung gung hu'u pe zhing u'i drung yigakrung gung han dbyang rdzong u'i u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur myong / 1928lor gshegs/6)1924lor rang rgyal ni dmag shed can gyis 'khrug 'dzing byed pa'i gnas su lhung 'dug thengs shig com pa pos spar sgyug cig nyos te pir kha sbyong ba'i skabs su/pir gyi yu ba'i steng du 6 zhi bde pir smyug khang gis bzos zhes pa'i yi ge brkos yod pa mthong bas tshig pa zos te da lta lag pa brkyangs na mdzub mo mi mthong ba'i mun pas khyab cing / rgyu nor yod pa can gyis 'thab res gsod res byas te khyi smyon gyis rus pa 'phrog res byed pa dang 'dra/ krung go'i sa rgya 'di 'dra che yang bde 'jags yin pa'i sa lag mthil tsam yang med pa la 6 zhi bde /zer ba ga la yod ces smra bzhin yu ba'i steng gi yi ṭā sdo // gris gzhogs nas mdun gyi shog ngor snyan tshig sho lo ka 'di shar mar bris pa 140

zhwa ming stanakṣarang srog gtong kha'i snyan tshigadzomago bo bcad kyang ci mi snyam//ring lugs tshad mas grub pas chog/zhwa ming han nyid bsad na yang //phyi rabs rjes 'jug bstud nas 'ong //mchan 'grel/duzhwa ming han (4771900 1928) hu'u nan zhing chen hing dbyang gi mi yin/ 6 lnga bzhi las 'gul skabs su ting dbyang slob ma'i mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi mgo 'dren pa byas/ 1920lor khrang phor phebs nas slob ma'i rgyal gces las 'gul gyi bya ba bsgrubs/ 1925lo'i rjes su krung gung hu'u nan zhing u'i u yon dang /1927lor wu'u han zhing ba'i las 'gul khrid stong khang gi drung yig gi 'gar khur/6 ma ri ma dus 'gyur rjes su hu'u nan la phyir log nas hu'u nan zhing u'i u yon dang rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang gcig lcogs byas/ de nas slar yang han kho'u la spos te krung gung hu'u pe zhing u'i u yon gyi 'gan khur/ 1928lo'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nyin 'dzin bzung thebs/ phyi nyin go min tang log spyod pas bkrongs/6)snyan tshig 'di ni blo mthun zhwa ming han 'das khar dgra bos khong la kha chems 'dra yod dam med ces dris pa la/ khong gis ci yang mi gsung bar smyu gu bteg ste gong gsal gyi sho lo ka 'di bris skad/141

le'u hra'o nan/dhidagra bor brgal lan btab paṇḍiskyes pho rab yin na gsar brje byed//dus gsar ba skrun pa'i spobs pa dgos//'bangs bzo zhing tshogs la phan bde gnyer//tshegs dka' sdug che yang dpa' mi zhum//dgra khyod tshos nga rang bkrongs pa de//snum mar me rlung gis bsad dang mtshungs//las gsar brjer mi gcig bri na yang //dpe mtsho las chu thigs 'dzad dang 'dra//gsar brje'i blo sems rlabs ltar 'phyo//sgang gshong gcig la gcig tu 'brel//gdon 'dre smyo ham che na yang //rlabs kyis bye ma 'ded pa bzhin//dar dkar phab nas dar dmar bsgrengs/khyang yi shi gson da res gcod//'chi na 'greng nas 'chi ba yin//'dre phrug tsho//142

mgo bo ma smad spo bo nga la ltos//mtshan 'grel/duli'u hra'o nan (smo1lko tshe 19034 1928) hu'u pe zhing chen hong hu'u yi mi yin/ 1920lor wu'u khrang du slob 'bring 'grim pa'i skabs su mar le ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i bag chags sad/ ma 'gyangs par krung rgo gung khran tang la zhugs/1926lor tang sga bkas mngags ltar hong hu'u sa khul du log nas/ dmar dmag hri bcu drug pa'i chab srid pu'u yi kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ 1928lor dmag dpung hu'u nan nub phyogs su skyod skabs khong gis hong hu'u gnas srung byed 'gan blangs nas bsdad/ phyis yul gyi gshed ma'i jal tshogs la 'thab pa'i khrod du rmas phog ste 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1928lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin log spyod pas bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po la dgra bos 'dri gcod byed skabs khong gis glu rtar drangs nas gyer skad/rjodar dkar zhes pa ni dgra bo'i dar cha la bstan pa yin/143

tsha' cing stong khyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcigadakar bsil zla bas ston kha'i ba mo gsal//ring byes pha yul 'di la da gdod byon//rang srog ma chad mgo bo ma lhung na//spobs pa ma nyams gzengs su bstod par nges//mchan 'grel/0tsha'i cing hong (21331906 1928) hu'u pe zhing chen ma khreng gi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i rjes/hong ma zhing pa'i 'os langs la zhugs myong ba dang / krung gung ma khreng rdzong khu'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1928lor dgra bos ma khreng sa khul la skor bcom byas te sku snyang bzhin pa'i tsha'i cing hong nad khri'i thog nas 'dzin bzung byas shing blo mthun gzhan gnyis dang mnyam du bkrongs/ khong tsho gshegs khar gsum ga dgung lo nyer gnyis tsam yin pas yul mi tshos skyo zhing phangs pa'i ngang nas nga tsho dbul po'i don du shi ba'i mi 'di gsum ga'i dgung lo bsdoms pas lo drug cu re drug tsam las ma 'das pas phangs zer/ gong gsal gyi snyan tshig 'di ni khong 'dzin bzung thebs skabs bris skad/144

ho cin kra'akhyalang tha'o tratha1927lo'i zla dgu bar nga ni kong tung nas hrang nyer log pa'i lam bar du gsar brjer ngo rgol pas gang sa gang la bzo zhing mang tshogs dmar gsod byed pa mthong bas skyo gdung chen po skyes shing / hrang ter yang 'jigs skrag dang nyams rgyad kyi rnam pas khyab pa mthong bas 'dug ma bzod par snyan tshig 'di shar mar bris pa yin/g.ya' dag sngo bsangs mthongs la bltas pa na//pha mtha'i gnam klung dbyer med 'brel ba mthong //ngogs gnyis rgya lcang lo 'dab rgyas pas mdzes//ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzes ljongs 'di//jag rkun tshogs kyis brdzis par blo re pham//ma rung cang jag dugadug rtsub che re ltos//snying rje'i sems bral mi las dgu las byed//bzo zhing dmar gsod byas pa'i khrag ma skam//'a cag yul khams gso ba'i lag brkyangs nas//mes po'i khab 'di slar yang skyob par 'dod//mchan 'grel/ཿho cin kra'o (mas 1101— 1928) hu'u nan zhing chen sang kri'i mi 145

yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i skabs/ blo mthun ho lung gis mgo 'dren byas pa'i dmag dpung gi hri krang khur/ 1927lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1928lor ho lung phyir rang yul du log nas krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag cun bzhi pa gsar 'dzugs byed skabs ho cin kra'i yis hri dang po'i hri krang gi 'gan khur/1928lo'i zla dgu bar hu'u nan zhing chen hri ming nyi pho'i sa khul du dmag 'thab byed pa'i nang du rang srog blos btang /⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos1927lo'i zla bcu bar dmag dpung gnas spo byed skabs blo mthun ho lung la 'brel gtug chad pas grur bsdad de phong her blo mthun ho kṣiṃ trī ḍi rdorsha nā /na pa'i lam bar du bris pa yin/ lang tha'o hra zhes pa ni rgya'i snyan tshig ()cang jag ces pa ni cang ce hri log spyod phyogs khag la bstan pa yin/

zhun nyeng han pheng tser bros byol byas palhorgyal khab nyams kyang mdun lam ma 'gag pas//srog gcod stegs bur 'jigs med 'dzeg par spobs//rlung dang char gyi nyams sad ci la skrag/mda' mdel gseb nas byon pa ma yin nam//mchan 'grel/༷zhun hong han ('jo 1894 1928) hu'u nan zhing chen tho'o cang gi mi yin/ de snga dmangs gtso gsar brje'i las 'gul la zhugs myong / 1926lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1927lor cang ce hris gsar brje ngo rgol gyi dus 'gyur bslangs rjes/ dkar po'i 'jigs skrag gi nang du'ang gsar brje'i don du hur brtson chen po byas/ 1928lo'i zla bcu gcig par lu'u han du stabs ma legs par 'dzin bzung thebs te bkrongs/()pheng tse zhes pa ni cang zhi zhing chen gyi rdzong zhig gi ming yin/147

kran ku'u thang 5)snyan tshig tshan pa gcig(dmag shed can bar 'khrug 'dzing langs pas 'bangs la sdug bsngal chen po bzos par ma bzod nas tshigs bcad 'di shar mar bris/)②'byams klas zhing 'dir bden med dmag 'khrug langs//dmangs kyis bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar re//rgya mtsho'i klong nas rba rlabs 'khrigs pa'i mthus//gdon 'dre tshar gcod dmangs la bde ba sbyin//mchan 'grel/dhikran ku'u thang (6341882— 1929) an hu'e zhing chen cin kro'i mi yin/ 1923lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs rjes/ phyogs gcig nas slob gso'i bya ba bsgrubs shing phyogs gcig nas gsar brje'i bya ba bsgrubs/ 1929lo'i zla gnyis par hrang khreng rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ zla drug pa'i nang dmar dmag thad gtogs hri bcu gcig pa'i chab srid u yon gyi 'gan khur/ dmag dpung spo 'then byas rjes/ khong sa gnas su bzhugs nas 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas/ mi ngan gyis gsang brtol bas 'dzin bzung thebs shing ma 'gyangs par bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos de snga ho nan du slob chung gi dge rgan byed skabs thengs shig dmag shed can gyis 'khrug 'dzing bslangs pa'i skor gleng pa'i tshe la thol byung du smras pa yin skad/148

pheng pha'ekhya'os langs glu/'u cag mnyam du 'os langs byed//ma rung stobs shugs rtsad nas rdzogs//da lta'i gsar brje chen po yis//bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ngo rgol dang //'bangs la sa zhing bgo skal 'gyed//su'u we yed nyid gsar 'dzugs kyis/sgo'ibazo zhing zung gis srid dbang 'dzin//gung khran lam lugs lag len bstar//'jig rten rdzogs ldan lam la 'god//'byor med gral rim mgo drangs pa'i//'dzam gling gsar brje chen po 'di//phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog/mchan 'grel/dupheng pa'i (771896 1929) kong tung zhing chen he gleng gi mi yin/krung go'i snga rabs kyi zhing ba'i las 'gul gyi mgo 'dren pa dang kong tung he lu'u hpheng gsar brje'i gnas gzhi sa khul gsar gtod byed mkhan yin/ 1922lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir krung gung kong tung zhing u'i u yon dang rgyal yongs zhing 149

'brel lhan tshogs kyi gnas skabs lag bstar u yon lhan khang bi u yon/ krung gung krung dbyang gi u yon/ krung gung krung dbyang chab srid cus u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur myong /1929lo'i zla brgyad par hrang he nas 'dzin bzung thebs shing zla brgyad pa'i tshes so gcig nyin lung hwa ru bkrongs/②su'u we ed ces pa ni de snga'i su'u len krung dbyang dang sa gnas rim pa so so'i rgyal khab srid 'dzin las khungs kyi ming yin/ rang rgyal gyi rgyal nang gsar brje dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su gsar brje'i gnas gzhi sa khul so sor bzo zhing dmangs gtso'i srid dbang btsugs pa'i ming la'ang su'u we ed ces brjod pa yin no//

lu'o zhu'e tsanakhyarang blo'i 'char snang /rang blo mi bde 'tshig pa'i tshe//yig gcugs grogs po'i gam la bcar/grogs kyis nyer bsdogs legs bshams nas//nga la mgon po'i tshul du byas//gnam 'og 'gro don 'ba' zhig las//rang don spu tsam gleng bya min//sgang nas rgyang gzigs byas pa na//snod bcud lag mthil rdzas bzhin gsal//khri gdugs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar bas//gdon bgegs gnod 'tsher 'jigs don med//rno dbal ral gri shubs 'don gyis//sdug bsngal rtsa ba gcod par byed//nyams dmas rgyal khab skyob pa la//snying mdzangs dpa' bo byed par rangs//ma na 'grel/dulu'o zhu'e tsan (7lha 1893 1930) hu'u nan zhing chen zhang than gyi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon yin/ 1918lor 6 dmangs gsar slob tshogs sa su zhugs/1919lor hpha ran sir slob zhor las ka byed par phyin/ 1922lor phyir log rjes/ snga 151

phyir hu'u nan zhing chen spyi'i bzo tshogs dang / krung gung hu'u nan zhing ur bya ba bsgrubs/gzhan yang hu'u nan zhing chen lis lin rdzong u'i hru'u ci dang zhang than rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur myong / 1929lor krung gung kro cang zhing ur bya ba sgrub skabs 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1930lor hang krig tu bkrongs/

krang cing hu'ekhyarang srog gtong kha'i snyan tshigadushi rgyur mi skrag gson la 'jigs pa min//don dag ci tsam che yang theg par spobs//blo gcig gsar brje byed cing dmangs don du//gri kha yin yang de la 'dzeg par nus//dar dmar bsgrengs pas lhab lhab rlung gis bskyod//bzo zhing dmar dmag la ni stobs shugs ldan//gung khran tang gis gnam 'og lo khrir skyong //log spyod phyogs khag tshe thag ring mi 'gyur//dbul phongs bzo zhing dang ni dmag mi kun//blo sems rdog rtsa gcig tu sgril ba gal//dmag shed can dang go min tang bsgral tshe//gnam 'og zhi bde mi 'ong ga la srid//mchan 'greladhikrang cing hu'e (lkoḥṭha1915 1930) spru can zhing chen yun ting rdzong gi mi yin/ sa zhing gsar brje'i skabs su tang gi na gzhon dril bsgrags pa byas shing /yun ting sa khul gyi ming grags che ba'i glu ma yin/ 1930lo'i zla bzhi par kho mo chus su'u we ed srid gzhung gi dril bsgrags ru khag dang mnyam du zhi dbyang yin sde bar phyin 153
nas 'dzin bzungan krang cing hu'e tha

ro'u hri khrag dron chu ltar khol/—nan cin du bkrongs pa'i na chung blo mthun zhig rjes su dran pa/khrag ni chu ltar khol/sems ni me bzhin 'bar/'jigs snang che ba'i mtshan mo 'dir/kho 'das song /kho bgrongs song /'jigs snang che ba'i mtshan mo 'dir/nga tsho'i na chung blo mthun de/gdug rtsub kyi mde'us kho yi snying khong brtol/nyam chung gi gzugs phung phra mo sa la 'gyel/gsar bton gyi khrag dron dmar pos spang thang sbags/go min tang /gdon 'dre 'dra ba'i gshed ma ste/ce spyang gi sems/wa mo'i mjug ma/khyi smyon gyi sna can des/155

kho rang mnams nas zin/kho rang bzung nas drud/kho rang mid nas bkrongs/khras ni chu ltar khol/sems ni me bzhin 'bar/sa gzhi g.yo zhing 'gul/me ri 'gas shing 'phyur/btsan rgyal ring lugs pa tsho/khyod tsho 'chi kha'i dus la nye/rlung chen pos rdo dang zegs ma skyod/rlabs drag pos gor mo gyen la 'dren/bzo grwa'i du khung nang nas dgung la me stag mched/yur khem gyi rtse mo las sa yi khrag rgyun 'bab/yod tshad de khyod tsho'i yod tshad/'gas shing zhig ste 'gro/tshar zhing rdzogs par 'gyur/dngul sgor/ 'jigs snang / gnya' gnon/ bshu gshogakhyod tsho la sprod par byed/skyogs chen/ gnam gru/ dug mda'/ glog dra/khyod tshos myur du sgrigs shigami'i rigs 'thab rtsod kyi lo rgyus steng //56

'di ni mtha' mjug gi skad cig yin/khrag gis sbags pa'i lo rgyus/mda' dang skyogs kyi lo rgyus/sa gzhi g.yo zhing sgul ba'i lo rgyus ang /nga tsho'i na chung blo mthun te/dgung lo bcu drug las med pa'i spun zla de/skad cig ma'i lo rgyus de'i steng du gshegs song /'o dod dang sdug bsngal chod cigamade'u ni kho yi klad par phogakho dang mnyam du mi lnga yod/phreng gcig gshar nas bsgrigs/kho dang lhan du lnga brgya yod/dpung gcig gshar nas bsgrigs/kho dang chabs cig khri stong yod/'dzam gling yongs kyi 'byor med gral rim gyi dpung khag bsgrigs/hur brtson gyi dpung khagabartul phod kyi dpung khagakhrag ni chu ltar khol/sems ni me bzhin 'bar/nga tsho'i na chung blo mthun der lcags lta bu'i sha rus yod/me ltar dbal che ba'i mig zung ldan/157

mde'u ni kho tshor gzas nas 'phur song /kho ni mda' rgyag mkhan gyi 'ben dang /ldir khung sprod pa'i thig tu gyur/kho ni dmar gsod kyi yul du gyur/lha yar longs/'khyags ltogs kyis mnar ba'i bran g.yog rgyal yongs kyi bzo zhing ngal rtsol mang tshogs kye/mnyam du yar longs shigang tshos rang nyid bcings 'grol byed/rma chu'i rba rlabs chen pos rags ngos brdabs/su'u we ed kyi dar cha rgyal yongs kyi/ri sgang kun tu lhab lhub skyod par byed/rlabs che ba'i gsar brje/rlabs che ba'i 'thab rtsod/nga tsho'i na chung blo mthun te/na chung gdong len ru khag gi tos krang /kho rang 'di ru 'das song /smyo ham che ba'i mtshan mo/dkar po'i 'jigs skrag gi mtshan mor/ga sa ga la ce sbyang gi sems/wa mo'i mjug ma/158

khyi smyon gyi sna yis khengs/ri tshom gyis ngar sgra 'di ltar sgrogadabang sgyur gral rim pa tsho/khyod tshos tshe mjug gi gyon chas dkar po/ro sgam dkar po myur tu sgrigs shigabazo zhing mang tshogs kyis snga mo nas/khyod tsho'i dur sa brkos zin/mya ngan gyi glu ni 'di skad blangs/nga tshor yur khem yod/nga tshor sta re yod/nga tshor khrag dron yod/nga tshor dmar sems yod/smyo ham che ba'i mtshan mo/dkar po'i 'jigs skrag gi mtshan mor/sku drag dang ni rgyal 'tshong pa/'byor ldan gral rim bde ba'i mal du gzims/de nas bzung khyod tsho la nam gsal med/ khyod tshos zhogs pa'i skya rengs mthong mi 'gyur/—khyod tshos rang la khrel dgod gyis dang /mun nag gi 'chi kha rang la thug 'dugang tsho'i na chung spun zla'am/159

gces su 'os pa'i blo mthun 050khyod/mda' kha'i mdun du/'dzum bag dang bcas te gshegs song /de ni las 'gan yin/de ni bden don yin/mtshan mun/rlung 'tshub/thog rgod/drag char/sdiltos dang / 'thab rtsod kyi mtha' mjugasngon du mchongs shigablo mthun tsho/nga tshos gshin po'i 'khon lan slogagason po rnams la rgyal kha brtson/khrag ni chu ltar khol/sems ni me bzhin 'bar/dkar po'i 'jigs skrag gi mtshan mo 'dir/nga tsho'i na chung blo mthun de 'das song /mchan 'grel/phyiro'u hri (rsā71901—1931) kye cang zhing chen nying he'i mi yin/ gung khran tang yon yin/ 1928lo'i mgor hrang ter phebs nas gsar brje'i rtsom rig las 160

'gul spel/ (gtam tshogs 〉 dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i 'gan khur/ sku zhabs lu'u zhun dang mnyam du (khra'o hwa hre 〉zhes pa bsgrubs/ 1930lo'i mabor rang mos 'gul skyod mna' 'brel tshogs pa sasar 'dzugs byas/ 1930lo'i zla sasum par krung so'i go yon phyogs rtsom mkhan 'brel tshogs gsar du btsugs shing / khong bis rgyun las u yon dang rtsom sgrig du 'u kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ lo de'i zla lnga bar g.yon phyogs 'brel tshogs kyi tshab byas nas rgyal yongs su'u we ed sa khul 'thus mi tshogs chen la zhugs/1931lo'i zla dang ngo ra hrang ter 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin go min tang log spyod pas lkog tu bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di 1930lo'i zla 10tshes 23nyin gyi 'jigs pa'i mtshan mor bris/du0 5zhes pa ni gung gzhon tshogs pa'i dbyin yig gi bsdus ming yin/

dbyin sbosakhrag yigakhrag gis bris pa'i yig chen zung /khu'inan cing lam du 'phred nyal byed//brjed par dka' ba'i nyin mo des//lo re'i dus 'dir mya ngan byin//khrag gis bris pa'i yig chen des//skye bo mang po'i 'bod sgra mtshon//brjed par dka' ba'i nyin mo des//kun gyi sems la khong khro bslangs//khrag gis bris pa'i yig chen des//'gal 'thab brgyud rim gsal bor bkod//brjed par dka' ba'i nyin mo der//ngan rengs re zung gad mo 'chor//lnga ba'i sum cu'i nyin mo ang khyayar bzhengs nan cing lam du skyod//khyod kyi khrag gi zer snang de nyid nam mkha'i mthar yang spros shig kye//162

khyod kyi dpa' zhing rtul ba'i rnam 'gyur hong phu'u gtsang bo'i ngos la phob//khyod kyi 'brug sgra lta bu'i lung bstan sgra yis 'jig rten sgul gyur cig/de ring kho tsho'i lha yul yin yang //sang nyin kho tsho'i dmyal khams yin//de ring nga tsho'i khrag gis yig chen bris//phyi nyin kho tsho'i sdug mchi mtsho ltar 'khyil//nga ni dad log gi thog ma yin//nga ni lo rgyus kyi bu chen yin//nga ni rgya mtsho'i khug rta yin//nga ni dus rabs kyi mdung rtse yin//zla 'di 'khon lan slog pa'i khrims sgor gyur cig/tshes 'di dgra nag 'tshud byed kyi gzeb tu gyur cig/zla 'di tho dang zor ba'i rnam par gyur cig/tshes 'di dgra ngan gtor ba'i skyogs su gyur cig/lo bzhi yi khrag rgyun bran pas sbags//khrag yig gnyis kyi zer snang nyams par rigs//mi khri stong mang po'i ngar sgra 'brug ltar ldir//zla tshes 'di da lta nyid nas yal bar rigs//163

mchan /zlon/ hphu (7( 1909 1931) kre cang zhing chen zhang hran gyi mi yin/gung khran tang yon dang krung go'i 'byor med gral rim gyi snyan ngas pa phul byung can yin/1928lo nas bzung sngon thon dus deb 〈〈rbab chu 〉〉dang 〈〈le nyin gzhon nu 〉〉gnyis kyi steng du gsar brje'i snyan tshig spel/ 1929lo nas bzung tang gi mgo 'dren 'og tu na gzhon bzo pa'i las 'gul gyi bya ba bsgrubs te thengs 'gar 'dzin bzung thebs/ btson nas bud rjes mu mthud du gsar brje'i bya ba bsgrubs/ 1930lo'i zla gsum pa ra krung bo g.yon phyogs pa'i rtsom mkhan 'brel tshogs btsugs ma thag kho ni de 'phral tshogs par zhugs/ zla lnga par g.yon phyogs rtsom tshogs kyi tshab byas nas rgyal yongs su'u we ed sa khul gyi 'thus mi tshogs chen la zhugs/ 1931lo'i zla dang por hrang ter 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin bkrongs/0yikhrag yig gnyis zhes pa ni zla lnga ba'i tshes sum cu nyin de rgya yig tu 31 zhes yig 'bru gnyis la bsdus pas na de skad du brjod pa dang / khrag yis zer don ni drag gnon gyi khrag gis sbags pa'i nyin mo/ yin pas na de skad du brjod pa'o//()lnga pa'i sum cu nyin ni go min tang gsar brjer blo log nas phong ter gsar brje pa drag gnon byas pas phyis su nyin mo de lnga pa'i sum cu'i khrag gyod kyang zer/164

yo'u dbyang li yan snyan tshig tshan pa gcigs steng thog khang yod tshad su yis bzhengs//de ru bsdad de gad mo dgod mkhan su//de yi sgo drung khyi bzhin srung mkhan gang //bzo pa'i don du brtson pa de su zhig/sa steng thog khang yod tshad bzo pas bzhengs//ma rtsa can ni bsdad nas gad mo dgod//go min tang gis sgo drung khyi bzhin srung //gung khran tang gis bzo pa'i don du brtson//mchan 'grel/ཿo'u dbyang li an (a/tha401914 1931) dbyang go hwa zhes kyang 'bod/ hu'u nan zhing chen khrang hra'i mi yin/ gung khran tang yon yin/ snga phyir gung gzhon cang su'u zhing u'i u yon dang hrang he spyi'i bzo tshogs kyi na gzhon pu'u krang /rgyal spyi'i na gzhon bzo pa 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi bcas kyi 'gan khur myong /1931lo'i zla dang por hrang her 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin lung hwar bkrongs/165

yun te dbyinakhyabatson khang du bris pa/'gro 'dug nges med dus kyi grogs po dran/khu'ishi gson gnyis gas nyams med mdzad rjes bzhag/rang gi bde sdug rtsis med gnas su bzhag/btson rar btsud kyang spobs pa gzengs su mtho//mchan 'grel/duyun te dbyin (sgo shursā18/ 5 1931) cang su'u zhing chen wu'u cin gyi mi yin/ gtam dang rtsom gnyis ka la mkhas/ 6 lnga bzhi las 'gul skabs su wu'u han slob ma'i las 'gul gyi mgo 'dren pa yin/ krung go gung khran tang btsugs rjes tang la zhugs/ 1923lor krung go gung gzhon tshogs pa'i u yon du bdams/ snga phyir gung gzhin tshogs pa'i dril bsgrags pu'u krang dang 〈〈krung go'i na gzhon 〉〉dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i 'gan khur/ 1926lor hong phu'u dmag dpon slob grwa'i chab srid khrid dpon gyi 'gan khur/ 1927lor krung go gung khran tang gi thengs lnga pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen krung dbyang u yon du bdams/ lo der snga phyir nan khrang thos langs dang kong krig 'os langs la zhugs/ 1928lo'i rjes tang krung dbyang dril bsgrags pu'u nang du bya ba bsgrubs/ 1930lor hrang ter 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1931lo'i zla bzhi bar nan cin du go min tang gis bkrongs/()'gro 'dug nges med dus zhes pa ni rtsom pa pos gsar brje'i don du gnas nges med kyis bya ba sgrub pa'i skabs de la bstan pa yin/166

than hri'u linakhyabazo ba'i glu/bzo bo'i dka' sdug bzod glags med//bzo grwa'i sgo them spos nyid nas//rkang dang lag pa sos dal med//ma rtsa can gyis mnar gcod byed//stag spyang bzhin du gdug cing rtsub//las ku'i chu tshod bcu gnyis yin//gla phogs nyung zhing rin thang chung // gong gi pha ma skyong thabs bral//zhabs kyi bu phrug kha mi sos//dka' sdug spyad pa'i 'bras bu dag/gzhan gyis khyer ba snying re rje//da lta nyi ma shar nas 'phags//gsar brje'i dar cha rlung gis skyod//bzo bo spun zla mthun sgril gyis//'bad brtson byas te bcings 'grol brtson//zas yod tshang mas mnyam bza' byed//hur thag byas nas gdong la mchongs//167
