nga yi lta ba dang du longs//gla phogs 'phar snon las yun thung //'tsho ba legs bcos byed pa gal//mchan /sna zo/ 'u lin ( zlolko1896 1931) kong zhi zhing chen kos zhan gyi mi yin/ 1923lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing / krung gung kong zhi zhing chen wu'u krig dmigs bsal khul u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur myong / 1927lor rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po pham rjes 'dzin bzung thebs/ btson las grol rjes rang yul du log nas zhing ba'i las 'gul spel/ cang ma 'gyangs par kong khrig tu song nas kong krig 'os langs la zhugs pas slar yang 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1928lor btson grol byung rjes hrang her song nas snga phyir rgyal yongs mtsho las bzo tshogs kyi drung yig chen mo dang rgyal yongs spyi'i bzo tshogs kyi drung yig chen mo'i 'gan khur/1931lor hrang ter yang bskyar 'dzin bzung thebs/ lo de'i zla lnga ba'i tshes sum cu nyin nan cing du bkrongs/168

tsha'o ho sen na gzhon rgyang du skyod pab—byang skyod lam bar du byung thing brgyud skabs kyi 'char snang /'brug sbrul snol mar 'dzing ba'i nor 'dzin dbus/khyan tshod gzhon pa'i blo ldan mchog cig mchi/60yul gru stod smad zang zing 'khrug pas gzir//rlung char dang bsdebs rgyang spyod gru gzings brdzangs/khya'ajig rten 'di ko bden rdzun 'byed dka' yang //rang blo mi rmongs rig pa'i gnas la brtson//rgyang ring yul gyi bshes gnyen zhabs la gtugakhronyeshes ldan dbus su yid gcugs grogs por mjal/khronyergyal khab skyob par rang rigs skye bo mang //gsar brje'i 'gan 'khri phrag pa gshibs nas theg/blo sems dkar po lhad med gshis kyis mtshon//drang bden spobs pas gnam sa 'degs par byed//lu'u dbyang lta bu'i nus pa med na yang /khya'akhrug zing zhi bar byed pa'i brtson pa bskyed//yul dus gnas tshul 'gyur ldog rab brtags nas//blo stobs chen pos dmangs sems skul slong byed//169

than krig blo ldan skye bos mdzes par brgyan/(kyetung thing mtsho mor rin chen 'dus pa mtshon/khrokhyamachan 'grel/dutsha'i ho sen (lkokṣarsā1895 1931) hu'u nan zhing chen shang zhang gi mi yin/ 1918lor blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis dmangs gsar slob tshogs mi btsugs pa la khong ni tshogs mi'i gtso bo'i gras yin/ 1919lor hpha ran sir brtson bsri slob gnyer la phebs shing de ru bzo slob 'dzam gling mthun tshogs btsugs/ 1921lor phyir log nas krung gung krung dbyang du bya ba bsgrubs/ 1922lor krung dbyang u yon du bdams shing snga phyir tang krung dbyang gi las khungs tshags par 〈〈lam sna 〉stanas pa'i spyi khyab rtsom sgrig pa dang krung dbyang chab srid cus kyi u yon/ 1931lor krung dbyang gi 'thus tshab byas te zhang kung du phebs nas kong krig gi tang gi bya bar bslab ston gnang /mi ring bar dbyin btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bzung ste kong krig la btsan khrid byas shing go min tang log spyod pas khong gi yan lag bzhi bo so sor brgyangs te 'dzer mas rtsig ngor brdabs thog khog pa gshags nas ngan gsod byas te bkrongs/6)1918lor blo mthun ma'o tse tung dang tsha'i ho sen gnyis kyis hu'u nan du dmangs gsar slob tshogs kyi tshogs 'du bsdus thog tshang mas blo mthun tsha'o ho sen pe cing du gnas tshul brtag par phebs dgos pa'i gros gzhi bton pas/1918lo'i zla drug pa'i nang du khong mtsho grur bsdad nas tung thing brgyud de pe cin la phyin/ snyan rtsom 'di ni de dus brtsams skad/()'brug sbrul snol mar 'dzing ba zhes pa ni skabs der rgyal nang du chab srid phyogs khag rnam pa sna tshogs yod pa bstan/6)'dir na gzhon blo ldan zhes pa ni rtsom pa po rang nyid la bstan/durgyang skyod gru gzings zhes pa ni blo mthun tsha'i ho sen pe cin du skyod skabs sdod pa'i gru gzings la bstan pa yin/()rgyang ring yul gyi bshes gnyen zhes pa ni de dus pe cin du bzhugs pa'i dge 170

rgonadabyang khrang cis zhes pa de bstan pa yin te/ dbyang lags ni de snga hu'u nan du bzhugs skabs ma'o tse tung dang tsham ho sen gnyis kyi dge rgan yin/ma tshon dushes ldan dbus zhes pa ni pe cin du shes ldan skyes bu mang po bzhugs pa de ()lu'u dbyang zhes pa ni gna'i kran go skabs kyi mi zhig yin/ de la han rgyal khab kyi dmas la 'thab nas nyi ma nub la nye bar khos lag gi mtshon cha gnam la ker bas nyi ma yang rgyang grag gsum gyi sa ru phyir nur byas skad/duthan krig ces pa ni da lta'i grong khyer khrang hra la bstan pa yin/ tshig 'di ni skabs der khrang hra na ma'o tse tung gtso byas pa'i shes ldan mang po bzhugs pa'i don/(yitshig 'di'i don ni tung thing mtsho rngo/ zab la rgya che bas nor bu la sogs rin po che ma nga po 'dus yod pa mtshon pa dpe de bzhin du skabs der hu'u nan na blo mthun ma'o tshe tung gtso byas pa'i dmangs gsar slob tshogs kyi shes ldan mang ngo yod pa dang de dag la dad pa'i gzhon nu'ang mang po yod pa shugs kyis bstan to//

dbyang pha'o yanakhro)btson khang du bris pa'i snyan tshig②zhum med 'khor lor bsdad de byon/khro)shi yang brtul phod rang gshes brtan//kha gtad dgra dpung thu drags pas//tshe 'dir zhen pa'i sems shugs nyams//krang can 'khyams pa'i brtul zhugs bzung /khro)khru'u yon spyod pa skyong la khrel/khronyegrogs rnams gtan 'bral byed pa la//ma skyo blo bag phebs par mdzod//mchanahu //sdung/ pha'o an (7701896 1931) kong tung zhing chen krung hran gyi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon yin/ 1927lor tang gi skabs lnga pa'i 'thus mi tshogs chen steng krung dbyang u yon du bdams/ 1931lor 'dzin bzung thebs shing cang ma 'gror bar dgra bos bkrongs/6yisnyan tshig 'di ni blo mthun dbyang pa'o an gshegs khar btson grogs la bris te phul ba yin/du'akhor lor bsdad ces pa ni rtsom pa po rang nyid dgra bos 'dzin bzung byas pa la blo spu tsam yang ma zhum par ngang ba pad mtshor 'jug pa bzhin dgra bo'i rlangs 'khor nang du bsdad pa'i dpa' nyams bstan pa'i don/6)krang can zhes pa ni han shar ma'i dus kyi mi yin/ de snga shar phyogs zhib bsher 172

dpon po'i 'gan khur skabs/ dpon ngan nyig lan gyis khrims 'gal lugs 'gal gyi bya ngan mang po bsgrubs pa'i nyes skyon la zhib bsher byas pas/ hig khros te phyir krang can la bsnyon btsugs mthar krang can 'u thug ste bros byol mi byed thabs med byung / 'dir rtsom pa pos rang nyid krang can bzhin du gnas nges med du bros byol byas kyang 'dzin bzung thebs tshul bstan/༷khru'u yon zhes pa ni sung rgyal rabs skabs kyi mi ste/ mgo bde dran 'phrul la mkhas shing blo mi brtan pa zhig yin pas phyi rabs pa'i khrel gzhir 'dzin/ 'dir rtsom pa pos rang phyogs kyi nang nas dgra la mgo btags pa'i blo log pa la bstan/

rtseng la'ekhyasnyan tshig tshan pa bzhi/dpyid/dpyid slebs me tog mtshar sdug bkra//'on kyang 'bras kyi khug ma stong //dpyid ston rol ba'i dga' ba nyams//bzo zhing blo mthun 'tsho dgos na//dmag shed can rnams rtsa rdzogs dgos//yul gyi gshed ma gtsang phyags byed//blo mthun tsho/ sems thag chod/dpa' bskyed sngon la skyod//gsar brje'i bya gzhag chen po de//mi 'gyangs myur du 'grub par 'gyur//dbyar/dbyar dus zhing kha'i lo tog ser ldem ldem//zo stong ting sgra grags//'tshos 'bras bza' bar re//dmag shed can dag gdug rtsub che//174

khral dang 'u lag rnam grangs mang //btsan gyis dmag la bskul cing sdud//'bru rigs khyer/khral bogs 'bebs/'khyer 'phrog bcom gsum 'dzoms//bltas byin bltas kyin/'phrog nas tshar song //ston/ston zlar shing tsha'i me tog dri zhim ldang //dmag shed can gyis dmag 'khrugs bslangs//mi dmangs yongs la sdug bsngal bzos//gshed ma grong la rgyu ba'i tshe//'degs 'gyogs 'khor g.yog btsan gyis khrid//nyal rogs mdzes ldan bu mo 'gugs//rjes mthun khas len ma song tshe/mde'u gcig gis ni//mi rtag lam la brdzangs//dgun/dgun dus kha ba bu lug 'tshub//lo mjug rdzogs la nye ba'i tshe//175

blo sems bde ba'i bya thabs bral//bu phrug 'khyags ltogs zung gis mnar//gyon pa gta' mar mnan//'bru rigs gcig kyang med//bun bdag sgo khar slebs//bya thabs ci zhig lags//yar langs gsar brje byed//thar lam gzhi nas rnyed//mchan 'grel/༷tseng la'e ( lko1899 1931) zi khron zhing chen rong zhan gyi mi yin/rgyal nang gsar brje thengs dang po pham rjes/ snga phyir rong zhan/ ne cang / leng hran sogs su zhing pa'i las 'gul la mgo 'dren byas shing / re zhig la khrun chin grong khyer gyi tang gi gsang ba'i bya ba bsgrubs/ glu tshig 'di ni1929lor rtsom pa pos ne cang du zhing pa'i las 'gul spel sgang la bris skad/ 1931lor leng hran lte gnas rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan 'khur skabs nang rul pas lkog tu bkrongs/176

ku'u bong lo'ukhyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcigalo mang gnas yul nges med 'khyams kyang bzod//dka' sdug grangs med brgyud kyang dpa' mi zhum//phrag gi 'gan 'khri ri rab bzhin du ljid//thams cad bzo zhing bcings 'grol bya ba'i don//mchan 'grel/༷ku'u kong lo'u (teyi 1887 1932) kong tung zhing chen wu'u hwa'i mi yin/ 1927lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs 'phral kong tung te lu'u gleng zhing pa'i drag po'i 'os langs la zhugs shing gtsang shar dmar dmag cun bcu gcig pa'i dmag rjas mkho sprod khru'u yi khru'u krang gi 'gan khur myong / 1932lor 'dzin bzung thebs shing cang ma 'gor bar bkrongs/177

brang can kren5)rang srog gtong kha'i gluyitshang mas nga ni gung khran yin par bshad//shi yang krang ci'u hwa la gnyen mi 'dzin/khu)dkar nag dbye ba nam zhig gsal bar 'gyur//me tog rnying tshab gsar ba bzhad par nges//mchan 'grel/dhikrang can kren (lko //71911— 1931) kong tung zhing chen wu'u hwa rdzong ko hwa'i mi yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i skabs su sa de ga'i dril bsgrags mkhan byas myong / phyis su 'dzin bzung thebs shing bkrongs/tu'iglu tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po gshegs khar blangs skad/()krang ci'u hwa zhes pa ni sa de ga'i log spyod gte bo zhig gi ming yin/179

we mākhrokyerang srog gtong kha'i grubasmyug gling 'bud cing me mda' bzung //dmag mi mang pos gshin rdzong byed/khyadapon po mang pos bsnyen bkur byas//shi yang 'gyod med spro dga' 'phel//mchanahu ༷bye ṭwāṃ /(ma ) kong tung zhing chen wu'u hwa'i mi yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i byeswārnyi kāddhiX ༷ngas dang po'i skabs su gsar brjer zhugs/ phyis dgra bos 'dzin bzung 0yiglu tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos gshegs khar blangs skad/()tshig 'di gnyis kyi don ni rtsom pa po gsod rar khrid skabs dmag mi mang pos me mda' bzung nas mthar bskor te khrid pa ni rgya'i lugs srol ltar gshin po'i bam ro dur khar skyel ma zhu ba dang mtshungs zhes 'phyas pa'i don no//180

kra'o po hreng lpagasar brje'i snying stobs bstod pa'i glu/gdong len gyis dang gdong len gyis//khrag dron chu ltar khol la ltos//'dra mnyam ched du rang srog gtong //mi'i rigs bcings 'grol mgon po byed//rna ba ring du glags pa na//ljongs 'dir 'khyags ltogs 'o dod sgras//gdong len rtogs pa sad gyur te//rang gi bde sdug yal bar dor//rgyal khab ma nyams gnas gyur na//shi yang don dang ldan par 'gyur//snying stobs ji srid nyams mi 'gyur//yid kyi dmigs pa mngon du 'gyur//'dzam gling zhi mthun yong bar 'gyur//mchanabye /zlo po/ hreng (sa 41897 1933) ho pe zhing chen hong hwa'i mi yin/1931lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ dmar dmag cun thon lnga ba'i tshan mo'u krang dang cun bcu bzhi pa'i cun krang gi 'gan gcig lcogs su khur myong / 1933lo'i zla dang por cang zhir cang ce hri'i 6skor bcom la 'gog rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug nang du gshegs/181

stong limibazo pa'i sdugabyang rlung 'ur 'ur g.yug pa 'tshub//bza' snod bzung nas sgo la rgyugs//rgyugs kyin bzo grwar brtol ma gyur//kyi hud/ kyi hud/rgyugs kyin bzo grwar brtol ma gyur//gzhung lam 'ga' zhig brgal nas rgyugs//rkang pa'i nywa zung sbrid par gyur//'phyis pas bzo grwa'i sgo yang brgyab//kyi hud/ kyi hud/de ring gla phogs chad pas 'khyer//mchan 'grel/ཿhong li (rsā71905 1933) hu'u nan zhing chen khrang pho'i mi yin/1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1928lor 'jar man gyi po lin grong khyer du 'dzam gling btsan rgol mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ 1931lor tang gis kho mo hrang her mngags nas bzo pa'i bya ba bsgrubs/ 1933lor cang su'u zhing chen rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang gi 'gan khur/ de lor blo log pas gsang brtol bas 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga nyin nan cing du bkrongs/182

teng krung 'khyatung thing mtsho la brgal ba/ngos yangs tung thing mtsho mo la//nyin lnga'i nang du thengs gnyis brgal//rlabs kyi zegs ma mkha' la 'phyo//'jigs rung gdod 'dre khros pa bzhin//deng gi 'jig rten mi yul 'dir//'tshang kha rgyag pa'i ce spyang tshogs//rngon pa bzhin du tshar gcod pa//nga yi lhad med rang lugs yin//ngos yangs tung thing mtsho mo la//nyin lnga'i nang du thengs gnyis brgal//nub kha'i nyi zer mtsho ngor 'phros//mtshams sprin dmar po'i dpal 'bar sgron//deng gi 'jig rten mi yul 'dir//gung khran dbul phyug snyoms par byed//rang lta tshul bzhin skyong ba ni//nga yi lhad med rang lugs yin//mchanahu ༷/3/krung zhwa (sdu'i za1894 1933) hu'u nan zhing chen dbyi krang gi mi 183

yin/ 6 lnga bzhi'i ri las 'gul skabs su mar le ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i rtogs pa sad cing bzo pa'i las 'gul gyi bya ba bsgrubs/ 1922lor krung dbyang u yon du bdams shing / krung go'i ngal rtsol sgrig 'dzugs hru'u ci pu'u yi kru'u rin dang / krung go'i gung gzhon tshogs pa'i rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang / rgyal yongs spyi'i bzo tshogs kyi las 'dzin u yon/ krung gung cang su'u zhing u'i hru'u ci/ kong tung zhing u'i hru'u ci/ spyi'i bzo tshogs kyi dmar ba'i bzo tshogs rgyal spyi'i 'thus tshab/ dmar ba'i bzo tshogs rgyal spyi'i las 'dzin u yon/ krung gung zhang o'i zhing u gnyis kyi u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur myong /1933lo'i zla lnga par hrang ter 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla bcu bar nan cing du bkrongs/

ci byung khrang lparang srog gtong kha'i snyan tshigadzoljar 'gog slad du ma shi phangs//de ring gson pa ngo tsha'i rgyu//rgyal khab 'thor zhing zhig pa na//rang srog 'di yis ci zhig bya//mchanabye bye lhang/ khrang (lha loṣṭha 1895 1934) ho nan zhing chen hphu ko'u yi mi yin/lo bcu drug nas bzung dmag dpon hpheng lus zhang gi mnga' 'og tu dmag mi dkyus ma/ zhig nas rim par gnas 'phar te cun nyer gcig pa'i cun krang gi 'gan khur/ gung khran tang gi slob gso las blo bskyed thob ste gsar brjer ngo rgol byed ma 'dod par las 'khyur dgongs pa zhus kyang ma gnang / 1931lor phyi gling rgyal khab khag tu gzigs skor la phebs/ 1932lor phyir log ste dmag dpung 'os langs byas kyang pham/1933lor tsha su'e dmangs tshogs ljar 'gog mna' mthun dmag dpung cun gnyis pa'i cung krang gi 'gan khur/ 1934lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1934lo'i zla bcu gcig par then cin du 'dzin bzung thebs/ cang ma 'gor bar bkrongs/6)snyan tshig 'di ni dgra pos gsod rar khrid skabs/ rtsom pa pos sa nas shing thur zhig blangs te sa ru shar mar bris skad/185

zhu'u ru'e thang khyazhing pa'i dngan pa/zhing pa dka' zhing sdug/zhogs par snga langs kyis//mtshan mo'i nam phyed bar//zhing khar 'phru ba slog/nyi ma'i tsha gdug gis//lus yongs rngul chus sbags//char rlung drag na yang //zhing khar 'bral thabs med//than pas gnod dogs nas//mtshan mor gnyid kyang bcag/lo yag byung na yang //phyed ka bogs la sprad//zor ba nyar nyid nas//bogs gtong khyim tshang btsal//dpyid kur zas chad pas//'tsho ba 'khyol thabs bral//dpon dmag bogs 'ded du//yang yang sgo khar slebs//yul dmag 'dod dgu byed//186

dpon dmag mi khral sdud//'dzin bzung thebs pa'i mi'i//skyabs 'jug phan ma gyur//sgrib g.yogs lwa med pas//lhan pas lhan pa brtsegs//gu dog khang khyim dag/phar yo tshur yom byed//'bras kyi skyo ma yis//pho ba 'grang dus med//bu phrug nar son yang //slob sbyong skal ba dben//rkang la lham med ces//gzhan gyis brnyas bcos byed//tshe 'dir dka' spyad pa//thams cad gzhan don gyur//yar langs byed dgos na//'gro lam 'tshol ba gal//gzhan la brten dgos med//tshang ma mthun sgril gces//log pa'i dpya khral 'gog/zhum med 'thab rtsod byed//so sor las ka thob//kun la bde skyid ldan/187

mchanabye /zlo ru/ 'e hphang (/ spro (1905 1934) cang zhi zhing chen khrun rin gyi mi yin/ 1926lor krung go gung khrin tang la zhugs/ 1929lor lin khron rdzong du zhing pa'i las 'gul spel te gsar brje'i drag dpung bsgrigs/ cang ce hri gsar brjer blo log rjes/ dkar po'i 'jigs skrag 'og tu 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas/ phyis su zhing pa'i drag dpung la mgo 'dren byas nas nan khrang 'os langs la zhugs shing / de'i rjes dmag dpung dang mnyam du lho 'dul dmag skyod la zhugs/ 1929lo'i dgun krung dbyang su'u khul du bya ba bsgrubs/ 1930lor dmar dmag cun bzhi ba'i hri bcu ba'i dril bsgrags la'o krang gi 'gan khur/ 1934lor rgyang skyod la zhugs shing lam bar du rang srog blos btang ba'o//

stong kri gleng /rjosnyan tshig tshan pa gcibatatrepho rab phyi byes rgyal don gnyer//lag rjes ma thon phyir mi ldog/gar gnas skye yul nyid dang mtshungs//rus pa gang la gtor kyang chog/mchanadzu ba/zlo kri/ gleng (7751891— 1934) kong zhi then dbyang gi krong rigs shig yin/ 1928lo'i zla bcu bar krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing snga phyir yug cang dmar srung ru khag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dang / dmar dmag cun bdun pa'i hri nyi shu ba'i hri krang gzhon pa dang tshan mu'u khru'u krang gi 'gan khur/ 1934lor krung dbyang su'u khul nas lug cang du phyir log pa'i lam bar du stabs ma legs par rgo min tang log spyod pas bkrongs/6)snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos ljar pan gyi snyan ngag pa zhis zhang lung zin gyis brtsams pa'i snyan tshig cig bzo bcos byas te bris skad/189

ho hru'u nyeng khyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcibatatregos la rgyang skyod rdul dang dri ma chags//gnas yul nges med bla yang 'khyams pa bzhin//tshe 'dir rang khyim bor ba'i ldom por gyur//char rlung khrod du grur brten phyi la 'grim/khyamachanahu rashā /'u/ heng (77mi1875 1935) hu'u nan zhing chen nying zhang sga mi yin/ 1918lor blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis 6 dmangs gsar slob tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byed skabs/ khong ni tshogs mi gtso gras yin/ 1921lo'i zla bdun par hu'u nan gyi tshab byas te krung go gung khun tang bi rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang por zhugs/ 1921lo nas 1923bar tang gis khrang phor 6 hu'u nan rang sbyong slob chen dang 6 zhang cang slob grwa btsugs pa'i tshe khong ni gtso 'dzin gyi gras yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i rjes su tang gis khong su'u len la slob sbyong byed par mngags/ phyir log rjes krung dbyang su'u khul du bya ba bsgrubs shing / krung dbyang bzo zhing dmang gtso srid gzhung gi u yon gyi 'gan khur/ 1934lor krung dbyang dmar dmag rgyang skyod byas rjes/ khong dang blo mthun chus chig pa'i sogs gnas gzhi sa khul du bsdad nas 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas/ 1935lo'i zla gnyis par spru can zhing chen khrang ting gtsang po'i nye 'gram du dgra bos bskor te bkrongs/6)snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos 1928lor mo zi kho la skyod pa'i lam bar du har pin brgyud pa'i skabs su bris skad/du'adi ni tang gis rtsom pa po rang nyid mo zi khor slob sbyong du mngags pa bstan/190

li'u po jan0rkang lag sgrog bzhin skyod pa/rkang lag sgrog bzhin sung la skyod//gom pa 'khyar 'khyor 'khyar 'khyor gda'/ mi rnams ce rer tshur la bltas//nga yi sems la nongs pa med//rkang lag sgrog bzhin srang la skyod//sgrog gi sgra dbyangs sing sing grag/mi rnams ha las 'jigs shing skrag/nga ni blo bag bde zhing 'jags//rkang lag sgrog bzhin srang la skyod//spobs pa ma nyams gzengs su mtho//de ring gzhan gyi btson byed pa//bzo zhing bcings 'grol ched du yin//mchan 'grel/tshuli'u po jan (7)482/ 1900 1935) zi khron zhing chen nan khron gyi mi yin/ 1923lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1924lor su'u len du slob sbyong la phebs/ 1926lor phyir log rjes nub byang dmag dpung gi hphing yus zhang mnga' 'og tu spyi khyab chab srid pu'u yi kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ 1927lor slar yang su'u len dmag 191

srid slob chen la slob sbyong du phebs/ 1930lor phyir log rjes krung dbyang su'u khul du bya ba bsgrubs/ krung dbyang bzo zhing dmangs gtso srid gzhung gi las 'dzin u yon du bdams/ 1931lor dmar dmag cun thon lnga pa'i chab srid pu'u yi kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ 1934lor krung dbyang dmar dmag rgyang skyod byed skabs/ gnas gzhi sa khul du bsdad nas 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas te cang zhi zhing chen lho phyogs mtha' khul gyi chab srid pu'u kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ 1935lo'i zla gsum par 'thab 'khrug nang du rmas phog ste 'dzin bzung thebs shing cang ma 'gor bar bkrongs/

chus tshig pa'ekhyarba rlabs dmar po'i glu dbyangs9rba rlabs dmar po dgung la 'phyo//zhogs pa'i mtshams sprin 'du 'god 'khrigs//lo rabs stong phrag lnga lhag gis/ma sangs gnyid stug gdod nas bslangs//shar phyogs gna' bo'i rgyal khab 'dir//dung phyur phrag bzhi'i skye 'gro'i tshogs//mgrin pa'i sgra dbyangs lam gcig gis//ngal rtsol mchog tu bstod cing bsngags//drag tu rgol dang drag tu rgol//btsan rgyal ring lugs ngan dgu gtor//zhum med skyod dang zhum med skyod//mi ser spel yul mi dmangs te//dkar nag ser gsum bran g.yog rnams/khyabacings pa nyid las sgrol cig dang //da nas bde skyid glu sgra ni//'dzam gling kun tu khyab pa dang //mthun 'gyur chen pos dpal yon spel//193

ltos dang dge mtshan snang bas khyab//mchanahu ༷/zlo chi/ ga pa'i (ṣṭhaṣṭha 1899 1935) cang su'u zhing chen khrang krig gi mi yin/ 1922lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing / tang gi snga rabs mgo 'dren pa'i gras yin/ 1923lo nas 1928lo'i bar krung go gung khran tang rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs gsum pa nas drug pa'i thog bstud mar krung dbyang u yon du bdams shing/ krung gung krung dbyang gi hru'u ci dang gung khran rgyal spyi'i las 'dzin u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang kru'u zhi tshogs pa'i u yon gyi 'gan khur myong / 1931lo nas1933lor phong ter sku zhabs lu'u zhun la mnyam 'brel gyis gsar brje'i rig gnas las 'gul la mgo 'dren mdzad/ 1933lo'i mgor krung dbyang gnas gzhi'i sa khul du log nas krung dbyang bzo zhing dmangs gtso srid gzhung gi mi dmangs slob gso'i u yon gyi 'gan khur/ 1934lo'i zla bcu bar krung dbyang dmar dmag rgyang skyod byas rjes/ gnas gzhi sa khul du bsdad nas 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyodas byas/ 1935lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer lnga nyin spru can zhing chen khrang ting rdzong du go min tang log spyod pas 'dzin bzung byas shing zla drug pa'i nang sa de ru bkrongs/6)snyan tshig 'di ni ma gzhir glu tshig tu brtsams pa dang / de la rol dbyangs kyang bsdebs myong skad/rjodakar nag ser gsum zhes pa ni 'dzam gling 'dir dkar nag ser gsum gyi sha mdangs mi 'dra ba'i mi rigs mang po yod par bstan/194

thang kri minakhyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcibasti)dgra bos rin chen mgo bo gcod kyang bla//'on kyang nga tsho'i dad 'dun sgyur mi nus//nga tshos dad 'dun byed pa'i ring lugs de//snang srid kun la khyab pa'i bden don yin//gung khran ring lugs slad du srog 'dor zhing //su'u we ed kyi ched du khrag 'don pa//nga tshos snying nas dga' mos byed yul yin//mchan 'grel/meglang kri min (lha 71900 1935) cang zhi zhing chen dbyis dbyang gi mi yin/ 1922lor krung go spyi tshogs ring lugs na gzhon tshogs par zhugs/1923lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir cang zhi zhing chen zhing pa'i mthun tshogs kyi drung yig chen mo dang / srin kro kun zhing chen gyi su'u we ed srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi/ dmar dmag cun bzhi pa'i chab srid u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1928lor krung go gung khran tang rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs drug pa'i steng krung dbyang u yon du bdams/ 1931lor rgyal yongs su'u we ed 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i thog krung dbyang bzo zhing dmangs gtso srid gzhung gi las 'dzin u yon du bdams/1934lor dmar dmag ljar 'gog sngon mngags ru khag khrid de rgyang skyod byas/1935lo'i zla dang por kro wan kun sa mtshams su go min tang log spyod dmag dpung dang 'phrad de 'thab 'dzing byed skabs blo log pas gsang brtol bas 'dzin bzung thebs/195
:thanasgo'i

thang we 'khyaslob gtso khung kro hrig gi snyan ngag la bsdebs palhomakhar lhor dka' spyad slob sgrub bcu phrag 'da'//rdo ring tshal bur klog bzhin gna' mi dran/khyad cha ston zla'i dkyil 'bor rdzogs pa'i mod//kru'u krang zhal 'dzoms gru khar rgyang lta byed/lpagazhon dus kru'u rong ri rtser lhan du 'dzeg mnyam cig sdod dus dgon pa'i cong sgra gsan//brtses bskyangs phyogs med mkhas ldan slob ma'i tshogs//gser rir thun mtshams sprin gyis mdzes pa bzhin//mkhar lhor bzhugs nas lo 'khor brgyad tsam 'das//skra tshogs dkar por bsgos kyang blo ma 'gyur//de snga'i gus zhabs khang gi cong sgra ni//ston khar dwangs gsal rna ba'i gsos su 'jo//me'o na'o ri rtser shes ldan tshogs 'dus kyang /khyachag sgo'i rjes kyi cong sgra thos par dka'//skyid sdug 'du 'bral khyed dang mnyam gcig tu//197

nam zhig las gnas gsar ba gtad par rangs/khronyemachan 'grel/duphong we thā (33444 1879 1935) hu'u nan zhing chen phin cang gi mi yin/ 1924lor krung bo gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1926lor byang 'dul dam ga dpung bi hri zhig ri tang bi las tshab pa'i 'gan khur/ 1927lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin nan khrang 'os langs la zhugs/ kong krig drag po'i 'os langs rjes su tang krung dbyang nas kho rang su'u len krung hran slob grwa chen rngo ra slob sbyong du mngags/1931lor phyir log rjes men zhi'i dmar dmag slob grwa'i chab srid pu'u kru'u rin dang krung dbyang dmangs btso srid gzhung i spyi gnyer thin krang / cang zhi zhing chen dam/ngas gtso srid gzhung gi slob gso zin krang / zhang kun zhing chen dmangs gtso srid gzhung gi slob gso thin krang / khrims gcod pu'u krang sogs kyi 'gan khur/ 1934lor dmar dam ga ljar 'gog rgyang skyod byas rjes rtsom pa pos zhang rkos sa khul du nges med 'jab rgol dam/ga 'khrug rgyun 'khyongs byas/ phyis blo log pas gsang brtol bas go min tang log spyod pas bkrongs/②khung kro hrig ni de snga hu'u nan zhing chen dge thon slob grwa dang po'i slob gtso yin/gzhung drang zhing g.yo sgyu med pas khor yug gis mnar nas ma bzod par las 'khyur byas shing (mkhar lhor zhal gyes 〉 zhes pa'i snyan ngag cig bris te dge grogs dang slob ma rnams la gnang ba la rtsom pa pos 'di brtsams te ched du bsdebs pa yin no//du'adir gna' mi zhes pa ni sung lho ma'i dus kyi mkhas can krang hri zhes pa de la bstan pa yin te/ krang hri zhes pa des de snga mkhar lho'i gtsug lag khang du slob rgyun spel te shes ldan mang po bskyed bsring byas skad/6)kru'u krang zhes pa ni sung lho ma'i dus kyi mkhas can kru'u shis dang krang hri gnyis la bstan pa yin/ de snga kru'u krang gnyis rgyun du sa de ga'i gru khar lhan 'dzoms kyis rig gzhung skor gyi lta ba brje res byas skad/mekru'u rong zhes pa ni hu'u nan zhing chen gyi ting hran ri bo'i ri rtse zhig gi ming /du'adir me'o /'o ri rtse ni nying hran ri bo'i ri rtse ches mtho shos shig gi ming / ri 198

rtse'i 'dabs su ma khar lho'i btsug lag khang yod la dge slob rnam sa rgyun du der 'dus nas lta ba brje res byed pa la bstan/du'adir rtsom pa po dge rgan khung lags dang skyid sdug mnyam myong bis chab srid la zhugs te las gnas gsar ba gsar gtod byed pa'i rbad sem sa bstan/

khrin sung hranakhro)gsar brje'i sna ti tsa ṣāgung khran tang mi'i blo mos brtan//me chur 'dzem med gdong len byed//nyes rdung drag por 'jigs dgos med//tsa ti tsa snyan pa rgyas la ltos//mchana' di/sna su/ nga hran (777) 1936lo'i snga phyir go min tang log spyod pas 'dzin bzung byas te cang zhi len hwar btson 'jug byas shing cang ma 'gor bar bkrongs/0yiti tsa zhes pa ni lcags mgar gyi mgar stegs te tho gdan yang zer cang zhi len hwa btson khang nang gi gung khran tang mi rnams mnar gcod ji 'dra byas kyang blo 'gyur med pas de ga'i log spyod pa'i cus krang zhig gis gong rim la snyan zhu 'bul skabs 6 gung khran tang yon ni ti tsa dang 'dra bar sgyur ba dka' mizhes brjod pas/ 'dir rtsom pa pos gtam de thos 'phral ched du snyan tshig 'di brtsams skad/200

los kha'e yon5)rang srog gtong kha'i tshigagasar brjer zhugs nas bzung //blo sems lcags ltar brtan//log spyod pa la sdang //ltas ngan tshar gcod byed//log 11da phyogs khag gis//grong gi rgyugs khyi 31gas//bos spyazlo khra ho bskor/sgo'i/gu /rte kāga' / rgyud//mnyam du gsang༄ kha srung //tang gi rjes su 'brangs//shi yang rin thang ldan//mchanahu /bye kha/ 'e yon (ṣṭha77) gung khrin tang yon yin/ rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su hu'u pe zhing chen hong hu'u rdzong du 'dzin bzung thebs shing bkrongs/rkyunyakhra ho zhes pa ni hong hu'u rdzong gi grong brdal zhig gi ming /201

bla then hokhyadagra bo'i 'dri gcod la lan btab padzospo bo nga ni gsar brje byed pa dgarto)gsar brje mkhan yang rang nyid gcig pu yin//khyod kyis ci dang gang zhes dris pa na//nam mkhas khyab sar nga yi mi rtsa yod//khyod kyi spo bo nga nyid bsad pa na//sa 'dir bde 'jags mi yong thag gis chod//mchanadzu ༷bye lhan/ ho (sto(7) hu'u pe zhing chen mā khrin gyi mi yin/ lo bcu drug steng dmar dmag la zhugs/ krung dbyis dmag 'khrug nang du 'dzin bzung thebs/ cang ma 'gor bar log spyod pas bkrongs/pa'i rterdo sdu// tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos btson khang du dgra bo'i 'dri gcod la lan btab ()'dir spo bo zhes pa ni rtsom pa pos rang nyid ni dgra bo'i spo bo yin pa'i tshul gyis dgra bor snang chung byas pa'i tshul bstan pa yin/202

zhon zhwa chu50snyan ngag tshan pa gcigadzomi dmangs rim gyis rmi lam yul nas bslangs//gsar brje'i nga ro 'brug sgra ldir ba bzhin//blo mthun khyod kyis ma brjed yid la zungs//rang dbang gnyer na rang khrag dor nas brtson//mchanazhu ra/sna zhwa/ spru (ṣṭhaṣṭha༅1899 1938) kre cang zhing chen kru'u ci'i mi yin/gung khran tang yon/ 1924lor hong phu dmag srid slob grwa'i skabs dang po las mthar phyin/ tsha su'e dmangs tshogs lngar 'gog mna' mthun dmag gi cun gnyis pa'i hri krang dang pa lu'u cun spyi khyab pu'u yi mtho rim tshan dbyi'i 'gan khur/ 1938lo'i zla brgyad par zhi an grong khyer du go min tang log spyod pas lkog gsod byas/0yisnyan tshig 'di brtsams dus ma nges kyang phal cher rgyal nang gsar rje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i skabs su mdzad par bshad/203

thu'u kreng khunakhyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcigamadung ring rtse mo 'od lam lam//rkun jag thog mar gte bo 'dzin//cang ce hri ni rtsa rdzogs dang //zhu'u khe zhang nyid gson bzung dgos/sgo'imachanabye /zlo kre/ nga khun (ikṣuḥ 1897 1939) hu'u nan zhing chen yin cang gi mi yin/ 1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir zhang o kun mtha' khul gyi rdzong u'i hru'u ci dang / zhing u'i hru'u ci/ dmigs bsal khul u'i hru'u ci/ zhin zi cun ca dbyi bca' sdod khru'u yi kru'u rin bcas kyi 'gan khur myong / 1933lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin go min tang log spyod pas yin cang ya nga'i don rkyen bzos te blo mthun thu'u kreng khun yang de'i nang du bkrongs pa red/0yi'adir zhu'u khe zhang zhes pa ni de snga hu'u nan zhing chen gyi log spyod dmag dngo na zhig gi ming yin/ 1927lor cang ce hri gsar brjer blo log rjes/ des cang ce hri'i ngan skul 'og tu gsar brje'i mang tshogs mang po dmar gsod byas/204

cin hphang khrang khyadagra bo'i 'dri gcod la lan btab pa/tsha gcun bslu brid zung gis 'dul mi thub//mgo sgur gnya' chag pho rabs min pa'i rtags//mchanahu rabye/ hpha/ nga khrang (97zla 1921— 1940) hran tung zhing chen le'o khrin gyi mi yin/ 1938lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ krung gung sran zhi zhing chen te zhan rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur myong / 1940lo'i zla bcu gcig par nang rul pas gsang brtol bas 'dzin bzung thebs shing zla bcu gnyis par bkrongs/205

zha'o tshi kran5)snyan tshig tshan pa gcigardziblo sems lcags bzhin sra zhing brtan//dka' sdug bde bar mthong zhing gzhol//lo 'khor sum cur slob gnyer byas//bden rdzun brtag pa'i rtogs pa rgyas//gnam dang las la khag 'gel med//'jig rten mi la bsnyon mi 'ding //dus rabs 'di la skyes pa na//bden don ched du sri zhur brtson//stobs shugs 'bul dus ring ba'i phyir//rang lus 'di ko gces pa gal//drang bden slad du tshe srog nyid//'dor rung phangs sems ga la 'dzin//gzugs phung 'di la zhen 'dzin med//yod tshad skad cig nyid du stong //phyi ma la yang zhe mi 'phreng //rjes na rgyun skyong mi rabs yod//mi tshe rgyun bsrings dmag 'thab 'dra//pham khas rgyal kha chen po brjes//spobs pa'i dbu 'phang dgung la bstod//206

rang bi khe gyong rgyab tu bskyur//skyes chen dam pa'i g.yab mo las//phu rob mi zhis bkug pa bzhin/khu)mtshanahu ༷/zlo tshi/ kran (lkom ) kos krig zhing chen zi nan gyi mi yin/ 1927lor krung rgo gung khran ring lugs na gzhin tshogs par zhugs/ 1938lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir krung gung zi nan rdzong u'i hru'u ci dang / krung gung kos krig zhing chen bzo u'i drung yig chen mo'i 'gan khur/ 1940lo'i dbyar khar go min tang myul mas 'dzin bzung byas shing zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nyin dgra bos lkog gsod byas te bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni phal cher rtsom pa pos btson khang nang du bris shas che/ kho rang bkrongs rjes/ khong gi btson grogs lis tsha'i zhes pa des nu bor bskur ba'i yig sgrom gyi nang du bcug ste bskur pas gzhi nas lag son byung ba yin/()phu rob mi zhis zhes pa ni gna' rabs 'i la'i lha sgrung nang gi lha zhig gi ming /des gnam gyi me son brkus te mi yul la gnang bas gnam gyi bdag po krig zi zhes pa de khros nas kho rang na'o ca zo ri bo'i brag ngor brdabs te dam la btags skad/207

dbyang cing yusakhyaljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag cun dang po'i glu tshig②nga tsho ni byang shar ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung yin//mnyam 'brel dmag gi cun dang po 'di ru gsar 'dzugs byas//gdong mchong dgra gsod kyi nga ros gnam sa skul//de ni gsar brje rnam par rgyal ba'i dan rtags yin//yang dag pa'i gsar brje'i rtsa 'dzin gong bkur bya//dpon dang dmag gi thob thang 'dra mnyam yin//lcags lta bu'i dmag gi sgrig khrims brtsi srung byed//lcags lta bu'i zla med gsar brje'i dmag dpung bsgrigs//mdza' brtse'i blo mthun rnam pa mthun sgril gyis//dgra bo'i go mtshon ri ltar bsgrigs pa las//sngar shor rang rgyal sa cha 'phrog len byed//rgyal shor bran g.yog sdug bsngal rgya las sgrol//dpa' brtul gyi blo mthun rnam pa sngon skyod kyis//ljar jag mthar skyod man ju'i rgyal khab gtor//thengs 'di'i mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug gis//208

gnyom chung mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol las 'gul slong //dmar mdangs 'tsher ba'i rgyal kha'i dmag dar de//nga tsho'i steng gi bar snang khams su g.yo//gdong mchong gyis/ nga tsho cun dang po'i dmag/gdong mchong gyis/ nga tsho cun dang po'i dmag/mchan 'grel/rjodabyang cing lus (7thos1905 1940) ho nan zhing chen cha'o hran gyi mi yin/ 1926lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing krung gung lus nan dmigs bsal khul u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur myong / 1929lor krung gung krung dbyang gi bka' mngags ltar byang shar sa khul du phebs nas snga phyir har pin grong khyer gyi hru'u ci dang man ju zhing u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1933lor byang shar mi dmangs lngar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung cun dang po'i cun krang dang chab srid u yon gcig lcogs byas/ 1934lor rgyal yongs su'u we ed 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa'i steng krung dbyang bzo zhing dmangs gtso srid gzhung bi las 'dzin u yon du bdams/1936lor krung gung man lho zhing mu'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1937lor lngar 'gog dmag 'khrug bslangs rjes/ byang shar ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag cun dang po'i spyi khyab zi lin gyi 'gan khur/ 1940lo'i zla gnyis par man cang sa khul du lhar jag la dmag 'thab byed skabs stabs ma legs par mda' phog ste gshegs/nyu1932lor rang rgyal byang shar sa khul du myur du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ljar 'gog 'jab rgol ru khag cig gsar du byung / de la tang gi 'go khrid shugs snon byed ched/ krung gung man ju zhing us blo mthun dbyang cing lus mngags te ru khag de'i chab srid u yon gyi 'gan khur/ phyis ru khag de'i stobs shugs cher 'phel bas/ gzhi nas ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi cun dang por bsgyur cing / blo mthun dbyang cing lus kyis spyi khyab zi lin gyi 'gan khur/ glu tshig 'di ni khong gis skabs der bris 209

skad/ ༷man ju rgyal khab ces pa ni1931lo'i 9 18 don rkyen byung rjes ljar pan gyis rang rgyal byang shar sa khul la btsan 'dzul byas shing / cang ma 'gor bar man ju'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ches tha ma dru dbyi zhes pa de gong ma'i gsob byas te 6 man ju rgyal khab rdzun ma btsugs/ 1945lo'i zla brgyad par su'u len dmar dmag gis ljar pan btsan 'dzul dmag pham par brgyab ste man ju rgyal khab rdzun ma de rtsa gtor byas/

lu'e ta chan btson khang du bzhag pa'i snyan tshig②dus rabs shugs kyis 'khor lo dmar po bskul//zhogs pa'i nyi gzhon gsar ba gsar bas bsus//da lan dpyid kyi sngo lo'i mgo bcad kyang //sang lor slar skyes sngo ljang dus shig mchi//mchanabye /zlo /ta na (dzam 1909 1937) nye lung cang zhing chen pin zhan gyi mi yin/ 1932lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing snga phyir krung gung pin zhan yan lag tshogs pa'i dril bsgrags u yon dang de nas hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1937lo'i zla bzhi bar rtsa 'dzugs gtor brlag thebs te bzung zhing btson la bcug lo de'i zla bdun par ljar jag gis har min du bkrongs/tsho)snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos btson khang du bris shing rang nyid gsod rar khrid skabs btson khang du bzhag pas na de skad du brjod do//211

yin yang / 'dir gtso bor krung go rgyal khab spyi la go dgos/()zha'o zhang zhes pa ni hu'u nan zhing chen la bstan pa yin te/ de'i khongs na zha'o spros gtsang po dang zhang cang gtsang po gnyis yod pas na de skad brjod/6)yun kos zhes pa ni yun nan zhing chen dang kos krig zhing chen la bstan pa yin/zhig giX py-i /gzar 'gag ces pa ni kun su'u zhing chen the bo rdzong khongs na yod pa'i ri bo

ho dzin/rjobatson khang nang gi glu dbyangasabamatshan smag gis skya rengs bkag/ rang gzugs kyis grib ma dpyangs//lcags sgrog gis lag pa bsdams// zhe sdang gis rang sems bsregs//dug sbrang ni 'brug bzhin ldir// tsig tshogs ni dmag ltar rub//sgron 'od ni mog por snang // tsha rlangs ni chu ltar khol//nyi 'od kyis ma zin pa'i// mun nag gi gru logs su//nga tsho la zhe 'khreng ba'i// sems ngal ni gso mkhan su//lus thog gi rma kha'i zug/ snying rje yis rtog mkhan gang //khrag dron ni dbyar mtsho bzhin// blo sems ni lcags ltar sra//tshe srog ni ma chad na// bden don du 'thab rtsod byed//kye kye snying sdug ma khyod gyes tshun mdzes zhal mthong ba'i skal ba dben//'thab 'dzing ched du so sor 'bral khar rgyal kha 'thob rjes 'phrad par 'ches//'on kyang rgyal kha'i sngon la 'chi bar dpa' rtul yin yang mchi ma 'chor//khyod la snying mdzangs groṭa kyis stong bas g.yul gyi dpung shuṭa nyams min nam//nga la blos thub grogs po shor bas hreng por lus pa'i skyo snang 'char//snying sdug ma khyod nga yi rjes shul bskyangs te dgra la 'thab par rigs//bgrang yas dmangs dang lhan cig nga tsho'i khrag rjes ded nas skyod cig dang //chad med 'thab rtsod kho nas da gzod rang re'i dri med brtse dung mchod//btson khang nang gi glu dbyangs 'di yis gzhi nas nga yi snang sems mtshon//1941lo'i zla11par/214

mchanasbyo/shā ltan/ (5771915 1941) hu'u pe zhing chen 'an nying sga mi yin/1936lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir krung gung hu'u pe zhing u'i u yon dngawu'u khrang grong khyer gyi hru'u ci/ o nan dmigs bsal khul u'i hru'u ci/ o zhi dmigs bsal khul u'i hru'u ci/ zhang o khron dmigs bsal khul mu'i hru'u ci bcas kyi 'asan khur/ 1941lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer bdun nyin hu'u pe'i yin hrir 'dzin bzung thebs/ hu'u pe'i go min tang gi 'go gtso'am hu'u pe srid gzhung bi kru'u zhi khrin khreng zhes pa des rtsom pa po la blo 'gug gi lkog gshom bzos kyang ma grub pas mthar dgra bo'ang thabs zad de bgrongs/0yisnyan tshig 'di ni 1942lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin yan an (bcings 'grol tshags par 〉 steng du 'god dus su kha byang la (zhus yon rjes su dran pa 〉 zhes 'khod 'dug 215

stong khreng khyabros byolakhri'imun ring mtshan mor gar skyod gtol med gyur//smag pas mnan cing nam gsal dus kyis bskal//mgo bo 'phrug bzhin yid la gnongs pa skyes//lag pa brang khar sbyar nas the tshom gcod//bde sdug shi gson tshe 'di'i gnyer bya min//sha khrag dor nas sa 'di bran par bya//bshul lam ring zhing dka' bar ma 'jigs shig/bya skad sgrog nyid nags mthar skya rengs 'dzum//ma nabye //khre/ nga (rsā71914 1941) ho pe zhing chen an tshi'i mi yin/6612 9 slob ma'i rgyal gces las 'gul nang du hur brtson can gyi gras yin zhing ching hwa slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma tshogs pa'i kru'u zhi dang / pe phin slob ma'i lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi'i 'gan khur myong / cang ma 'gor bar krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1937lor ljar 'gog dmag 'khrug bslangs rjes/ zhin si cun la zhugs nas spyi khyab chab srid pu'u yi drung yig chen mo'i 'gan khur/ 1941lor cang ce hris wan nan don 'gyur bslangs pa'i khrod du 'dzin bzung thebs shing mi ring bar hrang ra'o btson khang du bkrongs/0yisnyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos 1936lo'i zla gnyis par go min tang log spyod pa pe cin ching hwa slob grwa chen mor sngon thon slob ma 'dzin bzung byed par 'ong tshul mthong rjes shar mar bris te rang nyid kyi 'thab rtsod chod sems bstan/216

dbyang ta'o hreng khyabatson khang nang gi snyan tshigakrung yon sa gzhir g.yu 'brug dgung la rtsen/phriyi ge gsum gyi snying 'khon zhi ma gyur/khyachang dkar bkyags nas gad rgyangs chen po sgrog/sta res dum brgyar gtubs kyang mgo mi sgur//mchan 'grel/①dbyang ta'o hreng (67419114 1942) 1938lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing tang gi rig gnas dpe sgrun gyi las don bsgrubs nas khrin tu'u grong khyer gyi g.yul dus dpe skrun khang gi hro krang gi 'gan khur myong / 1941lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1942lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nyin khrin tu'u grong khyer du bkrongs/②klung yon zhes pa ni rma chu 'bab yul gyi bar rgyud dang smad rgyud kyi sa khul rgya chen po zhig la bstan pa yin yang 'dir krung go'i sa khyon yongs la go dgos te/ tshig 'di'i nang don ni krung go gung khran tang ni g.yu 'brug sngon mo dgung la rtsen pa bzhin du krung go'i sa gzhi 'di ru 'khrungs shing mi dmangs la mgo khrid byas nas dbang sgyur gral rim rtsa rdzogs byed pa'i stobs shugs chen po zhig tu gyur pa'o zhes pa'o//()yi ge gsum gyi 'khon zhes pa ni 1927lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes so gcig nyin khrun chin grong khyer gyi mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis khrom skor tshogs chen bsdus te a ri dang dbyin ju btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag grus nan cing grong khyer la me skyogs 'phangs par rgol gtam btang ba la dmag shed can li'u zhang gis dmag dang myul ma mngags nas tshogs rar glo bur du me mdas brgyab ste mi cig stong lhag gsod rmas byas pa'i gyod gzhi chen po zhig bzos pa de la bstan to//217

khrin hpha lhukhyabatson khang nang gi snyan tshigatshe 'di'i bya ba btso sbyangs gser bzhin dag/gsod rar skyod kyang gnongs 'gyod ci yang med//phugs 'dun brtan po g.yo 'gul mi byed cing //khrag dron dor nas rang lugs skyong la rangs//shi na spobs pas khengs pa'i gshin 'dre dang //gson na blo bag phebs pa'i btson pa byed//zla 'dir snying nas zhen pa skyes na yang //drang bden ched du yod tshad gtong bar phod//mchanahu ༷zlo/ hpha/ hri (ṭhaṭharsā1917 1942) kos krig zhing chen kos dbyang gi mi yin/ 1939lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ kos krig sbrag tar bzo pa'i las 'gul la zhugs nas bzo tshogs la g.yo 'dzul byas pa'i go min tang gi myul ma la 'thab rtsod byas/ 1941lor 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1942lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin kos dbyang grong khyer du bkrongs/218

li'u the kri snyan tshig tshan pa gcigadzodabo zla'i kha ba 'bab pa'i nyin//krung ta sgo khar 'dzin bzung thebs/khyare rer zhags pas dam bkyigs kyis//nyen rtog dmag mi'i tsha gzhus bzod//nyes don ci yin dris pa na//mes rgyal dga' zhen drags pas yin//gzeb 'khor nang du btsan bcug gis//dmag rtog khang la gnas spo byas//de yi dmag khrims btsan zhing gdug/rkang la lcags sgrog ljid mo dang //lus la gos thul srab pas sdug/lcags drar btson pa'i mi tshe skyong //nyin rer phye rdog gnyis las med//skyo ma'i nang du bro tshwa dkon//bsam na sems nas bzod glags bral//phyi dgra rgyal khab dbus la brtol/khyakhab 'di dbang med 'thor zhing zhig/rang khyim mi 'thor ga la srid//mi rigs nyams dmas mi 'gyur grang //219

nang rul ngo tsha khrel med kyis//dgra 'gugs rang phyogs 'joms la dga'//nang gi rgyal gces mi sna gsod//phyi la rang gi bla 'tshong mkhan//nam zhig mi dmangs yar langs tshe//gshin rje'i yul du brdzang bar nges//mchana~X hāḍithe/ kri (smo1ṣṭhanyu1914 1942) ho pe zhing chen ching ho'i mi yinargyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su pe yin du slob ma'i las 'gul la zhugs/ 1935lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ ljar 'gog skabs su cisanan sa khul srid 'dzin las khungs kyi drung yig chen mo'i 'gan khur/ phyis su hran zhi zhingachen du mtha' khul srid gzhung gi mgo 'dren bya ba bsgrubs/ 1942lo'i zla drug par ljar jag gi skor bcom la rgol ba'i 'thab 'dzing khrod du bkrongs/tshomisnyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po pe phin du 812 9 slob ma'i las 'gul la zhugs nas 'dzin bzung thebs te btson khang du bzhugs skabs bris skad/()krung ta zhes pa ni rgya yig gi krung go slob grwa chen mo'i bsdus ming ngo /6)phyi dgra rgyal khab dbus la brtol zhes pa'i don ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis rang rgyal la btsan 'dzul byas te rgyal khab kyi dbus phyogs su brtol la nye ba'i don no//220

wang ling pa'okhyasnyan tshig tshan pa gcibaldegazhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas dus 'phrad//da lta maso skra dkar la nye//mdun lam kyag kyog dka' sdug che//ral gri phyung nas log spyod 'joms//mchakā kāswā ༵/nga pa'o (༅771889 1942) hu'u nan zhing chen nying zhang gi mi yin/ 1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ go gung mnyam 'brel skabs su go min tang hu'u nan zhing chen gyi tang pu'u hru'u ci krang gi 'gan khur/ 1927lo'i rjes su snga phyir thengs gnyis la 'dzin bzung thebs kyang blo sems 'gyur ma myong / ljar 'grog dmas 'khrug bslangs rjes pa lu'u cun hu'u nan bca' sdod gsar 'gyur khru'u yi kru'u rin dang zhin si cun don sgrub khang bi kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur/ 1940lor go min tang log spyod pas gung rgol gyi rlung rlabs bslangs shing blo mthun wang ling pa'o btsan sgyugs byas/ lo der khong rang yan an du phyin pa dang srid 'dzin slob grwa chen mo'i yon krang /spyan ba dri'i du 'a //ga par/ 1942lo'i zla dgu ba'i tshes gsum nyin klad pa'i khrag rtsa gas chosan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po dgung lo nga gcig gi skyes skar nyin la khong gi bza' ṭwāṃ // /da rin gyis rten 'brel zhu ba'i snyan ngag sho lo ka gcig bris te phul ba'i lan du 221

lin ci lu'umibatson pa'i grubamis la mchi ma 'khrigs bzhin lo rgyus bklags//dus rabs re re dang ni rgyal rabs rer//rgyal dang dmangs don la gzhol dam pa rnams//ngang mtshor ji bzhin gsod rar phyin pa mthong //khrag ldan mche ba gcigs pa'i 'phar spyang bis//nam yang nyes dgu'i bya ngan 'dzem med spel//kyi hud mi rigs/ sdug gis mnar ba'i yum//dgung grangs lnga stong son pa'i lo rgyus khrod/khyagrangs med dpa' bo tshogs kyis rang srog btang //khri lor rtag pa'i rlabs chen mdzad 'phrin la//da dung skyes bu du ma'i brtson par rag/rtsig pa mthon pos rgyal skyob snying stobs gcun//smag mun stug pos gzugs phung 'khyur mid byas//lcags sgrog sra mos rang dbang gshog pa bsdams//'jigs rung lcags sgos shes ldan grangs med bkag/rang phyogs gtse res dgra bo yan la btang //nyes tshogs bsags pas sbyor ba rang la 'bebs//khrag gi dri ngan khrag 'thung mkhan gyis 'khrud//222

kye kye btson pa btson pa gsar ba tsho//blo sems 'gyur med lang phyogs brtan por gyis//mtho bcad srog 'phrog byes bu yul log bzhin//gcar rdung skor gsum nyin rgyun bza' btung 'dra//kye kye btson nga btson pa gsar ba tsho//blo sems 'gyur med lang phyogs brtan por gyis//mgo bo dor nas rang dbang mchod rten brtsig/rang khrag bton nas dar cha dmar por sgyur//ma sdu shāshārnyi/ lu'u (//skya 1916 1943) kong tung zhing chen tha'e hran gyi mi yin/ 1933lor krung go gung gzhon tshogs par zhugs/ 1935lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ lngar pan du slob gnyer byed skabs krung go'i phyi 'grim slob ma'i las 'gul la mgo 'dren byed mkhan gyi gras yin/ 1937lor phyir log nas lngar 'gog dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ 1938lo'i zla gnyis par tang gis khong rang shin cang la ma/ngags te/ snga phyir shin cang slob grwa chen mo'i slob ston 'go gtso dang / kho'u khre rdzong gi rdzong dpon gyi 'gan khur/ 1941lor dbang sgyur mkhan hrin hri tshe yis 'dzin bzung byas shing / 1943lo'i zla dgu bar bkrongs/skad/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po nyid shin cang gi btson khang du bzhugs skabs bris rjodagung grangs lnga stong zhes pa ni krung hwa mi rigs kyi lo rgyus ni da nas gyen 'ded /sa rags rtsis ltar na phal cher lo lnga stong lhag la zin pas na de skad du brjod pa yin 223

khrin hosakṣames rgyal bstod pa'i glu/ngas/rang nyid rol mo mkhan zhig min par/blo re phangs/kye/ mes rgyal lags/ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi bu phrug ste/lus kyi kho lag rgyas pa'i nga nyid ni/khyod gcig pur dbang ba yin pas/nga ni khyod la snying thag pa nas/snying thag pa nas dga' zhing zhen/nga ni ma se'i glu dbyangs len pa'i/glu ba dang 'dra b.rakṣatsha gdug gi nyi 'od 'og tu/pa li kung gres 'thab 'dzing byas pa'i rdzong ra'i 'gram dukhyargyud mangs kyi pi wang sbreng nas/'dzam gling la g.yo 'gul thebs shing /mi'i rigs kyi snyan dbang gso ba'i/rol dbyangs dang po dkrol bzhin/khyod la bstod pa'i ngag rtsal dman/224

nga ni ba glang gi rgyab tu zhon zhing /lag la gling bu btegs nas 'bud pa'am/yang na ston zla'i g.yul khar 'greng nas/sgyug ma'i gling bu ring 'bud gyis/snyan 'jebs kyi rta dbyangs 'dam jig las 'phros te/gtsang bo'i 'gram gyi ljon grib nang du/lhung bar byed pa'i yon tan med/'on kyang / ngas mgo bo btegs nas khyod nyid de/mes rgyal gyi g.ya' dag pa'i nam mkha'/yangs shing rgya che ba'i spang thang /nam mkha'i mtha' nas dal bur rgyu ba'i sprin dkar/yang na gor mo'i gseb nas yar 'greng zhing /'dzum mdangs dgod pa'i me tog dmar po mthong thengs rer/nga rang dga' ba'i sems ni/pha yul gyi me'o rigs bu mo tsho/ston zla dwangs shing gsal ba'i mtshan mor/sgra tshigs gcig gi 'gros la bsdebs nas/lding bas myos dang mtshungs/kye ma/ nga yi mes rgyal lags/gdong ba smug por gyur cing /na tshod kyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i/

'thab mo pa nga ni/khyod nyid gcig pur dbang ngo /ngas rnying hrul gyi khres po khur nas/bde thang 'phred kyis bcad nas skyod skabs/dgra bo'i so khang mthon po dang /de yi steng na skyod pa'i dgra dar mthong tshe/lus yongs la drag tu rgyug pa'i khrag rgyun ni/byang shar gyi kha ba stug po chags pa'i rtswa thang nas/rlung 'tshub chen po bzhin du gshar nas 'ongs pa'i/mes rgyal gyi dpa' rtul rnams kyi mgyogs 'gro'i dpung chen/'ur 'ur chem chem gyis slebs dang mtshungs/kye ma/ mes rgyal lags/khyod kyis brtse sems kyi 'o mas/nga nyid bskyed cing bsrings/nga yis rang bi sha dang khrag gis/khyod nyid bsrung nges yin/sang nyin nga rang 'chi yang srid la/nga rang gsod pa'i tshe/dgra bo'i mda' gri'i rtse mos/nga yi khog pa brtol kyang srid pa'am/grag 'gul med par dpyang thag tu bkum pa'am/226

yang na spyang khyu'i tshogs la bskyur na'ang thang /ltos dang /gdug rtsub che ba'i spyang khyi tshos mche ba gcigs bzhin/mig nang nas rngam ham gyi zer mdangs 'phros/kye ma/ mes rgyal lags/dgra bo'i gtsabs gri'i mdun du/nga yis mig chu 'don mi srid/skad gsang mthon pos khong dgod byed/khyod kyi kho lag rgyas pa'i bu phrus dang /khyod nyid mi 'bral bzhin du srung mkhan des/tshe srog gis bris pa'i bla med bstod glu zhigakhyod la legs skyes su phul yod/mes rgyal lags/ ngas khyod la bstod glu len/mes rgyal lags/nga yi rus pa sbas pa'i sa ser phung bo'i steng du/brtse dung gi me tog bi tshom bu zhig skye bar nges so//1942lo'i zla 8tshes 1༷nyin bris/mchan 'grel/0khrin hos (cho 1920 1944) hu'u nan zhing chen khrang te'i mi yin/ gung khran tang yon/ 1938lor yan an du phyin/ 1939lor cin khra ci dgra rgyab lngar 'gog gnas gzhi sa khul du phyin/ 1941lor le kro bde thang du phebs nas na gzhon rgyal skyob tshogs pa'i kru'u rin dang chus u hru'u ci/ drag chas las don ru las gi chab srid u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1944lo'i dpyid kha'i nyin zhig la dgra bos glo bur 227

du bskor te 'thab 'dzing byed pa'i khrod du rang srog blos btang ngo //②ma se'i glu dbyangs zhes pa ni hpha ran si'i gsar brje skabs su/ ma se zhes pa'i sa khul gyi 'thab mo pa rnams pa li'i phyogs su skyod skabs len pa'i dmag glu zhig la zer ba yin/ phyis su hpha ran si'i rgyal grur gtan 'khel byas so//tshupa li kung hre zhes pa ni 1871lo'i zla gsum par pa li'i bzo pa tshos gsar du btsugs pa'i gsar brje'i srid dbang ste 'byor med gral rim srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi srid dbang ang dang po yin/ lo de'i zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin 'byor ldan gral rim gyis drag gnon byas te pham/

kru'u zhu'e menakhyamyong tshorababu rgod na tshod gzhon dus brtson 'grus rtsom//'gram gnyis skra dkar bsgo la sgug mi rigs//yu la gru'i phyed tsam dgra bo'i lag tu shor//g.yul 'khrug bslangs pas ru dar mkha' la bsgrengs/kṣagana' nas da bar nang rul g.yo can mang //bsam gyin khros pas ngag rtsom dbang med thal//mi dmangs dung phyur nyis zung gcig sgril gyis//phyi dgrar rgol ba'i rgo mtshon spras par byed/mchakā lha/ rsha/'emin (lko 771912— 1944) kre cang zhing chen nying he'i mi yin/1937lo'i zla bcu bar yan an du phyin cing zla bcu gcig par krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1938lo'i zla gnyis par tang gis kho rang kro cang du bya ba bsgrub par mngags shing / snga phyir krung gung yun zhan rdzong u'i rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang dang / yus yo rdzong u'i hru'u ci/ kru'u ci rdzong u'i hru'u ci bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1944lo'i zla lnga bar ljar jag gi 6 gtsang phyags la 'gog rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing nang du rang srog blos btang ngo //⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos ljar 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su bris skad/dugayul 'khrug bslangs zhes pa ni 1937lo'i zla drug par ljar pan btsan 'dzul dmag gis bsam bzhin du lu'u kug zam pa'i don rkyen bzos te rnam pa rgya che ba'i sgo nas krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i g.yul 'khrug bslangs pa la krung go'i dmag dpung gis 'gog rgol byas pas ljar 'gog dmag 'khrug gi mgo tshugs pa de la bstan pa yin no//229

lu'u thi chu la mu thal chu ngas gtan nas min ②log spyod kyi stobs shugs kyis nga'i gnya' mnan nas sked pa/ skur yang rung /sadon 'dre yi sder mos nga yi mgul ba bcir kyang srid/'on kyang ngas ni gtan nas bla mi 'tshong /gtan nas min/rang la thengs bcig las mi thob pa'i tshe srog de/ngu ngag bis skyabs 'jus zhus nas blu ba'am/'dar sig sig bi lag pa brkyangs nas slong rgyu min/dgra bo'i rkang mgor thod phyag btsal ba'i sdar ma dang /rang bi 'od snang de mun nag la brje mkhan blo log pa/pha rol gyi mdun du pus mo btsugs nas mig chu 'don pa'i snying chung ba tshor/nga rang zhe 'khon rus pa'i gting nas skyes/ngas sger sdom pa'i bla srog btsog po dang /khrag rgyun 'dzag pa'i ral gri/bden don dang bde skyid bsgag pa'i 'gegs thag bcas/mngon sum du mtshang 'byin byed rgyu yin/dgra bos nga yi mgo bo bcad kyang mi dmangs kyis phyir 'bul nges yin/dgra bos gsar brje'i dar cha bslogs kyang mi dmangs kyis slar yang sgring nges yin/dgra bos nga rang ya nga'i gshin rje 'phrang sgor ded cing /2 30

nga yi margo bo gsal shing la bskyon te mi dmangs la 'jigs bsku la kyang /ngas ni gtan nas maso mi sgu ra/ gtan nas min/ngas rang bi snying stobs yod tshad kyis glu dbyangs len/ngas rang bi gangs dkar 'dra ba'i sems kyis rgyud mangs sbreng /ngas rang bi khras dron de 'khon slog gi rlabs rgyun drag por bsgyur nas/dgra bo'i pho brang 'jig par byed cing /gte bo'i khri stegs rmang nas rdzogs par byed/sdos shig sdos shig1943lor bris mchan 'grel/0lu'u thi hphu la mu thal spru ( mi 〉ne lha lko 542 1922— 1945) yu gur rigs/ shin cang lus li nye li khe'i mi yin/ 1939lor wu lu mu cir slob grwa 'grim/1941lo nas 1943lo'i bar shin cang nyin re'i tshags par las khungs su bya ba bsgrubs/ tang gi shan zhugs thebs pas gsar brje'i snyan tshig mang po bris/1943lor go min tang log spyod dbang 'dzin pas kho rang a khe su'u gsar 'gyur las khungs su snags kyang gsar brje'i bya 'gul gyi mtshams ma bzhag 1945lor zhing pa'i // ༵༵ /sdu langs sgrig 'dzugs byed skabs 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1945lo'i zla dgu ⑨snyan tshig 'di ni1943lor go min tang log spyod srid gzhung gis com pa po'i bsam blo gsar brje'i phyogs su 'khor yod pa shes nas bsam bzhin khong rang a khe su'u gsar 'gyur las khungs su btang ba'i snga phyi de la brtsam sa par snyam/231

li hra'o hri bza' zlar springs pa/ring du byes pas phan tshun dran pas gdung //mjal 'dzoms dus nyin nam zhig blos dpog dka'//mes rgyal rgyad par ma bzod mchi ma 'khrigs//ma gyes rang sor 'bral bar ma tshom zhig/'tsho dus dka' sdug nyams myong chos nyid yin//shi ying rin thang ldan pas ma skyo zhig/yul bskal khyo bor zhe sems ma 'khreng bar//bu mo skyong 'gan khyod kyis dang du longs//mchakā ṭwāṃ gāswā/ hri (chokro 719064 1945) kong tung zhing chen zhin hos kyi mi yin/rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i skabs su krung go gung khran ring lugs na gzhon tshogs par zhugs/ mi ring bar krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing /zhang kung gru pa'i bzo tshogs/ tang bi zhang kung 'brel gtug sa tshigs/ hrang he'i bzo pa'i gsar 'gyur khang / krung gung cang su'u zhing u'i dril bsgrags pu'u bcas su bya ba bsgrubs myong / 1934lor 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1937lor btson grol byung / phyis su khrun chin grong khyer gyi pa lu'u cun don sgrub khang du phyag las gnang / 1945lo'i zlabacu pa'i tshes brgyad nyin don sgrub khang gi rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas hra than pa brgyud skabs/hā // /dri zlog dmag gis 'jab rgol byas pas rmas phog ste khrag mang po bzhur bas rkyen 232

lu'e hos grinakṣargyal skyob lhag bsam lo rgyus skyes su 'jopodzeyul khams dum bur song la lta mi bzod/kṣakhrag dron dor te rgyal khab skyob par 'dod//dud me'i khrod nas dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs skyod//gnas gzhi gsar gtod dmangs gtso'i srid dbang 'dzugs//lo brgyad ljar 'gog spobs pa sngar las mthogyiblo sems dkar po mes rgyal don du 'bul//da ni nam gsal ran par ring mi 'gyur//rang srog phangs med 'dor bar mi spobs ci//mchakā kāshā lha/sa hrin (ṭha 41902 1945) an hos zhing chen wu'u le'i mi yin/1942lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir hos nan dbyi krin rdzong dpon dang mnyam 'brel slob 'bring gi slob gtso/ wu'u we rdzong gi rdzong dpon/ wan cang srid 'dzin kung hru'u yi kru'u rin sogs kyi 'gan khur/ 1945lo'i zla dgu ba'i nang zhin si cun hri bdun pa'i rjes 'brangs nas byang skyod byed skabs lam bar du cang jag gi 'jab rgol zlozlo/ ṭwāṃ stabs ma legs par 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla bcu gcig par nan cing du ⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos nan cing grong khyer cang nying krin btson khang du brtsams par bshad do//0yul khams dum bur song ba zhes pa ni 'dir ljar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs 233

gtso byas pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal lab kyis rang rgyal gyi sa cha mang po btsan bzung g.yo 'phrog byas te mes rgyal 'di dum bur song yod pa'i tshul de bstan/②'dir lo brgyad ces pa ni rang rgyal mi dmangs kyis ri pin btsan rgyal ring lugs la 'grog rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug ni tan tan lo brgyad byas tshul bstan/

li kra'o linakṣathang brang 'debs pa'i klumigacigari bo lhun sdug ngam brag gzar/ljon dang rtsi shing tshang tshing 'khrigs/char rlung drag tu 'tshub/sder thang gtsang 'gram rta pho 'tsher/me phung bskor cing mthun sgril dam/me 'od lam lam gnam sa khyab/blo mthun tsho/sung cang gtsang bo'i rlabs mthor ci la 'jigs/yar bzhengs shigazhum med gdong len gyis/ljar jag phyi ru skyod/byang shar tshur la 'phrogamesmag bsal nyi gzhon 'od snang dgung la 'phros/gnyis/rngam nag phung bos nam mkha' bsgribs/smug sprin lang long phyogs bzhir 'thul/235

rlan gsher sprin rum mgo nas mnan/zhabs brdol rngul 'dzag dbugs stod 'tshangs/du sngon gya gyur dgung la 'phyur/khrag 'jib 'bu yis gos mdog bsgyur/spun zla tsho/cin po'i rbab chus gung gzims rmi lam 'gugs lag pa gcig tu sbrel/rgyal skyob don du gnyer/zhags pa ring po 'debs/btsan drag dgra bo khyigs/ri rlung rnam pa bsgyur/g.yul 'khrug zhi bar brtson/gsum/mya ngam thang stong che/bsgribs med gcer bur mngon/spang me lam lam mched/dgra rdzong mthong bas rta pho 'drogs/rtsi shing rgud cing ston rlung 'tshub/brlan ldan bud shing zhugs sgron dka'/'thab grogs tsho/brtson pas ri rab stong phrag brgal/hur 'thab gyis dang /236

ljid 'gan phrag la babs/bkag rgya gtor/ bskor rgya brtol/'od snang gsal/ mun pa sel/bzhi/dgun rlung drag tu 'tshub/kha ba'i 'dab ma g.yo/rta pho'i spobs pa zhum/grang rlung gis gzir mtshan mnal dka'/brang mdun mer bsros dro na'ang /lus rgyab 'khyags pas gzir la ltos/dpa' rgod tsho/snying stobs ma nyams nu cang bde thang la dpung 'jug bya/spobs pa brtan po 'di/nyams pa ga la srid/mi rigs yongs dang gral rim tshogs/ mthun sgril dam po yis/sngar shor yul gru 'phrog len bya/ma sdu kāswākā/lin (lhamothu 1908 1946) le'o nying zhing chen le'o dbyang gi mi yin/ 1932lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing / snga phyir byang shar ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung cun gsum pa'i chab srid pu'u yi kru'u rin dang krung gung man ju zhing u'i u yon/ ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung cun gsum pa'i spyi khyab 237

bskad 'doms pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/ ljar 'grog dmas 'khrug rnam par rgyal rjes/su nga cang zhing chen gyi hrin krang gzhon pa dang / har pin grong khyer krung su'u mdza' mthun tshogs pa'i tshogs satso/ krung gung man ju byang khul yan lag cus u yon bcas kyi 'gan sa//ngas1/946lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes dgu nyin har pin du so min tang nyul ma sa lkog tu da ②thang brang zhes pa ni khang pa med pa'i sder thang du sdod gnas byas pa'i don te spyir glu tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos byang shar lngar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung cun gsum pa khrid nas ljar jag la dmag 'thab byed pa'i tshe/ re zhig la dgra bo'i stobs shugs che drags pas/ kho tsho ni 'dam chus gang ba'i na gzhong du par byol tshur byol byed dgos byung yang / dmag mi'i hur sems da dung shin tu mtho ba la rtsom pa pos dmangs mi'i spobs pa bskyed phyir glu tshig 'di ched du brtsams pa yin no//du'adir byang shar zhes pa ni rang rgyal gyi byang shar sa khul te da lta'i he lung cang dang ci lin dang le'o nying ste zhing chen gsum gyi sa cha spyi la bstan pa yin no//khong/ rdoci /da po rbab chu ni rbab chu zhig gi ming ste he lung cang zhing chen nying an rdzong gi 238

wang ru'o hphe snyan ngag tshig rkang gnyisami'achi ba'i lam nas thar ba 'thab rtsod nyid la rag/lcags kyi sge'us sra brtan blo sems gcun mi thub//mchan 'grel/duwang ru'o hphe (14 ༄1896 1946) kos krig zhing chen an hrun gyi mi yin/ 1921lor hpha ran sir slob gnyer la phebs shing de ru khong dang blo mthun kri'u en le dang kra'o hri yan bcas kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs na gzhon tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ lo der da dung krung go gung khran tang yo rub yan lag tshogs pa'ang btsugs/1923lor su'u len ma'o zi khor phebs nas shar phyogs ngal rtsol slob grwa chen mor slob gnyer mdzad/ 1925lor phyir log ste snga phyir yus hran khul tang u'i hru'u ci dang cang su'u zhing u'i hru'u ci/ krung gung krung dbyang gi drung yig chen mo/ gung khran rgyal spyi'i krung go'i 'thus tshab/ hran kun nying khul u'i dril bsgrags pu'u krang / mnyam 'dus cun bco brgyad pa'i tshan mu'u krang gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1927lor krung go gung khran tang thengs lnga ba'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen steng krung dbyang u yon du bdams/ 1931lor sos yon du 'dzin bzung thebs te btson la bcug dgra bos blo 'gugs kyi thabs sna tshogs spyad kyang wang ru'o gle'i gsar brje'i blo sems bsgyur ma thub/1936lor tang gi 'bad brtson la brten nas btson grol thob/ lngar 'gog dmag 'khrug rgyal rjes blo mthun kri'u en le dang mnyam du khrun chin gyi go gung gros mol la zhugs/ 1946lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad nyin gnam grur bsdad de yan an du phyir log pa'i lam bar du stabs ma legs par gnam grur chag sgo byung ste grongs/⑨snyan tshig rkang ba 'di gnyis ni rtsom pa po sos yon btson khang du bzhuṭa dus btson groṭa rnams kyi gsar brje 'thab rtsod kyi spobs pa bskyed phyir ched du 'tsho bas ni 'dzum mdangs dgod cing mchi〉zhes rtsom thung zhig brtsams pa'i rtsom mjug gi tshig gnyis red/239

hong chi hreng khusnyan tshig tshan pa gcibadzetsha bo ma nyes btson du btsud pa'i gtam//glo bur kos sos tar yig nyid las gsal//lta skor lan gsum byas kyang sgrol thabs zad//rang srog gtong phod che la snying nas gus//ma sdu lhaswārnyi/hreng (rsā741878 1946) kos krig zhing chen kos dbyang gi miyin/ slob gso la mkhas pas snyan grags che/ de sngar lcags phag lo'i gsar brjer zhugs myong / 1921lor hpha ran sir slob gnyer du phyin/ phyir log rjes mu mthud du slob gso'i las don bsgrubs/ 1945lor yan an du phyin/ 1946lo'i zla gsum par yan an gyi las rigs so so'i tshab byas te zi khron du gcar rdung thebs pa'i dmangs gtso'i mi snar 'tshams 'drir phebs/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad nyin gnam grur bsdad nas phyir yan an du log pa'i lam bar stabs ma legs par chag sgo byung ste grongs/②com pa po ni blo mthun wang ru'o hphe'i zhang bo yin/ 1931lor tsha bo 'dzin bzung thebs pa'i gtam thos rjes snga phyir lan gsum la lta skor du song nas btson grol gyi thabs sna tshogs btsal kyang ma grub mod/ blo mthun wang ru'o gles gsar brje'i don du /sdo srog gtong bar phod pa'i snying stobs kyis yid 'gul thebs pas snyan tshig 'di bris 240

ye thing kṣabatson khang gi grubami par 'gro tshur 'ong gi sgo glegs dam por brgyab//khyi phar 'dzul tshur 'dzul gyi khung bu phye nas 'dug//gog nas shog dang / khyod la rang dbang ster//ngan skad sgra zhig gsang mthor sgrog pa thos//nga ni rang dbang nyid la re ches kyang //dal 'byor rten 'di khyi 'dzul khung bu las//bgrod mi rigs pa nga yis gsal bor rtogs//nga yis snying nas re sgug 'di ltar bya//nam zhig sa 'og me dpung dgung la mched pa'i mod//nga dang bem po'i phung bo lhan cig thal bar bsregs//nga ni me dpung dang khrag dron khrod du yun gnas byed par rigs so//mchan 'grel/①ye thing (7718964 1946) kong tung zhing chen hos dbyang gi mi yin/1924lor su'u len du phebs nas snga phyir shar phyogs slob grwa chen mo dang dmag don slob grwa chen mo 'grims/ 1925lor phyir log rgyal nang gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po'i skabs/ rgyal dmangs gsar brje dmag thad gtogs thon gyi thon krang dang / hri nyer bzhi pa'i hri krang / cun bcu gcig pa'i cun krang bcas kyi 'gan khur/1927lor snga phyir nan khrang 'os langs dang kong krig 'os langs la zhugs/ ljar 'gog 241

dmag 'khrugaskabasasuzhin si cun cun krang gi 'gan khur/ 1941lor wan nan don 'gyur gyi nang du 'dzin bzung thebs shing snga phyir cang zhi'i phong ra'o dang hu'u pe'i yin hri/kong zhi'i kos lin/ khrun chin gyi kra tsi tung bcas su btson 'jug byas/ 1946lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes bzhi nyin krung dbyang gi 'bad brtson las btson grol thob/ btson las grol ma thag tu krung dbyang la tar yig gi lam nas tang la zhugs pa'i re 'dod bton pas zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun nyin krung dbyang gi chog mchan thob ste tang la zhugs/ zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad nyin khrun chin nas gnam grur bsdad de yan an du phebs pa'i lam bar du gnam grur chag sgo byung nas grongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po khrung chin gyi kra tsi tung zhes pa'i btson khang du bzhugs skabs sdod khang gi rtsig pa'i ngor bris pa zhis red/242

kon zhang dbyinakṣaskyod lamakhadamag skyod rdul gyis zla 'od mog por bsgribs//cang shes mig rtser tsha tsha'i me stag 'bar//dpung chen gtsang bo'i pha rol brgal ba'i mthus//chu ngos zla gzugs tshal ba brgya phrag btang //glog mes rta pho'i rmig sgra deb bzhin thal//sgron 'od dang bcas mthong byed lam nas yal//mchakā rsha/ kā/nga dbyin (cho/771903 1946) man ju rigs/ le'o nying zhing chen cin zhan gyi mi yin/ 1923lor krung go'i spyi tshogs ring lugs na gzhon tshogs par zhugs/ 1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1928lor tang gi thengs drug pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen steng krung dbyang u yon du bdams shing / snga phyir krung go'i gung gzhon tshogs pa'i hru'u ci dang / dmar dmag hphang men cun gnyis pa'i chab srid u yon/ pa lu'u cun hri 120pa'i chab srid u yon bcas kyi 'gan khur/1945lor tang gi thengs bdun pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen steng slar yang krung dbyang u yon du bdams/ 1946lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin yan an du sku bsnyungs te sman bcos kyis ma phan par grongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni dmag dpung mtshan mor gtsang po brgal nas skyod pa'i tshul de mthong nas shar mar bris pa zhig go//243

lu'o hri wunakṣasnyan tshig tshan pa gcilaldemes rgyal ri klung mdzes sdug bkra//dpyid dpal rgyas par kun gyis re//8 dpa' bos gcig gyur byed par rlom/kṣamatha' mar dgod mkhan su dang gang /rdzim sdu kāshārnyi/lun (7741904 1946) si khron zhing chen we yon gyi mi yin/1923lor krung go spyi tshogs ring lugs na gzhon tshogs par zhugs/ 1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing / krung gung khron lho khul u'i hru'u ci dang / si khron zhing u'i hru'u ci/ pa lu'u cun khrin tu'u don sgrub khang gi kru'u rin/ zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang khrin tu'u yan lag khang gi hre krang bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1940lor 'dzin bzung thebs/1946lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes bco brgyad nyin khrun chin du bkrongs/mtsho/khya/ tshig 'dis rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis bcings 'grol byed par re zhing sgug pa'i don du'adir 6 dpa' bo mi zhes pa ni cang ce hri la 'phya ba'i tshig ste/ khos de snga rgyal yongs gcig gyur byed rgyu yin zhes kha pho btang myong ba yin yang don la ma nus pas na rang nyid dpa' bo yin par rlom yang dpa' bo ma yin pa'i don bstan/②mtha' mar dgod pa zhes pa ni mtha' ma'i rgyal kha 'thob pa'i don la 'jug ste mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha ni mi dmangs la 'thob nges kyi yid ches yod pa bstan/244

khre ya'o zhanakṣadam tshigardzigazhon dus ral gri 'phyar yang snying rje bsgoms//sdig pa bshags nas sangs rgyas sgrub par rtsom//gsar rnying bstan bcos yang yang bklags pa na/jithams cad mi sems rmongs byed nyid du mthong //dmangs khrod zhugs shing rgyus mnga' lon pa na//'dzam gling spyi snyoms byed par yid ches bskyed/khugasar brje'i rlabs kyis sngar skyon dri ma 'dag/yul 'di gdod nas mi dmangs nyid la dbang //ngal med longs spyod rgyas pa khrel ba'i gzhi//nus med mi rnams gson yang shi dang mtshungs//bden don bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du//brtag dpyad thub na lhad med yon tan ngom//shar phyogs dge mtshan snang bas khyab pa mthong //drin lan mi gnyer dka' sdug khur du len//rang khrag dor nas sa gzhi bran pa ni//mes rgyal rtag tu zhi bde yong ba'i ched//— 245

ma spya ༵༵༵/zhan (4 ya 1894 1946) si tshun zhing chen ta hu'u yi mi yin/gung khran tang yon/ krung gung si khron zhing u'i dmag u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur myong /1940lor khrin tu'u ru blo mthun lu'o hru lun dang mnyam du 'dzin bzung thebs shing /1946lor khrun chin du bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos phal cher1929lor bris pa red/ rtsom pa po de snga dmas mi byas te dmag mi dkyus ma nas rim bzhin lis krang bar du 'phar/ dam/ga shed can phan tshun 'khrug rtsod kyi nang du thengs mang la rmas phog ste rkang pa 'theng pas dmag 'khyur byas shing gnam bdag chos lugs kyi sgor zhugs te thos bsam mang du byas mthar gnam bdab chos lugs de yang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i yo byad tsam du gyur pa mthong bas/ khong gis mes rgyal la dga' zhen che ba'i chos dad pa rnams bsdus te krung hwa gnam bdag chos lugs legs bcos tshogs pa zhig btsugs shing gsar brje'i gnas lugs dril bsgrags byas so//du'adir gsar rnying bstan bcos zhes pa ni gnam bdag chos lugs kyi gzhung (bstan bcos kun btus rnying pa 〉dang (bstan bcos kun btus gsar ba 〉zhes pa de gnyis la bstan pa yin/②'dzam gling spyi snyoms zhes pa ni gtso bo 'dzam gling yongs su gung khran ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs mngon 'gyur byed pa bstan/246

zhu'u than thing lparang srog gtong ba'i tshigazhagar 'gro grogs med hreng hreng gcig pu tsam//tshe 'dir zhen zhing chags pa'i dngos po med//dmangs kyi sdug bsngal mthong bas ma bzod de//rang lus rang dbang nyid du brje bar sems//ma~Xnazhu ༵ /sdu/ thing (tshibo 1893 1947) hran zhi zhing chen khrung zhan gyi mi yin/ 1936lor zhi an dus 'gyur byung rjes/ gung khran tang gi 'bod skul dang len byas te phyir hran zhir log nas ljar 'gog nyen skyob kyi las 'gul spel/ snga phyir hran zhi dmag gsar gyi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dang / cin sos mtha' khul gyi srid 'dzin kru'u rin/ dmag khul gyi zi lin yon gzhon pa/ krung gro mi dmangs bcings 'grol sa khul mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi gra sgrig u yon lhan khang bi kru'u rin gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1947lor hran zhir sku bsnyungs te grongs/nyu1935lor ljar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis rang rgyal la btsan 'dzul byed 'go brtsams ma thag rtsom pa ngo 'dug ma bzod par nan cing du song nas ljar 'gog gi gsal 'debs zhus kyang / cang ce hri srid gzhung gis rgyal 'tshong mgo 'dogs kyi srid jus lag len du bstar ba la snying nas khros te krung hran bang so chen po'i mdun du snyan rdzu sbri /di nyid shar mar bris shing grod pa gshags nas mi dmangs skul slong byed rtsis byas 247

li kon tshimili'o tung la skyo ba'i glu dbyangasamiskyo gdung ches pas mig chu'ang skem par gyur//yul shor sdug bsngal thog bzhin mgo la babs//jag rkun blo snying tshims pa'i dgod sgra shor//rang 'bangs ngo tshas ma bzod snying la gzan//sngar shor sa cha 'phrog nus bstod pa'i yul//phyi dgra gcig tsam bsad kyang bsngag bya'i gnas//rang la kho lag rdzogs pa'i gzugs phung ldan//khrag dron mes rgyal ched du 'dor bar rtsom//mchakā ṭwāṃ /sna/ tshi /cho'i01908 1947) ho nan zhing chen chin dbyang gi mi yin/1932lor krung go gung khran tang gis mgo 'dren byas pa'i zhing pa'i 'os langs la zhugs/ 1937lor hran zhi gzhon nu ljar 'gog srog bsdos ru khag la zhugs/ phyis su cin khra ci mtha' khul du song nas snga phyir lin hrig rdzong gi rdzong dpon/ phin zhi kron chu'i kron yon/ ci tung srid 'dzin drung yig chen mo bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1947lo'i dgun khar sku bsnyangs te sman bcos kyis ma phan par grongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos 1931lo'i zla dgu bar ljar pan gyis hrin dbyang btsan 'dzul byas tshul thos rjes khros te shar mar brtsams skad/248

lu'u kri ying lpakha byang med pa'i rtsomakhakyi hud spun zla mgo bo lhung ste gshegs//mde'us glo snying brtol nas tshe srog bcad//kho tshos rang srog btang ba'i snying stobs la//gson po rnams kyis rjes dran byed par rigs//gling 'dir bran g.yog gnas las thar byed pa'i//'thab rtsod de ni mtshungs med rlabs chen yin//phar skyod spun zla'i gdong len byed pa ni//dpa' mdzangs gtong phod che ba'i rang rtags yin//spun zla tsho kye dka' sdug bzod par gyis//spun zla tsho kye na gzir bzod par gyis//bzod stobs med na rgyal kha yod pa min//dran g.yog gnas las thar bar ga la nus//de bzhin dmyal bar sdug bsngal mi rnams la//gnam nas 'phros pa'i 'od snang ga la thob//de phyir 'khyags ltogs mnar ba'i spun zla tsho//bzod bsran dang ni 'thab rtsod rgyun skyongs shig/mchan 'grel/①lu'u kri ying (9671906 1948) hran tung zhing chen khrang hu'u yi mi yin/ 1925lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ snga phyir hran zhi/ kun su'u/ pe cin/249

then cin/ kos krig cang zhi sogs su tang gi gsang ba'i bya ba bsgrubs/ ljar 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su/ su'u pe ljar 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi zi lin yon gzhon pa'i 'gan khur/ lngar 'gog dmag 'khrug rgyal rjes/ nying po dang hrang he/ tang krig bcas su bya ba bsgrubs/ 1947lor hrang hor 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1948lo'i zla bcu gnyis par nan cing du go min tang log spyod pas bkrongs/②'di ni rtsom pa pos rang gi grogs po zhig spru can du 'dzin bzung thebs pa'i gtam ngan thos rjes shar mar bris pa zhig yin skad/

khreng go spenakṣasnyan tshig tshan pa gcig(the wan blo ma thun cang we chang nyulu'u mon du 'dzin bzung thebs par sdug lus zhu sa med pa/ra ched du tshigs bcad 'di brtsams nas gdung sems bstan pa yin/)stag sga kha nas thar yang spyang kir 'phrad//gnas sa spos kyang dgra bo'i lag mthil du//grogs khyod slar yang tshud cing yum chen gyi//zas gos ltag chu chad pa snying rje'i yul//lu'u mon gling phran nyid du zhal gyes nas//lkog rgyu gsang 'phrin mdzad tshul dran pas gdung //bshan pa'i gdug sems sngon las rtsub pa'i phyir/khushi gson ma nges gnam la dri dgos med//phan tshun bsnyes nas sems gtam mol ba dang //ring lugs dang ni snyan tshig rtsom tshul gleng //ral gri 'phyar nas dgra gte gtub par byed//dpal bskyed mig sngon can la brgal brtag bkyes/kṣasbyid lug byas na don chen mi 'grub phyir//dus dang skal bas mi la sgug pa med//snying stobs ma nyams spobs pa skyed kyis dang //gsar brjer rgyal kha 'thob pa'i dus shig mchi//251

ma kā kāswākā/kren (ṣṭha༅71898 19ga) dru can zhing chen phu'u then gyi mi yin/1928lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs shing / tang nang du dmag u'i 'brel gtug phyogs kyi las ka byas/ hra med grong khyer du btson pa 'phrog skyob byed pa'i 'thab rtsod thengs gnyis byas pa'i nang du/ rtsom pa pos 〈〈tshong las tshags par 〉〉rtsom sgrig pa gtso bo'i ming g.yar nas btson las bskyabs pa'i blo mthun sbed skung byas/ 1934lor blo log pas gsang brtol bas 'dzin bzung thebs/ btson grol byas rjes tang bis khong nyid hrang hre dang su'u nan sa khul bcas la mngags nas bya ba bsgrubs/ 1942lor nan dbyang du phyin nas spru can tshogs khang du bya ba bsgrubs/ 1943lor sing ka pho ru zla deb gnyis gtso sgrig byas/ 1946lor phyir log nas tang gi mngag bcol ltar men nan sa khul du phyin te gsang ba'i tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 1949lor go min tang log spyod pas 'dzin bzung byas shing cang ma 'gror bar bkrongs/②cang we ching zhes pa rtsom pa po'i grogs po zhig gi ming / de snga rtsom pa pos hra men grong khyer du 〈〈tshong las tshags par 〉〉gyi rtsom sgrig pa'i gtso 'gan 'khur ba la brten te gsang ba'i sgo nas tang bi dmag u'i las ka byed skabs/ blo mthun cang we ching gi rogs lam la brten nas lngar pan du dpar skrun byas pa'i krung go'i gsang ba'i dmag don sa khra 'ga' nyos te su'u khul du bskur ba phyis su gsang brtol bas stabs ma legs par dgra bos 'dzin bzung byas pa red/dubashan pa zhes pa ni 'dir go min tang log spyod phyogs khag la bstan/④mig sngon can zhes pa ni 'dir mig sngon po can gyi phyi gling pa la bstan/252

ga'o pogyibatson khang gi snyan tshigaldedamangs kyi don du sdig btsan tshar gcod byed/khu'aphar spyang tshogs la skrag don ci yang med//btson gyi gzeb tu rang lus btsud pas na//han gyi su'u wu'u rnam thar skyong bar rigs/gyimachakā /shā kā/ (lo7) gung khran tang yon/ rgyal nang gsar brje dmag 'khrug thengs gsum pa'i skabs su/ bcings 'grol dmag sga gsar btsugs li'u bcu gcig pa'i thon dang po'i chab srid u yon gyi 'gan khur/ 1947lor hran per go min tang log spyod pas 'dzin bzung byas te dang thob lan gru ru bkag 1949lo'i zla gnyis par nan cing du khrid de ma 'gor bar bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po lan gru'i btson khang du yod skabs bris skad/0sdig btsan zhes pa ni 'dir go min tang log spyod pa bstan/②su'u wu'u zhes pa ni han rgyal rabs kyi mi zhig gi ming / de snga byang phyogs kyi zhun nu'u ste hor gyis han rgyal rabs la dmag bkyes nas su'u wu'u bzung zhing yun ring la bkag kyang / su 'u yi han la blo dkar pa'i sems ni gtan nas bsgyur ma nus/ phyis su hor dang han gnyis mthun 'grig byung bas/ su'u wu'u gzhi nas han la log thub pa byung /'dir rtsom pa pos rang nyid ni btson la bkag kyang tang dang gsar brjer blo dkar ba'i sems ni nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i chod sems bstan pa yin/253

ren ru'emigaces bu g.yul la brdzongs pa/gces bu g.yul la bsdangs// spobs pa gzengs su mtho//dgung lo lnga yi tshe// pha ni gsar brjer gshegs//'khyags ltogs sdug bsngal myangs// bcu bzhir dmag la zhugs//ma sems bu la 'khreng // krung hwa'i yul gru 'dir//g.yu 'brug du mas khyab// bu yi skyid sdug nyid//shes pa'i go skabs phra// de snga gyes pa'i mod//da dung byis pa'i tshul// de ring 'phrad pa na//pha dang dbyer mi phyed// gdong la mchi mas bran//sngar 'das brjed mi srid// pha shul bus bzung nas//g.yul la chas par byed//ma pa sdo snrodro /(4rwa lko) gung khran tang yon/ sngon gshegs dpa' bo sung pin lin gyi bza' zla yin/ 1927lor khyo bo dgra bos bkrongs rjes/ kho mos bu phrug skyong ba'i 'gan rang khur byas te lo bcu gcig gi ring la dka' sdug tshad med myangs/1938lor yan an du slebs shing snga phyir lngar 'gog dmag srid slob grwa chen mo dang mar le slob grwa chen mor zhugs nas slob gnyer byas/ 1949lo'i zla bzhi bar then cing du bsnyungs nas grongs/254

yu'u win hanakhugazeb dra'i kha yi zla 'od mthong ba'i 'char snang /gzeb dra'i kha yi zla 'od dkar zhing gsal//tshe rabs phreng bar zhe 'khon zhi mi 'gyur//rang gi shi gson gnyi ga rgyab tu bskyur//phyis kyi khrel gzhir mi 'gyur gnad du gal//mchakā kā/ trī/na han (༅4719174 1949) si khron zhing chen nying zhan gyi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon/ 1942lor krung gung ta zhan gyi rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1949lor krung gung khron lho'i rdzong drug gi mtha' khul rdzong u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1949lo'i zla lnga bar 'dzin bzung thebs/ zla bdun pa'i nang bkrongs/255

khrin ranakṣang yi ngos len yi geldirkang pa'i 'dabs la lcags sgrog ljid mos dpyangs pa/'am//khyod kyis 'brab lcags ring mo mthon por bsgrengs kyang rung //brang khar khrag sbags mda' gri gzas te 'phyar na'ang //nga la ngos len bya rgyu ci dang gang yang med//mi zhig yin na bla med mgo bo sgur mi srid//snying chung snar mas gzod nas lha rang dbang sa slong bar byed//mi bzad gcar rdung tsha drag byas kyang ji mi snyam//shi yang nga yi smra byed kha de gdangs mi srid//'chi bdag mdun du skad gsang mthon pos gad rgyangs sgrog/gad rgyangs sgra yis gshin rje'i pho brang g.yo zhing sgu la//rgyal kha'i grur bsdebs cang jag rgyal rabs rtsa rdzogs byed//'di ni gung khran tang yon nga yi ngos len yin//mchanahu ༷/sna ra/ na (mcho 19234 19ga) ho pe zhing chen ta men gyi mi yin/ ljar 'bog dmag 'khrug skabs su krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ 1947lor krung gung khrun chin grong khyer u yon lhan khang nas maso 'dren byas pa'i gsang ba'i tshags par 〈〈ma dun skyod tshags par 〉〉gyi dmigs bsal yan lag khang sga hru'u ci'i 'gan khur/ 1948lo'i zla bzhi bar 'dzin bzung thebs/ 1949lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin bkrongs/256
/ rjesakhang 'di
