zhu'u zha'o zhonakhro)'das grogs zhu'u jan ye la mchod palhomi shis gtam ngan btson khang nang la khyab//gdung bas ma bzod so sgra thag thag grags//wun hran snying stobs tshe rabs phreng bar 'barakṣaye thing spobs pa rang gshis khyad chos ldan/khu)nyes rdung byas kyang phar la gshe ba'i gtam//ma chad ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa bzhin//rang srog gtong la mi 'jigs spobs pa rgyas//nyen kha'i mdun du bag bde'i glu dbyangs gyer//mi rnams dpa' bo'i 'dun mar mos gus bskyed//mchan 'grel/duzhu'u zha'o zhon (734 19164 1949) cang su'u zhing chen wu'u zhi'i mi yin/ 1938lor krung go gung khran tang la zhugs/ de sngar khrun chin du 〈〈zhin hwa nyin re'i tshags par 〉〉nang du las ka byas shing 〈〈na gzhon gyi 'tsho ba 〉zhes pa'i dus deb kyi gtso sgrig pa dang / krung gung si byon shar ma'i dmigs bsal khul u'i na gzhon u yon lhan khang gi dril bsgrags pu'u krang gi 'gan khur/ 1940lor 'dzin bzung thebs te/khrun chin gyi lha krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam las khang zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug 1949lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin bkrongs/0yizhu'u ngan ye ni rtsom pa po'i 'thab grogs shig gi ming ste/ de snga krung gung khrun rin grong khyer bzo ba'i las 'gul sgrig 'dzugs byed pa'i mgo 'dren gtso bo yin/258

1948lor bo min tang log spyod pas 'dzin bzung byas shing mi ring bar bkrongs/ snyan rdokā /de ni khong dgra bos bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul thos rjes 'das mchod kyi tshul du bris pa de / kyemiXn ngo hran zhes pa ni rang rgyal nye rabs kyi mi rigs dpa' bo wun then zhang zhes ②ye thing zhes pa ni de snga zhin zi cun gyi cun krang yin/ wan nan don 'gyur gyi nang du 'dzin bzung thebs te/ khrun chin gyi kra tsi tung btson khang du bkag myong / phyis tang bi 'bad brtson la brten nas btson grol thob/ 1946lo'i zla bzhi bar yan an du los skabs gnam grur chag sgo byung te grongs/

ho cin dzinasakhri mun zhabs ma/thil rdol bar byedamimi rabs phyi ma'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i ched nga tshor khri mun brdol reg bar du sdod snying yod/nga tsho ni lhan skyes kyi rang lugs tha dad pa yin/nga tshos mtho mjug slog zin pa'i 'jig rten 'di phyir slog par byed/nga tshos lugs dang mi mthun pa yod tshad rtsa rdzogs byed/de ring nga tsho khri mun du tshud kyang de la ya mtshan ci/mi rabs phyi ma'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i ched/nga tshor khri mun brdol reg bar du sdod snying yod/ mchakā lha :rdo/ phin (rdo/mag 1918 1949) si khron zhing chen sba zhan gyi mi yin/gung khran tang yon/ de snga khrun rin glog shugs kung zir las ka byas/ 1948lo'i zla bzhi bar 'dzin bzung thebs shing 6 grung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang zhes ༵༵ //na khang du bcug 1949lo khrun chin grong khyer bcings 'grol 'thob khar ⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos btson khang nang du brtsams shing de la dbyangs rta'ang sbrags pas btson grogs rnams kyi dga' bsu thob skad/260

lu'u tsu'u hreng kṣanyi mar lde ba/nyi 'od gzigs ma gor mo'i rdo steng spro/nga yi lus la drod khol 'dzoms par gyur/kyi hud de yang gshin rje'i khrims la 'gal/lha nyin/ ngo tsha khrel 'das tsho/’ smin ma bsdus shing sdang mig bgrad/mi dang byol song 'dus pa'i mkhar rdzong nang /kun spyod/ khrims lugs/ drag shugs/dngul sgor so gas/mtha' dag mi sha za ba'i spyang ki bzhin/dpyid kyi drod khol jag rkun rnams la dbang /dgun gyi 'khyags grang dbul bo'i nor du bsgoms/nga rang gor mo'i rdo steng yar 'greng nas/gdeng dang spobs pas khengs bzhin 'di skad sgroganam zhig nga tsho mkhar rdzong rtse mo ru/'greng ste skad gsang mthon pos nyi ma ni/nga tshor dbang zhes sgrog pa'i dus shig mchi/261

mchakā pa/ dī/'greng (lkoma'i1926 1949) cang zhi zhing chen hu'u khug gi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon/ lo bcu gsum steng khrun rin dmag chas bzo grwa ang gcig pa'i nang du bzo ba'i las ka byas/ 1948lor 'dzin bzung thebs shing 6 krung me lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug tsha gcun drag pa'i mnar gcod ji 'dra byas kyang blo sems ye nas ma 'gyur/ 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/

pe hreng drukṣame togang rang me tog la dga'/nga rang zhogs pa'i zil ba dang bcas shar gyi mtshams sprin bsu zhing /skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i me tog la dga'/grang ngar dang ni smag par 'jigs pa med/dgun gsum gyi mtshan mor bzhad pa'i me tog gis/da gzod mtshar sdug rnam par bkra ba'i khyad chos mngon/skyi bser gyi rlung la'ang skrag pa min/'jo sgeg yid du 'ong ba'i me tog ni/da gzod bye rdul 'tshub pa'i byang yul du bzhad pa yin/nga rang me tog la dga'/nga rang dka' sdug gi nang nas skyes pa'i me tog la dga'/gang bu'i 'dzum rgya nyer 'tshes zhig na'ang /grangs med gsar skyes me tog tshom bur bkra/me tog gcig ni rnying shing skam na'ang /grangs med me tog gsar ba 'khrungs byed kyi/gzhal yas 'bras bu sa la 'thor min nam/nga ni rnying bral rtag pa'i me tog la/26 3

dga' 'o dga' 'o rang gshis 'gyur med dang /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal nus de la dga'/ltos dang me tog med pa'i sa cha med/snum gshin dang ni rgyu zhan sa khul du/rigs sna mi gcig me tog bzhad pa mtshungs/mgrin pa med kyang sgam chung gru bzhi'i nang /skul med glog gi me tog rgyu spun bsgrigasakhri'ide yi steng na nga tsho'i re snyeg gi/'dun ma'i mtshar sdug me tog lhug par bzhad/nga rang me tog la dga'/'do// ni mes rgyal gyi don du khrag ltar dmar ba'i me tog cig tu 'gyur bar mchakā ༵ gāswā/ rlu ( sdu zlo) gung khran tang yon/ si khron zhing chen pis hran gyi mi yin/si khyon ho cang dang kong an sa khul bcas su slob ma'i las 'gul sgrig 'dzugs kyi bya ba bsgrubs myong / 1948lor 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi (krung me'i las rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang :zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la gtogs/ rtsom pa pos me tog bstod pa la brten nas rang nyid kyi gsar brje'i 'dun ma dang snying stobs mtshon pa red/shug/ dri// spya /ga tu bcings 'grol sa khul gyi rgyang bsgrags nyan skabs kyi spro snang de 264

ho zhu'e sung kṣabla srog la bstod pakhikhyod ni tan nyang gi rnam 'phrul dang kṣakhyod ni so hphe ya'i rigs skyes yinatatamin/ khyod ni khyod yin/khyod ni krung hwa bu mo'i gsar brje'i dpe gzhi yin/mchakā lha shārnyi/ sung ( /za7) si khron zhing chen /'o zhan gyi mi yin/ 1947lo'i zla brgyad par drag po'i 'os langs sgrig 'dzugs byed sgang la 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi ru krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang mi ste kra tsi tung btson lang du bcug btson khang du'ang hur brtson gyis tang gi bya ba bsgrubs/ 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/ bcings 'grol byas rjes khong nyid gung khran tang yon yin par khas len mdzad/⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po 'dzin bzung thebs te khrun chin gyi kra tsi tung btson khang du yod skabs/ khong gis dngos su brtsams shing gsar brje pa thun mong gis dpa' mo cang kru'u cun la phul ba'i bstod tshig cig red/ de yang dpa' mo cang kru'u cun ni si khron zhing chen gyi mi yin/ 1939lor krung go gung khun tang la zhugs/ 1947lor tang gis kho mo khron shar zhing grong du mngags te zhing pa'i drag po'i 'os langs sgrig 'dzugs kyi bya ba bsgrubs shing khron shar smad khul gyi khul u'i u yon gyi 'gan khur/ 1948lo'i dbyar khar blo log pas gsang brtol bas 'dzin 'azung thebs shing / khrun chin gyi lha krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang zhes pa'am kra tsi tung zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug ste/ mnar gcod bzod glags med pa myangs kyang blo brtan 'gyur ba med pas btson grogs rnams la bskul ma chen po thebs shing kho mo la mos gus skyes/ 1949lor 265

khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/0tan nyang zhes pa ni su'u len rgyal skyob dmag 'khrug skabs kyi dpa' mo grags can kro ya zhes pa de'i ming gzhan zhis ste/ 'jar man hpha shi si'i dmag dpung gis su'u len la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i skabs su/ 1941lo'i zla bcu gcig par kho mos dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs su nges med 'jab rgol gyi las ka byed sgang la stabs ma legs par 'dzin bzung thebs shing mnar bcod ji 'dra myangs kyang dgra bor mgo ma btags pas bkrongs/duso hphe ya zhes pa ni u ru si'i hra hong gong ma'i skabs kyi dbang sgyur gral rim la ngo rgol byed mkhan dpa' mo zhig sga ming /

lan tis yus bu phrug la gdams pathang yi gces phrug keng hong khyod/khyamya ngam thang nas tshur la byon//slar yang mya ngam thang la bzhud//ma bu gtan 'bral byed dus slebs//srang lam ce spyang tshogs kyis 'gengs//thang la rtse dbal tsher mas khyab//do dgong khyod dang gtan 'bral khar//kha chems tshig gsum bshad kyis gson//ston dpyid brje ba'i snying stobs kyis//mes rgyal mya ngam thang chen 'di//yid 'ong kun dga'i skyed tshal du//mchan 'grel/ skrun cig nga yi gces phrug lags/①lan ting lus (༅lko 61916 1949) si khron zhing chen leng phin gyi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon/ 1948lo'i dgun khar 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi 4krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang mi ste kra tsi tung btson khang du bcugardo/ des ༵༵nga ṭwāṃ /bcu bar kho mo dang blo mthun khrin ran sogs mnyam gcig tu khrun chin ta ⑨snyan tshig 'di ni rtsom pa po gsod rar 'gro khar khrun chin kra tsi tung btson khang gi blo mthun rnams la sprad nas bu phrug la 'phrod par byas pa'i kha chems yin skad/rjokeng heng zhes pa ni rtsom pa po'i bu phrug gi ming yin/267

ku'u khreng gri'okṣadam bca'aba'athab 'dzing gi lo rabs nang du//snying dbus kyi dam bca' 'di ltar//rlung 'tshub dang drag char zung gi//rgol ba la gzhar yang mi skrag/me rlung dang dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs//dpa' mdzangs kyi gad rgyangs sgrog pas//mi nga yi snying khong dbus su//spro snang gi tsha rlabs 'phyur song //nor med kyi dbul bo sprang bo//khyim med kyi thang nyul 'khyams po//gos med kyi nyam thag 'gro bar//bcos min gyi snying rje skyes byung //'dod ham gyi 'khor lo bskor te//mi dmangs la gnya' gnon byed cing //bden don la tho co byed pa'i//jag rkun dag nga yi dgra yin//bden don dang drang bden zung ni//nga nyid kyi gnyer bya yin phyir//268

mi'i rigs kyi rang dbang bde skyid//brtson len la 'jug par byed nges//ma sdu // rnyi/nga hre'o (8rsāṣṭha19204 1949) si khron zhing chen nan khron gyi mi yin/ gung khran tang yon/ khong ni snyan ngag pa dang rol dbyangs mkhas can yin pas/de snga cang ce hri log spyod phyogs khag la ngo rgol byed pa'i glu dbyangs mang po brtsams/1948lo'i zla lnga bar 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi lha krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang ste kra tsi tung btson khang du bcug 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/②dam tshig 'di ni rtsom pa pos1948lor kra tsi tung btson khang nang du bris pa'o//269

hrin ti chodamibe shing lo ma/be shing lo ma'i ngos gnyis bskams//phyogs dang phyogs nas 'bru khral bsdus//dmangs la sdug bsngal tshad med bzos//ma bzod cho nge'i gdung dbyangs 'chor//'bru khral bsdus pas ci zhig bya//thams cad nang 'khrug ched du'o//rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ཿhring ti chon (7771908 1949) si khron nan khyon gyi mi yin/ lngar 'grog dmag 'khrug dang bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs su/ khrun chin du rig gnas kyi las ka byas te/ sngon thon dus deb 〈〈gson lam 〉smonas pa zhib gtso sgrig byas myong 1948lo'i zla brgyad par 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi 6grung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang te kra tsi tung btson khang du bkag 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/270

a'e wun zhinakṣablo mthun lun kong krang la mya ngan zhu btang tsho la mig chu mi dgos/nga tsho la sems gso mi dbos/krung rgo'i mi rabs chad med pas/khrag gis bris pa'i rtsis tho 'di/lo rgyus kyi rdo ring zhig yin/'chi ba ni mi 'jig pa'i rtags yin/'chi ba ni 'thab 'dzing bi me dpung zhi ba min/khong bi nam yang mi 'jig pa'i rnam shes de/sngo zhing ljang ba'i ki lo ri bo'i rtse mor 'grengs nas zhogs pa'i nyi gzhon bsu bar smon/mchan 'grel du.a'e wun zhon (4441913 1949) si khron zhing chen kong an gyi mi yin/ 1948lor khron byang drag po'i 'os langs la zhugs/ 'dzin bzung thebs rjes khrun chin gyi lha krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang gi btson khang du bcug1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/①blo mthun lun kong krang ni de snga krung yon bcings 'grol sa khul gyi bcings 'grol dmag mi zhig red/ 1946lor 'thab 'dzing zhig gi nang du rmas phog ste 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin zu krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang zhes pa'i btson khang du bcug nas mnar gcod yun ring btang yang blo ma 'gyur/ 1948lo'i zla 271

bcu gnyisapa'i tshes bco lnga nyin btson khang du grongs/ khong grongs rjes btson khang gi blo pa/shā rdo ṭwāṃ // ngan tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas mya ngan zhus/ snyan tshig 'di ni de dus duki lo ri bo zhes pa ni khrun chin gyi kra tsi tung btson khang yod sa'i ri bo de'i ming /

tshale meng le7khri mun gyi snyan tshigaldegacigalag mthil tsam las med pa'i lhas ra/tshags khung tsam las med pa'i nam mkha'/dpa' mi zhum pa'i mi nyis brgya lhag tsam/rtsig pa mthon pos bskor ba'i gnas 'di ru btsud/sgo lcags chen po zhig gis 'jig rten 'di cha gnyis su bgos/mkha' dbugs/nyi 'od/btung chu/tshad yod pa'i sgo nas 'thob/mi ni gnag phyugs kyi gras su bzhag cing /brlan zhing smag nag pa'i khang ba'i nang du bkagarkang pa yod kyang mdun du bgrod pa'i lam med/rlung sgo'i 'gram du/skyo sdug gi sa srod phar la bskyal/gser mdog gi nyi gzhon bsu bar sgugar ba'i phyi rol gyi ri sgang ni ser po nas sngon por gyur/lo dus ci dang ci tsam/ ci dang ci tsam/273

thams cad re sgug gi ngang la re re bzhin 'das/rtsig pa ni 'di 'dra mtho ba la/mda' dang gtsags gris tshags dam dra ba bsgrigs/nam mkha'i 'dab chags yod tshad zin nas rdzogs sam/brgya la gshog 'dab gnyi ga bregs na yang /glag rgod kyis nam 'phang gcod pa'i dran pa ga la 'thor/byi'u zhig gi 'phur gzugs tsam gzeb dra'i kha nas pal yang /sems ni rang dbang med par lding zhing 'phyo ba zhig byung /'tsho ba ni dpar shing gi nang du blugs pa bzhin/de ring ni grangs med pa'i kha sang gi dpar ma tsam/chag sgo'i snga ltas ni/bar snang gi sprin nag bzhin du mgo bor 'thibs/mtshan mo'i gung la zugaganyid la yur ba'i sdur sgra 'then na yang /dbang rtse'i sne mo zhig gis rna ba'i 'gram du mel tshe byed/rmis lab kyis bslangs pa'i mig lam du/da dung 'jigs rung rmi lam du ma'i gzugs brnyan 'char/lo rabs ga tshod nas bzung /btson khang ni gyen ldog pa'i gnas khang du gyur/char dang rlung 'tshub che ba'i mtshan mo ru/mgron po rnams 'jigs rung gnas khang 'di ru bkagagasal la mi gsal ba'i sgron 'od de sgo yol gyi srubs ka nas 'phro ba'i tshe/274

'od dang grib gzugs gnyis kyi 'gal 'du'i ri mo yongs su grub/dpa' rgod kyi rmad byung gtam rgyud de/mi dang gcan gzan 'thab pa'i gtam rgyud ni/gdong gi dkyil 'khor 'di las rim par brjod/mi su dang gang zhigamadzad pa ci dang ci zhigathams cad lha sgrung nang gi byung rim bzhin ngo mtshar ldan zhing /thams cad dus rabs chen po'i rol dbyangs nang gi dbyangs tshan zhig yin las che/gerang dbang ang /bsdug bsngal ang /tshe srog gi sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/'dar sig sig gi dbyangs rim de gnyis phreng ba dang mtshungs/bya pho'i skad gsang sgrog nyid gnam la bltas/da ni nam gsal ran pa'i dus la slebs/gnyis/khri mun gyi sgo ni khyod la'ang phye myong ste/rkang ba ya gcig spos pa tsam gyis sgo yi them pa brgal bar nus/lde mig 'dzin pa'i mi bdag gis/khyod la 'dod pa ci zhig mchi/las don yang na chab srid sgrub bam ci/nga yis khyod la dpon gnas ster/275

nga yis khyod la kung zi dang ni dngul khang dang /dpe khang tshags par khang sogs ci 'dod ster/—de min na/ hin/sna dgod gcig gis skad cha'i nang gi gri gug sbed par byas/grub thob can gyis bdud kyi cho 'phrul bshig pa bzhin/khyod kyis khe dang dbang gi bslu brid rgyang du dor te/sko mjing mdun la bsrings nas/sdug gi khu ba rngub thengs gcig gis mar la mid/smin ma'ang 'gul tsam yang ma byas/gser gyi phung bo'i 'gram nas song yang sems ma shor/'jo sgeg g.yer bag can gyi gam la phyin kyang mig ma 'phrogabyams pa'i mig mdangs/ma yum gyi 'dzum ris na gzhon rnams kyi brtse sems ji 'dra mang po zhigabartse dung gi lag pas tshal ba du mar gshags shing ral/kye ma/ khyod ni gzi brjid kyi rgyal thabs can/khyod kyis mgo bo gug tsam dang g.yo tsam byas ma nyid der/tsha drag gi 'thab 'dzing ji 'dra zhig brgyud pa red ang /khyod kyis skad cig tsam gyi 'thab rtsod du ma'i nang du/gzhi gang zhig la brten nas da gzod dgra bo brtsegs ma las rgyal bar byas pa yin/g.yul ngo'i dpa' rtul dang 'dra bar/lag pa g.yas la dad pa brtan po'i phub bzung zhing /276

g.yon du spobs pa chen po'i ral gri 'phyar ba yin/de nas bzung / btson khang gi sgo la tshe lcags brgyab/zangs mdog can gyi lde mig de/khyod kyi mig lam du gtan nas brgyud ma myong /—mi rabs phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gtsang sel byed ched/nga tshos btson khang 'di'i zhabs brdol reg tu 'dug snying bcangs/mi sems nyis brgya lhag gis lding stangs gcig dang /mi nyis brgya lhag gis nyin de 'dra zhig la re sgug byed pa yin te/rang nyid kyi spun zla tsho slebs nas/me mda'i yu bas sgo lcags gtor bar byed par sgug go//gsum/mi yi skad cha bshad nas/mi yi gyon chas gyon zhing /mi dang cha lugs kun nas mtshungs kyang /sbrul dang spyang ki'i glo snying ldan/skye dngos rig pa bas zhib 'jug gyis dang /'jig rten na srog chags 'di 'dra yod dam ci/'di yi mi nyis brgya lhag tsam/re re bzhin dpang bo gson po yin/mi re re'i lus steng du kho tshos bzhag pa'i sder shul yod/lcags tsha mos brang la gsur ba dang /smyug ma'i snyung bu sen mo re rer brdabs/277

chu grang mo rna yi bu gar blugaglog gi tsha rgyun lus kyi steng la btang 'on kyang mi yi snying rus ni/dmyal khams kyi me lce'i nang du btso sbyang byas te/gser bzang gi mdangs bzhin dwangs shing gsal la/gser gyi rdo rje bzhin du sra zhing brtan/sha dang pags pa bsregs kyang rung /rgyus dang rus pa bcag kyang bla/lcags kyi dbyug pa dang shing gi rgyug pas/dam du bsdams pa'i kha sha 'byed mi nus/de ni 'thab mo ba khri stong gi bde 'jags srung ba'i kha red/gtsags gris grod pa gshags na yang /dmar zhing tsha ba'i snying mchin las cang ma mchis/66stag gi stegs bu/mi bya gag chu rkyal/ ’66chu yi bal ba/mi lhaganam grus sgo nga gtong ba/ ’de 'dra la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ni ji 'dra mtshar ba la ang /kho tsho'i tshig mdzod kyi nang du gyen ldog pa rnams mnar byed dang /rang nyid spro bsang byed pa'i rol rtsed las gzhan ma mchis/'on kyang mi'i rigs kyi 'thab rtsod lo rgyus steng du/'di ni rno lcags bzhu ba'i me thab dang /g.yang ṭir zhib ris bkod pa'i brdar rdo lta bu yin zhes khrag ltar dmar ba'i yi ges zhib tu bkod yod/kye kye rkang ba bcag pa'i khyod/278

kye kye dpung ba grum pa'i kho/khyod tshos me tog gi 'dab brgya grol ba'i ched/gser 'dra ba'i 'bras bu yongs su smin pa'i slad/rang nyid kyi phung bo skyon can du btang ba min nam/kye ho 'bras bu thon pa'i dus la slebs 'dugakhyod kyi grogs po dang bza' zla/blo mthun bcas kyi mdun du/khyod kyi lus steng gi rma kha re res kyang /de yis mtshon pa'i gzi brjid dang /don snying gsal bar mngon/bzhi/kye/ dga' bsu zhu/mdza' brtse ldan pa'i 'thab grogs sam blo mthun lags/khyod ni gang nas byon/rdzong dang grong sde gang gi yin/de ru bcings 'grol gyi rlabs phreng 'phyur ram ci/'di na mi gtsang rtog pa'i chu khol dang /spyad 'phro'i tha mag sne mo tsam las med/ 'on kyang mnyes gshin ldan pa'i mdzub rtse yis/gshin rje'i yul du slebs pa'i 'jigs pa sel/mnar gcod byas ma thag pa'i blo sems dang /bcon las byas ma thag pa'i phung bo ni/

chu tshan gyi nang du zhugs pa nang bzhin bde 'bol gyur/'khyags shur shur gyi mtshan mor/srab cing rnying ba'i thul sne zhig sbyin pa des/lus sems yongs la drod khol zhig 'dzoms par gyur/kha la yug gis dpyid kyi 'phrin brda tshur la bskyal/g.yul sa nas slebs pa'i mi yis/rgyal kha'i 'phrin bzang 'di ltar sgrogabatung hran phol/—zhis hran phin/mi dmangs rnams ni yar langs thob/rlung gtong ba'i ra ba'i nang dukhumi re re'i mig zung gsal bar gyur/mi re re'i gdong la 'dzum mdangs shar/sems kyi gting nas me lce rab tu 'bar sla nga'i nang du zas med stong bar gyur/gos rul rnying hrul 'ga' zhig yod pa tsam/khyim gzhis 'thor kyang yid pham dngan pa med/char rlang drag po'i mtshan mo ru/nags gseb kyi byi'u tshang ji 'dra mang po zhig 'thor ram/rba rlabs rtse yi gru gzings ji 'dra mang po zhig rgya mtshor snub/spun zla 'dra ba'i btson grogs phan tshun bar/khyod kyis yul mi'i 'dra gzugs mthong ba dang /yul mi lta bu'i mdza' brtse rol bar 'gyur/280

rgya mtsho mar la bri ba bzhin/sa'i bshong bu'i nang du bskyur ba'i nya mo dgathun mong gi sdug bsngal dang /thun mong gi re 'dun la brten nas/lteng ma'i chu dang wu ba'i nang du gnas rten 'cha'/kye ho/ rgya mtsho rgyas pa'i 'ur sgra chen po sgrogari skul mtsho skyom byed pa'i rba rlabs kyi phreng ba ni/g.yo la nye byung /g.yo la nye byung / lnga/gzeb nang du tshud nga/'i glag rgod kyis/rang gi 'dab gshog zhal zhal byas te/dgung sngon mthongs su 'phur ba'i nyin der ltos shing sgugayun ring bor btson du btsud pa des/gyen ldog pa'i blo stobs bsgyur mi nus/lcags kyi gzeb dra'i nang du/nam yin yang 'thab rtsod kyi mtshon cha brdar bar byed/sa ser gyis byas pa'i sa smyug gis/sa thog tu khrid gzhi'i zin bris bkod/khyod ni slob ma dang ni bshes gnyen gnyi ga yin/khar(7en ke si/281

dbyi li chikhuyo zi rlukhyakhong dag nga tsho'i dbus su bzhugs nas ni/brtse ba'i zhal brda mang po gnang dang 'dra/blo mthun ma'o tse tung gi zhal gsung sgra/blo la yang yang bskyar te gzungs su 'dzin/'khyags grang che ba'i u ru sir/dri zhim ldang ba'i me tog ji ltar bzhad/lo rgyus ring ba'i krung hwa 'dir/bcings 'grol me dpung ji ltar mched pa dang /kha gtad dgra la 'thab 'dzing byas pa'i gtam/rang gi 'gal rkyen sna tshogs zlog pa'i tshul/gcig la gcig mthud blo ngor 'char ba de/sngo bsang khyon la skar tshogs bkra ba bzhin/rtsibs ldan 'khor lo skor ba'i bzo ba dang /'jor khem lag la 'phyar pa'i so nam pa/smyug rtse sgyur ram smra mkhas blo ldan tshos/sngon med skyed tshal gsar ba 'grub bar du/rang gi spun zla rnams kyi spyan lam du/rang gi phung bo dang ni bla srog gi/ma bcos lhun grub ngo bo gsal bstan nas/nyes byas skyon dang dri ma 'dag par bya/mchog gyur mdzes sdug bkra ba'i skyed tshal du/282

lus la mi gtsang dri mas rab sbags nas/'jug pa de ni ngo gnong gnas min nam/rkang dkris can nam rgas 'khogs can gyis kyang /bcings 'grol mi nus snyam nas ma 'phya zhigadagung grangs lnga bcur son pa'i dar yol tshos/nyin rer yi ge 'bri klog brtson la ltos/tha na mal gcin shor ba'i byis pa tshos/rmi lam ngag gis gsar brje'i gnas lugs dang /spyi tshogs gsar ba'i mdzes ljongs khyad chos brjod/mchakā kāshā trī/nga we ( rma (1 — 1949) si khron zhing chen sos nying gi mi yin/gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan dang snyan ngag pa yin/ 1948lo'i zla bzhi bar 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi 6 krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang ste kra tsi tung ༵༵/ yang du bcug 1949lo'i bcu gcig par khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar ⑨snyan rtsom 'di ni rtsom pa pos btson khang nang du ma mog bsregs pa'i thal bas byas pa'i snag chu la smyug masi bsgres nas brtsams shing bris/ 1949lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer bdun gyi mtshan mor dgra bos kho mo kra tsi tung btson khang nas gsod rar khrid pa'i lam bar du glags btsal nas rtsom 'phror lus pa'i snyan rtsom shog dril 'di lam /shā ༵ / trī /nga gseb tu g.yugs/ khrun chin bcings 'grol byas rjes rtsi shing gseb ①rlung gtong ba zhes pa ni btson pa rnams nyin re'i dus tshod nges gtan zhig gi /dro du khang phyi'i lhas rar btang nas 'cham 'cham dang 'gul skyod byed du bcug pa de la 283
sar brje'i lha ni le nyin gyi si ta lin sdi

li'u krin mekhyakha byang med pa'i rtsom/rma bya'i sgro gur mtshar sdug yid dbang 'phrog/mtshan rmis lam du log dus 'phyis par thal//lo rgyus smra ba tung hru'u gtsug tu bkur/yideng rabs shes ldan lu'u zhun snyan rtsom bsngags/khyagasar 'khrungs myu gu dbyar gyi kha bas bcom//phyi lor slar yang sngo ljang lo 'dab rgyas//tshe 'dir btson du tshud par ci la 'jigs//dgung gi nyi mar 'char nub yod min nam//mchakā kā/ ༵/na me (mo/chorsā ) si khron zhing chen zhus dbyin gyi mi yin/ rig gnas las ka byed mkhan zhig yin/ 1947lor 'dzin bzung thebs shing khrun chin gyi 6 krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang ste kra tsi tung btson khang du bcug 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/chen ༈ // / trī byes pa ni khrun cig kran go'i skabs kyi cin rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus smra ba 0lu'u zhun zhes pa ni krung go'i deng rabs kyi rlabs che ba'i rtsom rig pa dang bsam blo ba/ gsar brje pa de la bstan pa yin no//285

wun rtse gyes kha'i gtam/mtshan mo'i smag ni 'jigs rung can gyi gdong zhig dang 'dra/skya la ser ba'i glog 'od kyi 'dzum ris ni gshin rje'i mtshon gdengs pa bzhin/glo bur du sbom zhing che ba'i 'dre lag cig tshur brkyangs nas/kho rang rmi lam gyi mal nas yar btegs/khos mig gnyis bgrad de phur tshugs su yud tsam bltas pa na/nga'o che zhing g.yo khram che ba'i bzhin ras shig gis kho rang bi bsam lam bkagade'i tshe khos gzhi nas ha rgo song /'o los yin/da ni rang thog la res 'khor ba red/spun zla lags/ dpa' ma zhum/gom stabs chen pos sgo them 'di rgol cigakho'i gdong la ji mi snyam pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig bzhad bzhin 'di skad sgrogakye ma/ 'di ni ji 'dra'i glen rtags shig red ang /gsar brje'i don la gzhol ba'i mi zhig yin phyin/'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ni ngang ba pad mtshor gtad pa dang 'dra/da thengs kyi khrag 'khon 'di sems la zungs dang /spun zla tshos cis kyang khrag 'khon 'di slog dgos/kye spun zla/ nga tsho 'gro yis/286

khyi rgan tsho'i tshe mtha' yang sang nyin rdzogs nges yin/khrab bis nam yang sngon gshegs pa tsho'i/6 nyes skyon mi'adi tsam 'khod 'dug ste/lo ni dmag shed can dang yul gyi gshed ma/bshu gzhog mkhan gyi mnga' 'og nas thar ba dang gcigakho ni spyi tshogs rnying ba'i g.yo khram dang bkres ltogs las thar ba dang gnyis/kho ni 'jig rten 'di'i mnar gcod dang brnyas bcos las thar ba dang gsum/kho yis jag rkun/ nyug rum pa/'khor g.yog rgyug khyi bcas kyis/mes rgyal gyi ske la bskon pa'i lcags sgrog bcad pa dang bzhi/kho ni bden don gyi lam la zhugs shing mnar gcod myong mkhan dang mgo skor thebs mkhan tshor gyen ldog gi dar cha sgreng ba dang lnga'o//kye spun zla lags/ khyod bzhud dang /spobs pa chen pos bzhud dang /kye spun zla lags/nga rang tsho'i 'thab 'dzing gi srung bya ma brjed cigadagos la thug tshe/khyod kyis dgra bo'i mda' gri bsus nas bzhud cigabaden don ni cis kyang tshur la 'thob nges dang /sa ngan 'di ni cis kyang me la mchod par 'gyur/gshed ma des kho yi phrag par lan 'ga' brgyab/kho ni glo bur du khong dgod cig shor te/287

kha phyir 'khor nas lam la chas song /kye spun zla lags/khyod kyis gyes mtshams zhu mi dgos/sems re res yod tshad rtogs 'dugakye ma/ nam gsal ran 'dugawa jag khyi rkun 'di tsho'i byin sha 'dar song /kho tshos nga tsho'i thog tu zhe 'khon slog pa dang /kho tshos khrims med lugs med byas pa'i dngos dpang med par bzo nges red/kho tshor ma dngul 'thob rjes gzhan la 'gro nges red/'on kyang khyod kyis nyon cigakhyi rgan de tshor gu yangs gtong sa med/khrag gi 'khon 'dzin de cis kyang khrag gis slog nges yin/1949lo'i zla 11par dmar gsod chen po'i mtshan mor bris/mchakā dī/ trī/ (4/rtse) si khron zhing chen ho khyon gyi mi yin/ de snga zhin si cun gyi chab srid las byed cig byas myong / 1941lo'i zla dang po'i wan nan don 'gyur skabs su 'dzin bzung thebs/ snga phyir hrang ro dang zhi gling / khrun chin gyi pe kung kon btson khang bcas su bkag 1949lor khrun min bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/ khong gi snyan tshig 'di ni btson shor byung ba'i blo mthun zhig gis khyer nas thon skad/288

li'u ko krikṣarang srog gtong kha'i snyan tshig②blo mthun tsho/ gson dang /dbyar gyi 'brug sgra bzhin grags pa'i sgra chen de ni/mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi skyogs chen gyi sgra red/mi dmangs bcings pa las bkrol song /sngi ༵༵ngas rnams rnam par rgyal song /tang gi mtshan snyan la ngan gyis ma brdzad/nga tsho shi yang 'gyod dang nongs pa ci yang med/ mchan 'grel/③li'u ko kri (smo1༅61921— 1949) si khron zhing chen lu'u zhun gyi mi yin/gung khrin tang yon/ de sngar krung gung khrun chin grong khyer hra ci khul u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan 'khur myong / 1948lo'i zla bzhi par 'dzin bzung thebs shing / 6 krung me'i lag rtsal khyad can mnyam 'brel khang ste pe kung kon btson khang du bkag 1949lor khrun chin bcings 'grol 'thob khar bkrongs/nyu1948lor krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung ni khrun chin grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su slebs shing 'thab 'dzing gi skyogs sgra ni btson khang nang nas gsal bor thos pa na/ rtsom pa po dga' bas ma bzod par lkog tu sbas pa'i zha smyug dum bu zhig yod pa de phyir bton nas bcings 'grol la dga' 'bod byed pa'i snyan tshig rtsom grabs kyi mod la dgra bo ni khong gi sgo khar 'greng pa mthong / de'i tshe khong gis ji mi snyam par lag gi zha sgyug sar g.yugs te dgra bo'i gdong bsus nas 'gro zhor du skad gsang mthon pos gong gi snyan tshig tshan pa de gyer 'don byas skad/289
'a ngabasgrab

mtsho sngon pa/nga ni mtsho sngon nga/ zhig yin//mtsho sngon 'di la dga' zhing zhen//phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'ongs kyang //khyim tshang gcig tu 'dus dang mtshungs//mtsho sngon nub byang phyogs na yod//'dzam gling yang rtse nyid du grags//sa khyon yangs shing dngos brgya 'dzoms//mtshan snyan srid pa gsum la khyab//mtho sgang gnas mchog dam pa 'dir//sa ni bkra shis mi yang mdzangs//mi rigs tha dad mang na yang //spun zla bzhin du mdza' zhing gshin//khyim gzhi gsar ba 'dzugs skrun gyi//las brgya dbyar mtsho rgyas dang mtshungs//bcos sgyur rlung gi shugs 'chang ba'i//gru gzings skyod pa'i dge mtshan bkra//293

phugs ring lo rgyus/mtsho sngon lo rgyus dus yu na ring //phugs la ded na srid par thug/sgrung dang gtam rgyud mang ngo la sa//ngo mtshar zad du med pa bskyed//khu nu ri por lha chen gyis/khyagazhal yas pho brang btab nas ni//rgyal mos dga' ston 'gyed pa dang /khu〉lha tshogs 'dus pa'i gnas su grags//'di ru yo hrun zhabs rjes bkod/khyamo'u wang phebs pa'i gtam yang gragasakhutanub rong rgyal phran bcu gnyis tshogs/(kyem lus chin gyi 'bangs su tshud/khyanub han ho chus min gyis ni/khu)'di ru zhis phin thing yang btsugs//dmag dpon kra'o khrun ko yis kyang /khro)khab 'dir sgar gzhis btab par bshad//dar gos tshong lam ring mo yis/khunye294

phyogs bzhir mdza' mthun sa bon btab//thang bod gna' lam btod par grags/khya nyi zla ri bor tshong lam rgyugakhyathang sung yon ming ching bcas la//mtha' srung so tshis sgrub par bshad//mā jag dmag shed can gyis ni/khya'abangs la sdug bsngal tshad med bskyed//phyugs las nyin bzhin nyam chung gyur//'khrug pas sa zhing rgod la shor//skyes bu dam pa mang po yis//rgyal 'bangs skyid sdug zhe la 'khrengs//gcig dgu bzhi bcu zhe dgu lor//'bangs rnams bcings pa nyid las grol//rlabs chen gung khran tang gis ni//lam sna khrid de mdun skyod byas//srid dbang gsar ba brtan por tshugs//rma 'bri'i yul du nyi ma shar//srid thus bzang zhing dmangs kun mthun//'phrin las yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel//295

snod bcud mdzes chos/brjid chags khu nu ri bo ni//mi rigs bla srog nyid du gyur//rma chu dang ni 'bri chu zung //shes rig 'byung ba'i gnas su 'khums//mtha' yas rtswa thang chen po de//sngo ljang g.yu yi mdangs su bkra//bye ma'i mya ngam thang chen du//rnga dril 'khrol ba'i sgra dbyangs 'khor//zab yangs khri shor rgyal mo nyid/khu〉mtho sgang rab gsal me long 'dra//mtsher ba ri la bya tshogs lding /khu)ma hā de bar g.yu 'brug 'khyugakhyaskya rengs sngo rengs lcam sring bzhin/ṭhagacig gis gcig la sngas te chags//skar tshom zlar gyur mtsho'u'i tshogs//snang 'phrul sgyu ma'i khams su 'khrul//mtshungs med sku 'bum byams pa gling ⑪//296

grags pa gnam 'og khyon na ldir//ris med dad ldan skye bo tshogs//pad ma'i tshal la bung ba bzhin//gnas mchog gro tshang go'u tam sdelingan//rtsig ris ngo mtshar brjod las 'das//gna' bo'i bzo bkod khyad chos rmad//brkos blugs yi ge rin thang che//li'u wan rgya yi bang so las/khukhyathon pa'i tshon ldan rdza bum mchog/nyi zla ri bo'i rdo rings kyis//rgya bod mdza' mthun lo rgyus brjod//chi len nags tshal rngam zhing stug/rma rgyal gangs kyi lhun po brjid/khuyireb gong lha ris sgyu rtsal rmad/khu)stong ri lha mtsho'i yul ljongs mdzes/khuyiya rdzi'i rnga mong chu mig dang /khu〉yichos rje'i gna' bo'i mkhar rdzong dang /khyaya tan sa bab ngo mtshar ldan/khuyitshwa khu'i gzhung lam mtha' mi dpog/byang ri'i dben gnas bsam gtan khang /khu1297

sgom phug brag khung bco brgyad yod//byang ri nags klong tshang tshing 'khrigs/9〉dme shul stag pa'i 'dab ma dmar/khu〉mtsho sngon yul ljongs mdzes shing sdug/dus bzhir khyad chos du ma yod//ri dang klung gi ngo mtshar gyis//phyogs bzhi'i mgron po ngang gis 'gugs//thun min rig gnas khyad chos mang //mdzes ljongs shog bris ri mo 'dra//bsngags brjod snyan tshig me tog gi//mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di na bstar//mtsho sngon sa khyon yangs shing che//ri klung yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gzhi//brjid cing mtho ba'i sa sgang du//rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod gtams//gter sna thon khungs/mtshungs med tshwa 'dam gzhing chen nyid/khrisadagos 'dod kun 'byung gnas su grub//mtha' klas mya ngam thang chen yang //3 98

gter sna 'dzoms pa'i gzhi ru gyur//rlabs dkar 'phyo ba'i tshwa mtsho las//ca nā rme lis pon bcas 'byung /khyamang nge'i rdo rgyus spus gtsang de/khyaphyi la shin tu byin par mthong /deng gi lung ba khra mo ru/khyardo snum grong khyer gsar ba chags//bye ma'i thang du gter sgrom bslangs//'dren sbug g.yu 'brug 'khyug dang mtshungs//gsha' lcags ri las zha nye dang /khyati tsha gser dngul 'dres mar 'byung //gter sna brgya phrag du ma'i tshogs//lhad med bsags tshad gzhal du med//rma 'bri'i chu klung chen po las//glog gi dge tshogs chen po bsags//ri bo'i phrag par g.yu mtsho bskyil//tsha rnga 'gag tu dpa' rtul 'jomasakhyalhag par sngo rgya 'gag 'phrang du/khu〉dpa' bos me long gsar ba spras//de bas yul 'dir mun pa bral//299

'dod dpal dar ba'i mthun rkyen 'grig/tsong chu'i ngogs su so nam rgyas/rdzimatsho shar 'bru yi mdzod du gyur//mi ni brtson 'grus lo ni legs//'bru rigs sna lnga'i 'phel sgo yag/bye thang dbus kyi zhing sde ru/khyaljon shing rgyas pa'i dpal yon shar//mu'u rer rgya ma nyis stong gi/'bru yi thon tshad zin pa mtshar/khri shor rgyal mo'i khor yug tu/khukhyanor lug thang ma brdal bzhin bkram//spus legs phra 'jam ldan pa'i bal//nor 'dzin gzhi 'dir ming grags che//lho yi gangs ri lhun po'i mgul//'brog las dar ba'i gnas su lham//thang na rta mchog rlung ltar rgyug/gnam na bya rgod lding zhing 'khor//dpa' bos dpa' rtags ngom 'dod na//dus rabs gsar ba'i rjes su snyogs//chi len yul gyi g.yang ṭi dang //300

sku 'bum dngul gyi yol go bzang //rma chu khugs pa'i cang shes dang //khu nu'i chu shel rdo spus legs/khukhyamago log tshag sha skam po dang //stong skor skyur khu ro mchog ldan//a khro'i glo gri bzo rtsal legs/dokroya rdzi'i la tsi dmar mdangs rgyas/khukhri ku'i lcang sil ro mngar zhing //zi ling lcum rtsa rin thang che//dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu gla rtsi dang //shwa ra'i rin thang de bas che//gro ma gro lo sa 'dzin dang //gangs lha tig ta sman gyi mchog/skra tshal zas kyi mchog tu bshad//phang ma'i 'bras bu kun gyis bsngags//tsong chu'i nya mo ro gsar ldan//bod kyi sa gdan 'thag rtsal zhib//gtsags drub dang ni thang ga yi//mdzes ris yon tan yid las 'gongs//srid 'dir dkon pa'i tshar nag dang //301

nor khul kun gyi mchog tu brtsi//lo bsnyal nas chang kham pa yis//bdud rtsi ming gi lhag mar byas//nam mkha'i skar tshogs bzhin bkra ba'i//rin chen nor bu brjod las 'das//rgyang nas phebs pa'i mgron po la//rang yul brjed pa'i sgyu 'phrul ston//mtho sgang ri klung mdzes sdug ldan//yul srol khyad chos ngo mtshar rdzogs//rdza ri smug por gcan gzan dang //ri dwags dkon po bag yangs rgyu//dgo dang dge'u sa na rgyug/lha bya dkar mo dgung na 'khor//gong mo rdza ri'i rtse na grag/spre'u nags tshal klong na mchong //chu sram gra kha nag 'jam ldan//wa mo'i spu mdangs dmar ser bsdebs//dred mo kher rkyang gnas par rangs//rkyang ni khyu tshogs 'dus par dga'//gla byi chung yang g.yer bag ldan//302

og dkar pags pa mchog tu brtsi//ngang 'jam shwa skya'i 'jo sgos ni//kun yid 'gug pa'i lcags gyur nges//ri bong dang ni spre'u'i tshogs//mchong lding mig sgas zin par dka'//gzugs bongs che ba'i 'brong g.yag ni//stobs shugs 'gran zla med par mthong /g.yi yi 'gros mgyogs mda' mo 'dra//gla dang gnyan gyi mchong stabs kyang //rlung gi shugs 'chang min nam snyam//stag gzigs nags klong rgyan du gyur//mgrin nag khrung khrung dkar mo yis//gre 'gyur snyan pa'i glu dbyangs gyer//ri dwags gtsod kyis rwa kha zung //gnam la ker ba'i 'gying bag ston//bya wang sngon mos 'dab gshog zung //bser bu la brten sprugs bzhin rkyong //rgyud 'jam lha bya tshe ring gis//chu la dgyes dgur rol nyams ston//mdor na ri skyes srog chags kyi//303

thun min khyad chos brjod las 'das//grong khyer mtha' ru tsong chu 'bab//rlabs phreng sngon mo'i gzegs ma spro//zhing 'di'i lte gnas zi ling gi//rnam pa nyin bzhin nyin bzhin gsar//khrom srang tshong gi 'du 'dzi 'khrigs//thog khang dgung la zug pa 'dra//rlangs 'khor chu yi rgyun la 'khu//dus bzhir me tog bzhad pa yod//shes rig dpal yon gsar ba yis//grong khyer rnam pa rab tu rgyas//bzo tshong las rigs dbyar mtsho bzhin//'phel bas dpal 'byor dar zhing rgyas//phyogs bzhi'i mgron po 'dzum gyis bsu//mtshams brgyad khe tshong nang la 'dren//mi sems mthun zhing 'phrin las rgyas//yar rgyas gsar 'don nyid la rag/deng gi gor mo'i na gzhong du/khyakhu nu'i grong khyer dang po chags//nub mthar gangs seng 'gyings pa bzhin//304

mya ngam thang bi bzhin ras brjes//bzo grwa dang ni gter kha yi//dud khung gnam gyi ka bzhin bslangs//rdo snum rang byung sol rlangs dang //tshwa khu'i grong sga brjid nyams 'bar//tshwa 'dam gzhong chen gsar 'don gyi/phrilas 'gan mtsho nub phrag la babs//dpal 'byor 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i tshe//mtha' khul bde zhing brtan par 'gyur//bgrod dka'i mtsho bod gzhung lam nyid//phya ler bde ba'i thang gi spun//'grim 'grul gzhung rtsa lcags lam ni//rgyang grags stong gi bar du brkyangs//mkha' yi 'grul lam dgung la btod//dngul mdog lcags bya thogs med rgyu//gzhung lam dra rgya bsnol ba yis//grong dang grong khyer gcig tu sbrel//sa gzhir rab mdzes gos bklubs bzhin//'gro rnams dga' ba'i dpal gyis khengs//grong brdal khe las rgyas pa yis//305

'dab zung rtsal stobs mnyam du rdzogs//dmangs srol khyad chos/mtsho sngon mi rigs mang po yod//spun zla bzhin du thugs gshin zab//yul srol khyad chos tha dad cing //rig gnas lhad med dwangs gtsang ldan//'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung //rin thang bral ba'i nor bur bsngags//rma 'bri'i sgyu rtsal dus chen las//gangs ljongs yul gyi khyad chos mtshon//hor gyi a 'gro klu gtor du/khya3'ja' ris bkra ba'i sgor bro mdzes//sog po'i na tam dus chen la/khro〉rtswa thang dga' ba'i yo lang rdzogs//dmangs khrod glu shags khrom tshogs kyi//rol dbyangs nam mkha'i mthongs na rgyu//rigs kun spun zla mthun 'grogs kyis//skyid sdug mnyam du myong la ltos//las la dad cing brtson 'grus rdi//306

blo bag phebs shing bde skyid ldan//'tsho ba gsar ba je legs su//btang zhing goms srol gsar ba dar//gsar gtod mdun skyod/'bri chu lang long shar la rgyug/rma klung rba rlabs phreng ba g.yo//nam mkha' mtho zhing shar rlung ldang //gsar 'don rgya mtsho'i klong kha brdol//'a cag mtsho sngon pa la bsngags//spobs pa dgung sngon dbyings las mtho//lus kung snying stobs rab bskyed nas/(sprerang yul mtsho sngon gsar 'don bya//dpa' bos lag rjes 'jog pa la//'di 'dra'i rten 'brel 'grig par dka'//dpa' mdzangs bu dang bu mo'i tshogs//rgyang skyod gsar ba'i lam du chas//khyung chen 'dra ba'i snying stobs 'a chang //mtho sgang srog bi bla ru bsten//mi yul ngo mtshar mdzad rjes dang //307

deng gi rlabs chen bya gzhag skrun//bcos sgyur gom chen spo ba la//thog mar 'du shes gsar brje bya//rig gnas slob gso'i rmang gzhi 'ding //tshan rig lag rtsal gdong len bya//thon khungs gsar du 'don par brtson//las brgya mnyam du 'phel zhing rgyas//bya gzhag chen po legs sgrub pa'i//mi sems mkhar gyi lcags ri bzhin//dpal 'byor 'bras bu g.yur du za//spyi tshogs nyin bzhin dar zhing rgyas//dngos po dang ni bsam pa yi//dpal yon 'dab brgya cig car bzhad//'a cag mtsho sngon pa rnams ni//mtsho sngon zhing la snying nas dga'//phugs kyi mdzes ris legs 'god par//lang tsho 'bul ba'i g.yar dam bca'//zhing dang rgyal khab dar spel la//brtson 'grus snying stobs rab tu bskyed//yid 'ong krung hwa legs brgyan nas//308

'dzam gling shar gyi rgyan gyur cig/ //mchanabye ༵༵/dir bshad pa'i lha chen dang rgyal mo gnyis ni bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud nang gi lha chen tshangs pa dkar po dang a ne gong sman rgyal mo gnyis la go chog cing /rgya'i gtam rgyud nang du de gnyis kyi pho brang ni khu nu ri bo'i steng du bkod par grags pas na de skad du brjod pa'o//payinaX/ yo hrun zhes pa ni rgya'i ches gna' rabs kyi rgyal po yo dang hrun gnyis la bshad lasmo'u wang zhes pa ni rgya'i kro'u nub ma'i rgyal rabs lnga ba smo'u wang cis man zer ba de la bstan pa yin te/ rgya'i lo rgyus deb ther nang du smo'u wang dngos su mtsho sngon du phebs myong skad/0nub rong rgyal phran bcu gnyis zhes pa ni de snga mtsho sngon dang kun su'u sa khul du gdod mar gnas pa'i 'jang rigs te phal cher bod mi rigs kyi khongs su 'dres pa'i sa gnas stobs shugs bcu gnyis tsam la bstan pa yin/yin/ 0rin zhes pa ni gong ma rin hri hong gis tshugs pa'i rin rgyal rabs la bstan pa ()ho chus pin zhes pa ni rgya'i han nub ma'i dmag dpon chen mo zhig ste/ rgya'i lo rgyus nang du des mtsho sngon phyogs su dmag drangs te yul 'di dbang du bsdus par ma zad da dung zhis yin thing (nub phyogs bde bkod khang zhes pa'i don 〉zhes 'bod pa'i srid skyong las khungs shig kyang btsugs skad/()kra'o khrun ko zhes pa ni han rgyal rabs kyi dmag dpon chen mo zhig ste/ des nub kyi 'jang zhi ba'i thabs kyis btul ba'i thog sgar gzhis btab ste so nam byas pas mtha' mtshams bsrungs par ma zad dmag mi'i so tshis kyang zhar du bsgrubs skad/()dar gos tshong lam zhes pa ni rgya'i han nub ma'i skabs su rgyal sa khrang an (da lta'i zhis an grong khyer 〉nas mgo tshugs/ bar du kun su'u bye thang brgyud/ pha mir mtho 309

sgang brgal te sa dbus rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs dang rgya gar/ dbyi lang / dbyi rab la sogs pa 'i rgyal khab bar du dar gos kyi tshong lam zhig btod de rang rgyal gyi dar gos dang bzo zhing lag rtsal dang rig gnas bcas nub phyogs su bskyal cing / nub phyogs kyi zhing thon dngos rdzas dang rig gnas sgyu rtsal rang rgyal du drangs pa de la zer/(sprethang bod gna' lam zhes pa ni gna' rabs kyi rgya'i thang rgyal rabs dang bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rgya bod bar du btod pa'i 'grim 'grul gyi lam la zer te/ rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs dus lam 'dir zhugs nas phebs skad/༷nyi zla ri bo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon po'i shar phyogs kyi ri bo zhig bi ming ste rong 'brog gnyis kyi sa mtshams su grags/ de snga rgya bza' kong jo bod du skyod dus ri bo 'di brgyud nas phyin par bshad/0mā jag dmag shed can zhes pa ni bcings 'grol sngon du mtsho sngon la dbang sgyur byed mkhan dmag shed can mā pu'u hphang la bstan pa yin/par bya⑤/ khri shor rgyal mo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon po'i ming / de'i gtam rgyud gzhan nas shes ming /3mtsher ba ri zhes pa ni da lta mi rigs gzhan gyis bya gling zhes 'bod pa de yi (yim hā de ba zhes pa ni mtsho snying gi ming /(yiskya rengs sngo rengs zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mgo log khul khongs su yod pa'i mtsho skya rengs dang mtsho sngo rengs gnyis la bstan pa yin/(1sku 'bum byams pa gling zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa grags can sku 'bum dgon pa'i ming /⑦gro tshang go'u tam sde zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen lo tu'u rdzong khongs na yod pa'i gro tshang rdo rje 'chang dgon pa'i ming /(yili'u wan bang so zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen lo tu'u rdzong khongs kyi li'u wan grong sde nas thon pa'i rig gnas gna' shul zhig yin/ de nas gna' bo'i dur dang gna' rdzas mang po thon skad/310

4yirma rgyal zhis pa ni da lta ma tsho sngon zhing chen mgo log khul khongs na yod pa'i bangs ri rma rgyal sbom ra'i ming /4)reb song sgyu rtsal zhes pa ni reb gong sa cha'i lha ris sgyu rtsal la go/yistong ri lha mtsho zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun hwa rdzong min tā shang khongs na yod pa'i gnam mtsho zhig gi ming /〈〈ya rdzi zhes pa ni sngon chad bod kyis ya rdzi mkhar dmar zhis 'bod pa'i sa cha ste da lta zhun hwa rdzong zer/yirnga rmong chu mig ces pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun hwa rdzong khongs na yod pa'i chu mig cig gi ming ste/ chu mig thon sa'i rdo'i dbyibs ni rnga mong dang 'dra bas na de skad du brjod par bshad/yichos rje'i gna' bo'i mkhar rdzong zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen gung ho rdzong chos rje shang khongs na yod pa'i gna' bo'i mkhar shul zhig la zer ba yin te dmangs khrod du 6chos rje rgya mkhar zhes 'bod/ de ni 'das lo 1400lhag gi sngon du gru gu zhes 'bod pa'i tsho ba'i tshogs pa chen po zhig yod pa de'i rje dpon gyis brtsigs pa'i mkhar rdzong chen po zhig yin skad/spyiya tan sa bab ces pa ni g.yang gzar ldan pa'i de'u 'bur zhes pa'i don yin/gtso cher skam po sa khul gyi rlung skyon thebs pa'i ngos gzar sa bab cig la bya'o//yibyang ri'i dben gnas zhes pa ni zi ling grong khyer byang phyogs ri bo'i mgul gyi to co chos lugs kyi dben dgon zhig yod pa de la zer/yibyang ri nags klong zhes pa ni da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen hu'u kru'u rdzong khongs byang phyogs kyi nags tshal chen po'i ming /lhunadame shul zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen rtse khog rdzong khongs kyi sa cha zhig gi ming ste/ de ru nags tshal gyi mdzes ljongs shin tu yag skad/tshoyo tshwa 'dam gzhong zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul khongs kyi tshwa mang po yod pa'i sa cha zhig gi ming /〈mica nā rme lis pon bcas ni rdzas 'gyur gyi gzhi rgyu'i ming ste/ rgya skad dus mchi311

྅rngochisngosariyotshebacas so//4yimang nge zhes pa ni da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul gyi sa cha'i ming zhig ste/ de ru rdo rgyus yag po thon skad/tshon lung ba khra mo zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul khongs kyi rdo snum dang sol rlangs yod pa'i lung ba zhig gi ming /tsho)gsha' lcags ri zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul khongs kyi ri bo // / ming ste/ de ru ti tsha dang zha nye mang po 'byung bas/ rgya skad du zhis the hran zhes 〈yilung yangs 'gag ces pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho khul khongs kyi rma chu'i 'phrang 'gag chen po zhig ste tshal rnga 'gag kyang zer/ de ru rma chu'i chu glog sa tshigs chen po zhig tshugs yod/yisngo rgya 'gag ces pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen gcan tsha rdzong khongs kyi rma chu'i pa// 'phrang zhig gi ming ste/ de ru da lta chu glog sa tshigs chen po zhig 'dzugs skrun byas ming /7tsong chu zhes pa ni da lta'i zi ling grong khyer brgyud nas 'bab pa'i chu bo de'i (sprezhing sde zhes pa ni mtsho nub khul khongs kyi sa cha zhig gi ming ste/ bod kyis de la paṇa chen zhing sde zhes 'bod srol yang yod/snyonangag rgyun la chi len sa khul nas thon pa'i rdo g.yang ṭi'i spus shin tu legs pa dang sku 'bum nas thon pa'i dngul gyi snod chas bzo spus legs pa/ rma chu khugs pa ste deng rma lho khul gyi rma lho rdzong nas thon pa'i rta rgyud bzang ba/ khu nu ri bo nas thon pa'i rdo chu shel gyi spus ka legs par bshad to//(yi.a khro zhes pa ni da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen yul shul khul khongs kyi sa cha zhig gi ming ste/ sa cha de yi mis bzos pa'i glo gri shin tu legs skad/༷ya rdzi zhes pa sngar 'grel dang mtshungs/(yigor mo zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul gyi grong khyer zhig gi ming ste/312

na sor mo yang zer/(yitshwa 'dam zhes pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho nub khul gyi sa cha zhig bi ming ste/ de ru tshwa khu mang po thon pas tshwa 'dam zhes bya'o//(spre.a 'gro zhes pa ni hor rigs kyis 'khrab pa'i sgor bro'i ming / a 'gro 'gro zhes glu gyer bzhin 'khrab pas na de skad do//chuklu gtor zhes pa ni dang thog klu la bsngo ba'i gtor ma phul te nad dang gnod 'tshe zlog pa'i chos lugs kyi gar 'cham zhig yin kyang / phyis su hor rigs dmangs srol gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i dus chen zhig tu gyur skad/(yin tam zhes pa ni dbyar rtsed ces pa'i don yin/ de ni sog rigs mang tshogs kyis dbyar mjug ston mgor rtswa thang du rta rgyug dang mda' 'phen/ 'ju res byed pa'i dus chen zhig la zer ro//(1lus kung zhes pa ni de snga rgya'i ngag rgyun du grags pa'i gtam rgyud 〈〈yus kung gis ri bo spos pa 〉zhes pa'i nang du bshad pa'i ri bo spo mkhan rgan po de la zer/ 313
yig gsum mdo gsar ma//〈〈yig gsum mdo gsar ma 〉〉rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang gis sgrig rtsom byas/

mi ni skyes nyid nas// 〉〉rnye7dwangs gsal gaṅgeng ṭi 'dra// 10212gshis dang ngang tshul gnyis// cho tshibacos su rung bar 'gyur// tsho112tshul bzhin ma gdams na// chosamaspyod lam 'chol bar 'gyur// 267yogadams par bya ba la// 7lha kun spyod gnad du zungs// tsho rki gna' yi mdzangs yum ni// dzee ṣṭhaṣṭhabu skyong thabs mkhas ldan// snomachameng gis thags ras bcad/khunye rtsalo'iya'o yis rgyab yig gtsags/khu'i 6ste/zemabaskyangs kyang ma gdams na// skaramapha ma'i skyon du bgrang // 077gdams kyang ma bslabs na// mas༈bu yi nongs par 'gyur// 16lha g.yang ṭi ma brkos na// char yol gor 'gyur mi srid// poloḥmi yis ma bslabs na// 〉postsa'ajig rten lugs mi shes// rkosaṭwābu slob byed pa'i dus// 〉〉tswa317

na tshod gzhon pa'i sgang // 〉〉 bsargan la brtsi bkur bya// stoṣṭharsāgus lugs goms par rigs pho 'i sgyumal khri bsro ba ni// cho ༅sgobu mo hong shang ste/khu) 7)rirsārsāpha mar byams pa'i tshul// 456don dgongs zab la ring 6/lkoṣṭhagacen la shing tog che// cho/14 'bul shes khung rong nyid/6) 7)ri1'i spun zla'i mdza' brtse ni// cha༅khyoyid la gcag par bya// /zu 6ri bsnyen zhing bkur ba'i srol// chaXsgorgyun 'dzin byed par rigs// 70rsārgan gzhon ris med du// ṣṭha yisha rus gcig tu sgoms// cha lkopha mas bu bskyangs pa'i// lkolko16dka' sdug brjod las 'das// tshoṣṭha dpyid kyi nyi ma'i drin// rsā lhaskye dgus gzhal bar dka'// /sgobapha mas gdams pa'i ngag/ moji41rgyuyobu yis btud de gson// 16 lkobyas nyes byung ba na// lta rtse sprunga'aphral du bshag par bya// khubamacha318

gyur to②// 'dir ya'o hphe la zer ba yin te/ sung lho ma'i skabs kyi dmag dpon grags can zhig yin/ skabs der byang phyogs kyi jin rgyal khab kyis dbus la dpung 'jug byas pas/jin bzlog ched a mas ya'o hphe'i rgyab la rgya yig 6 cin krung po go mizhes pa bod skad du bsgyur na 6 blo dkar rgyal skyob zer ba gtsags te rgyal khab kyi ched du lag rjes 'jog dgos par gdams shing g.yul ngor brdzangs pas rgyal kha chen po blangs zhes pa'o//dusngon han rgyal rabs kyi skabs/ hong shang zer ba'i bu mo zhig lo dgu'i tshe/ pha mar bkur ster brtson zhing gzhol/ dbyar tsha gdug che ba'i tshe pha ma'i mal khri'i rtsar song nas rnga g.yab kyis 'bu sbrang sogs bskrad nas gnyid 'gug pa dang / dgun grang ngar che ba'i tshe pha ma'i mal khri lus drod kyis bsros nas bde bar nyal du bcug pas/ pha mar bkur ste byed pa'i mig dper gyur to//6)han rgyal rabs kyi skabs/ khung ci'i gdung rabs so gnyis pa khung rong zhes 'bod pa de lo bzhi lon pa tsam la gcen rnams dang lhan du shing tog za ba'i tshe/ gcen la che ba phul/ rang gis chung ngu zos pas/ gcen gyis khyod kyis che ba mi za ba ci yin zhes dris pas/ khung rong bis gcen lo che bas che ba za dgos/ nga ni lo chung bas chung ngu za 'os zhes zer/ phyis su sa gnas shig gi dpon du bskos nas 'bangs mi tshul bzhin bskyangs zhes grags so//du'adir kun rig ces pa'i kun ni kun spyod la go dgos shing / rig ni rig gnas la go dgos so//du'adir bshad pa'i bzhi ldan ni phugs bsam ldan pa dang / kun spyod ldan pa/rig gnas ldan pa/ sgrig khrims ldan pa bcas la zer ro//()'gad sman nag po zhes pa ni thang rgyal rabs skabs kyi ril bu sgrub mkhan gyis sol ba dang / ze tshwa/ mu zi ser po bcas spyad nas ril bu sgrub skabs 'gad sla ba'i sman rang shugs su rnyed par grags shing / sung byang ma'i skabs nas bzung g.yul 'thab tu skyud par bshad de/ dus rabs bcu gsum nas bcu bzhi bar da gzod phyi gling du dar 336

()bya skad 'grogs nas sbyangs/ zhes pa ni jin nub ma'i rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug tu/ dmag dpon tsu'u thes zer ba gzhon pa'i skabs su/ grogs mched li'u khung dang mnyam du 'dug pa'i tshe/ bya skad snyan zhing gsal ba glo bur du thos pas/ har gyis langs te phyi la bltas pas tshes zla gnam gyi mthar 'phyang ba mthong bas nyams 'ur nas grogs po la rdog pas gnyid bslangs te/ bya skad grags zin pas myur du longs la drag rtsal sbyang ngo zer nas gnyis gas drag rtsal sbyang / de nas bzung rgyun du de ltar byas pas bya skad 'grogs nas sbyang zhes pa ni brtson 'grus bskyed de sbyong brdar byas nas rgyal khab la nus shugs 'bul bar gra sgrig byed pa'i don la go dgos so//༷snyan ngag pa chen po lis pe sku na chung dus rtsed mo la g.yengs te slob gnyer la sgyid lug byas/ nyin zhig rgan mo zhig dang 'phrad de/ des lcags dbyug rdo thog la brdar bzhin pa mthong bas ngo mtshar te/ ma phyi lags/ khyed kyis 'di brdar nas ci bya zhes dris pas/ brdar nas khab bya'o zer/ lcags dbyug 'di ltar sbom pa la/ khab tu ji ltar 'gyur/ bu/ brtson 'grus yun ring bskyed pas na/ lcags dbyug khab tu 'gyur bar nges zer/ rgan mo'i ngag spyod las lis pe la yid 'gul dang slob gso zab mo thebs/ de nas bzung khong gis brtson pa bskyed de slob gnyer 'bad 'bungs byas pas/ phyis su ming grags shin tu che ba'i snyan ngag pa chen por gyur to//3jing rgyal rabs skabs khyad ying zer ba zhig yod pa khyim dbul po yin pas/nub mo dpe cha lta byed kyi sgron me med/ de nas srin bu me khyer bzung nas seng ras kyi khug mar bcug ste/ de'i 'od la brten nas dpe char bltas/ yang sung khang zer ba zhig khyim dbul bas nub mo dpe char lta ba'i sgron me med pas/ lhas la song nas gangs kyi 'od la //na nas dpe cha bltas/ de ltar nyin bzhin sbyangs pas mthar mkhas pa chen por gyur ཿli'u hro chi ( 1898 1969)rang rgyal gyi rlabs che ba'i mar khe si ring lugs pa dang / gzhung lugs smra ba/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi mgo 'dren phul byung can yin/khong gis 1936lor 〈〈gung khran tang yon gyi blo sbyong rnam bshad 〉〉ces pa de brtsams shing mngon par spel/ dpe deb de'i nang du khong gis gung khran tang yon gyi blo sbyong skor 337

la blang bya gsal bo bton cing / khong rang nyid kyis mig dpe gzhan ston byas te spyi sems kho na gnyer ba'i mdzad bzang las rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi yi rang dang gus bkur thob/(yitsung li krig en le ( 1898 1976)ni mar khe si ring lugs pa phul byung dang / tang dang rgyal khab kyi gsar gtod pa dang mgo 'dren mchog tu gyur pa yin/ krung go gsar ba dbu brnyes pa nas bzung sku ma gshegs bar du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tsung li'i 'gan bzhes te rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi don du zhum med sri zhur gzhol bas mi dmangs kyi dga' zhen dang gus bkur thob/(mikru'u te ( 1886 1976)ni rlabs che ba'i mar khe si ring lugs pa dang gsar brje pa/ dmag don mkhas can yin/ yun ring bor rang re'i dmag dpung gi spyi khyab dmag spyi'i 'gan khur bas kru'u te zi lin yang zer/ de snga cin gang hran gsar brje'i gnas gzhi gsar gtod byed skabs dmag mi dang mnyam du ri 'dabs su bro chas khur bas/ dmag mi tshos sha tsha ba'i ngang nas khong sga 'khur rgyug sbas/ de'i phyir khong gis 'tshol bde ba'i ched du 'khur rgyug de'i steng du kru'u te zhes rang gi ming yig brkos so/ /btam rgyud de phyis su khong la bstod pa'i rgyu ru gyur to//(spredamag mi los hphin ( 1940 1962)ni rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi mig dper byed pa'i dmag mi dpe bzang can de'o/ /kho rang1960lor dmag la zhugs shing slob sbyong la dga' ba dang / bya ba la brtson 'grus che/ kho rang gshegs rjes/ ma'o tse tung mchog gis rgyal yongs la lha los hphin la slob sbyong byed dbos :zhes pa'i bka' brda gnang ngo //༷co dbyi lu'u ( 1922— 1964〉ni de snga ho nan zhing chen lan kha'o rdzong gi rdzong u hru'u ci'i 'gan bzhes pa'i ring la mchin skran gyi nad byung ste na zug bzod dka' ba skyes kyang / bzod bsran chen pos mi dmangs kyi thog drangs nas dbul phongs sel ched dka' sdug gang mang spyad de rang tshe ma rdzogs bar du bya ba'i mtshams ma bzhag pas/mi dmangs kyis khong ni tang bi las byed pa yas po red ces bstod bsngags byas/tshu'adir bshad pa'i kon ni kon krung dang pa'o ni pa'o hru'u yā la zer/ khong rnam 338

pa gnyis ni khrun tshig skabs kyi mi yin/ chung dus nas mthun 'dris che ba dang / cher skyes nas re zhig rgyal po so so'i blon du gyur te srid kyi dgra zlar langs/ phyis su kon krung bi rje bo pham zhing rang nyid kyang btson du tshud/ pa'o hru'u yā'i rje bor rgyal kha thob/ des pa'o hru'u yā srid blon chen por bsko bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ pa'o hru'u lngas kon krung ni rang nyid las kyang srid la mkhas par mthong nas rgyal por yang yang zhus pas/ mthar rgyal pos pa'o hru'u yā yi ngag la nyan te kon krung srid blon du bskos pas srid kyi lag rjes chen po bzhag skad/(1si ma kong ni sung rgyal rabs skabs kyi lo rgyus smra ba chen po yin/ lo bcu dgu'i ring sdug rus spyad nas 〈〈srid don me long 〉zhes pa'i deb ther brtsams skad/ khong rang chung dus blo rig bkra zhing dpa' rtul che ste/ nyin zhig grogs po rnams dang lhan du rtse ba'i skabs/ byis pa zhig chus gang ba'i rdza bum nang du lhung bas/ gzhan rnams skrag cing ci bya gtol med du gyur tshe/ si ma kong gis rdo chen po zhig btsal nas rdza chen bcag ste byis pa bskyabs pas phyis su mi rnams kyi bsngag bya'i yul du gyur/⑤han shar ma'i rgyal rabs skabs su dbyang krin zer ba'i dpon bzang zhig yod de/ thengs shig la khrang dbyi zhes pa'i rdzong brgyud nas phebs skabs/ rdzong dpon gyi 'gan 'khur ba'i grogs po zhig gis mtshan mor gser rgya ma bcu lkog rngan du phul te/ da ni nam gung yin pas mi sus kyang mi shes zer skad/ dbyang krin gyis don 'di gnam dang / lha/ khyod/ nga bcas kyis shes pas sus kyang mi shes zer ba ga la rung zer nas gser rnams phyir sprad/ gtam rgyud des dbyang krin gyi srid gtsang spyod bzang mngon par mtshon pas mi rnams kyi gong bkur thob skad/(grokun sgo'i dus mjug gi chin rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po chin hri hong zer ba des/ spyi lo sngon gyi 230lor han rgyal rabs la dpung 'jug byas pa nas bzung / lo bcu'i ring la rgyal rabs drug ste/ han dang / kra'o/ wa'e/ khru'u/ yan/ chi bcas bcom nas/ krung go'i lo rgyus thog gcig gyur gyi krung dbyang srid gzhung thog mar btsugs par grags/tunyehan nub ma'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po drug pa li'u khre zer ba des/ sa gnas kyi dbang shugs je chung du btang ba dang / tshong pa'i ma rtsa'i khral bsdus nas tshong 3// gi

tshul gtor ba dang / lcags bzhu/ tshwa len/ dngul lugs bcas las rigs bzhung gis gnyer ba/ chu bed bsgrubs shing nub byang du mi 'bor spor nas zhing rmos pa sogs byas pas/ dpal 'byor gong du spel zhing rgyal srid je brtan du btang zhes pa'o//6)thang the tsung lis hri min srid khrir mnga' sasol rjes rgyal rtags la krin kon zhes btags shing / mdzangs blon 'khor du bsdus/ zhing par sa zhing cha snyom du bgos/ chu bed bsgrubs/ zhing las spel nas zhing pa'i khral je yang du btang / rgya bza' kong jo bod rgyal srong btsan sgam/ po'i btsun mor bsdangs pa sogs mdzad pa che bas/ lo rgyus thog chab srid rgya yangs/ dpal 'byor 'phel ba/ phyi 'brel rgyas pa bcas kyi tshul 'di la 6 krin kon bde skyong mi zhes grags so//〈yiching rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po khang shis kyis zhing las la thugs 'khur dang / rma chu'i gnod pa sel ba dang / mdzangs mi bsdus nas gna' dpe dag sgrig byas te rig gnas gong du spel ba dang / hra hong sga btsan 'dzul dmag phar bzlog pa sogs mdzad pa rmad byung gang mang mchis pas song ma'i mchog tu grags pa'o//ཿhan nub ma'i rgyal po wu'u ti'i skabs blon su'u lu'u zer ba zhig byang phyogs zhun rnal la pho nyar mngags pa pha rol gyis bzung nas phyir ma btang bar byang mtsho khar sgyugs te lug 'tsho ru bcug sa de grang ngar che zhing zas dbon na'ang / lo bcu dgu'i ring bzod bsran byas mthar/ zhun nol dang han nub ma 'grigs pas su'u wu'u phyir pha yul du log go/ /khong i mes rgyal la blo dkar zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i snying stobs la kun gyis bsngags so//(mewe krin zhes pa ni thang rgyal rabs kyi dus mgo'i chab srid pa zhig yin/ khong sgas thang rgyal po lis hri min la srid
